original:
Yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem a 4 yʋʋm 2025 soabã Burkĩna Faso tʋʋm-noor ning sẽn get kibay kũun na tũ sorã taoor soab a Wẽndengũudi Lui Modɛɛs Wedraoog zẽka a naoor n tɩ zĩnd Memoryall Toma Sãnkara tɩ b maan kiuug pʋgẽ pipi lamus b sẽn yãk n waoogd a Toma Sãnkar ne a tũud-n-taas piig la a yiibã b sẽn kʋ wã waoor tẽegre. Lamusã yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem a 4 soabã yɩ a tẽegrã naoor a yiib soaba. Tẽeg-kãng soabã yaa Seɛsse CSC taoor rãmba, la kiba-kɩtbã ne Minitɛɛr dãmbã n maan-a.

CSC taoor soab a Wẽndgũudi Lui Modɛɛs Wedraoogo, ne kʋdemdã, kiba-kɩtbã la gilg-n-ges yel-soalma Miniisr a Pẽgdwẽnde Zɩlbɛɛr Wedraoogo, n paas Miniisr sõangda Amadu Diko sẽn get gʋʋlgã, ne Mali Miniisr a Bukar Dɛne sẽn get koomã ne kʋʋra wã, la Nizɛɛr neb zẽka b naoor n zĩnd zĩigẽ wã.

Miniisr Pẽgdwẽnde Zɩlbɛɛr Wedraoog koeesã pʋgẽ, a pẽga Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm Tarwore, a sẽn yãk yam tɩ kiuug pʋgẽ pipi lumus fãa bɩ Manitɛɛr dãmbã  maand waoor n tẽegd Kapitɛnd Toma Sãnkar ne a tũud-n-taas piig la a yiibã b sẽn kʋ wã yelle. A wilgame tɩ waoorã, yaa na-kẽnd-sõngo, sẽn na yɩl tɩ b rɩk yam a pʋgẽ, n tõog n kell n kẽng ne yam nins Kapitɛnd Toma Sãnkar sẽn da gãneg n na n tʋmã. Miniisrã togsame tɩ Memoryall Toma Sãnkara nin-naand-kasengã meeb ligd sẽn kẽ nan ka yɩɩd koabg  piig 10 % pʋgẽ ye, tɩ yaool n yaa Milyaar ka tɛk la b rat n paam n me-a. Yaa rẽ tɩ b rat tɩ ni-buiidã fãa kẽes b  toog tɩ b tõog n baas-a. Miniisr Pẽgdwẽnde Zɩlbɛɛr Wedraoog boonda nin-buiidã tɩ b kɩs b nug bũmb tɩ b tõog n me Memoryall Toma Sãnkarã t’a yɩ wa b sẽn datã.

Miniisrã koees poore, CSC taoor soab a Wẽndgũudi Lui Modɛɛs Wedraoog me rɩka koɛɛga. Yẽ me koeesã pʋgẽ, a kell n pẽg tẽngã zãadb yam yãkrã. A wilgame tɩ b yam yãkrã boonda burkĩn-bi wã la nin-sabls tẽnsã kamb tɩ b mobg taaba, la b naag taab zĩig fãa n zab ne nasaar wẽnsã ne b yam-soaadɩ wã, tɩ Kapitɛnd Toma Sãnkar sẽn da tuk sor ning n dat tɩ b vʋɩɩmd ne burkĩnd la zug zẽkrã tõog n yɩ vẽenega.

A Wẽndengũudi Lui Modɛɛs Wedroog ratame tɩ nin-buiidã kẽes b toog ne b nug bũmb tɩ Memoryall Toma Sãnkara wã, na n sõnga nin-sabls tẽnsã zãadb tɩ b politikã toeem na-kẽndre, n kẽng taoore, ne sɩda, la bʋ-tɩrse, tɩ b zamaanã gãand bãane.

A Pẽgdwẽnde Erik Zĩnaaba

Lamusa yuum sar kiuug rasem a naanse soaba yi a teiegra naoor a yiib soaba. Teieg kang soaba yaa Seesse CSC taoor ramba, la kiba kitba ne Miniteer damba on maan a.

Miniisr Peigdweinde Zilbeer Wedraoog koeesa pugei, a peiga Kapitend Yibrayiim Tarwore, a sein yak yam ti kiuug pugei pipi lumus faa bi Maniteer damba  maand waoor on teiegd Kapitend Toma Sankar ne a tuud n taas piig la a yiiba ub sein ku wa yelle. A wilgame ti waoora, yaa na keind sonngo, sein na yil ti ub rik yam a pugei, on toong on kell on keing ne yam nins Kapitend Toma Sankar sein da ganeg on na on tuma. Miniisra togsame ti Memoryall Toma Sankara nin naand kasenga meeb ligd sein kei nan ka yiid koabg  piig piiga % pugei ye, ti yaool on yaa Milyaar ka tek la ub rat on paam on me a. Yaa rei ti ub rat ti ni buiida faa keies b  toog ti ub toong on baas a. Miniisr Peigdweinde Zilbeer Wedraoog boonda nin buiida ti ub kis ub nug bumb ti ub toong on me Memoryall Toma Sankara t’a yi wa ub sein data.

Miniisra koees poore, CSC taoor soab a Weindguudi Lui Modees Wedraoog me rika koeega. Yei me koeesa pugei, a kell on peig teinga zaadb yam yakra. A wilgame ti ub yam yakra boonda burkin bi wa la nin sabls teinsa kamb ti ub mobg taaba, la ub naag taab ziig faa on zab ne nasaar weinsa ne ub yam soaadi wa, ti Kapitend Toma Sankar sein da tuk sor ning on dat ti ub vuiimd ne burkind la zug zeikra toong on yi veienega.

A Weindenguudi Lui Modees Wedroog ratame ti nin buiida keies ub toog ne ub nug bumb ti Memoryall Toma Sankara wa, na on sonnga nin sabls teinsa zaadb ti ub politika toeem na keindre, on keing taoore, ne sida, la bu tirse, ti ub zamaana gaand baane.

Sapaolg kiuug rasem 18 yʋʋm 2025 soabã Miniisr ning sẽn get yõ-koglgã sigla sull sẽn na n vaees raasã tɩ b boond tɩ « Ladeli ». Ladeli wã yaa tẽng gãand bãan rãmb 1100 n be a pʋgẽ. 

Ladeli sɩnga a tʋʋmdã Waogdgo, Sãnkaryaare. Sãnkaryaar vaeesgã pʋgẽ, b paama neb sẽn da koosd koosem tɩ ka tũud soay n yõge. B sẽn yõg b rãmbã ra koosda: bõn-pusdum, rã-toose, la te-wẽns buud toor-toore. Yõ-koglgã Miniisr a Masmuudu SÃANA wilgame tɩ sodaasã sẽn tʋm tʋʋmd ningã b fãaga neb ka tɛk yõore. Bala, b ka tõe n bãng tɩ tẽng gãand bãanã rãmb na n bee weoogẽ wã n zabd wĩndg la yʋngo, tɩ neb be Waogdg n dɩk zabrã n maan b paoong pukr sor ye. Sãnkaryaar nengẽ wã, b rɩka raarã tõr n kell n tʋm tʋʋmdã. La bũmb ning sẽn wa ne Sãnkaryaar vaeesgã, yaa sull ning tẽngã zãadb sẽn sigl tɩ b sigind tẽngã sẽn na yɩl tɩ bũmbã fãa tũ sor wala sẽn segd tɩ b boond tɩ Laabalã n da kẽng zĩigẽ wã n na n tɩ yõk tab-wẽngã koaasda, tɩ Sãnkaryaar raag biisã n yik-b tɩ b kõn tʋm b tʋʋmdã, yaa rẽ n wa ne b sigl Ladeli wã. Sãnkaryaar vaeesgã poore, sapaolg kiuug rasem 19 yʋʋm 2025 yaa Bobodɩʋlaso raagã la b vaeesda rãmbã.

Sapaolg kiuug rasem 18 yʋʋm 2025 Burkĩna Faso tẽngã taoor soab a Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE, tɩ zĩndame tɩ b pak nasaara nug tʋʋm-te-paal b sẽn boond tɩ Nimerikã rasem a yapoe tig-kaseng naoor pissi soaba, Waogdg ka, Sɩyao wã zak pʋgẽ. Tigrã kʋlens pakr wakate Kapitɛnd pẽga tẽng gãand bãanã rãmb sẽn be weoogã pʋg n tʋmd wĩndg la yʋngã. A  wilgame t’a sũur yaa noogo, bala, tẽngã nu-gãag zabrã wɛɛngẽ wã tẽeb la saagr beeme. A kell n togsame tɩ nasaar wẽngã ra magdame t’a na n lebsa Burkĩna Faso yõ-koglgã poorẽ, la kibay sẽn yi zabrã pʋg rasem a yopoe wã pʋgẽ, wilgdame tɩ bɛ wã raab ka na n tol n pid ye. Bala, zĩig fãa, nin-wẽnsã ne tẽng gãand bãanã rãmb lebga « wãamb zoe n bas a biiga ». Yaa rẽ t’a  kos nebã tɩ  b yik tɩ b  yals yĩngr maan yĩn-kiiri, n tags tẽng gãand bãana rãmb yelle. Sẽn kẽed ne Nimerikã wɛɛngẽ, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWOR yeelame tɩ yaa yʋʋm pissi, la Burkĩna Faso be-a pʋgẽ. Nebã sẽn seg taab n na n zĩnd rasem a yopoe wã pʋga,

a ratame tɩ b ges yʋʋm pissi wã sẽn loogã pugẽ tʋʋma, n bal n gese, b zoe kẽn n taa yae, la b rat n kẽng-a n ta zĩ-bʋgo. A wilgame 2023 tɛka, b kẽng taoor Nimerikã tʋʋm wɛɛngẽ la b segd n modgame n kell n kẽng taoor n paase. Bala, a ratame tɩ ka la yʋʋm a nu sẽn wata, bɩ b mik tɩ yaa wa b sẽn da be a pʋgẽ yʋʋm koabga. A kell n togsame tɩ Burkĩna Faso segd n lʋɩs-a-la taoore, n tõog tɩ ãndũni wã fãa pʋgẽ, bɩ Burkĩna Faso zĩnd sʋka. A wilgame tɩ rũnda-rũnda tʋʋmd ka le tõe n tʋm t’a ka be sʋk ye. B sã n dɩk Nimerikã n kẽes sʋka, a na n sõngame tɩ nin-yend sẽn dɩk neb ka tɛk tʋʋm n tʋmdẽ wã, bɩ rẽ kolg weoogo, t’a leb n kẽesd tẽngã laogo. A na n sõngame tɩ gosneem tʋʋma kẽng taoore. Yaa laafɩ wã wɛɛngẽ, tɩ yaa kaorengã, tɩ yaa yõ-koglgã zĩigẽ, bãmb fãa segdame tɩ b kẽes Nimerikã sʋka, sẽn na yɩl tɩ bũmbã fãa kẽng taoore. A kell n togsame tɩ b ka tõe n zab ne ninsaal yam raabã n tõog t’a ka zĩnd sʋk ye. B sã n dat zab ne-a t’a sa zãnga, rẽndame tɩ b kẽes Nimereikã zĩig fãa. Tɩ bala, tõnd tẽngã tara a tʋʋmde, yaa rẽ n kɩt tɩ gosneem kẽesd a toogo, sẽn na yɩl tɩ Nimerikã tall n tʋm lebg vẽenega. Tʋʋm-noya fãa sã n kẽes-a sʋka, a na n sõngame tɩ b zab ne ninsaal yam daabã. Yaa rẽ tɩ Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWOR rat tɩ neb nins sẽn tʋmd a pʋgẽ wã sẽn tar bãngr buud toor-toorã,

bɩ b rɩk-a  kẽes sʋk gosneem tʋʋm-noya pʋgẽ t’a  yaa bũmb sẽn tõe n sõng tɩ bɛ wã sã n na n ling n kẽ n maan sãoong bɩ b gɩbl tao-tao n seg-a t’a ka paam n ta ye. A wilgame tɩ rũndã zugã ned fãa ratame tɩ bũmb sã n yɩ pẽrɩ bɩ a togs tẽng gãand bãanã rãmb zĩig pʋgẽ tɩ b gɩbl tɩ ra sãam ye. Nimerikã fãaga neb ka tɛk yõya. Bala, a sõngdame tɩ b beool n seg nin-wẽnsã tɩ b ka tʋm yook ye. Yaa rẽ tɩ b rat tɩ b kẽes-a karen-dotã pʋse, la zĩig fãa.

Oni rãmb yiisa b yʋʋm 2025 magb sebr n wilg tɩ rapã sõor paooga pagbã. Ãndũni wã gilli, yaa neb tus-kẽemd a yopoe la zak n be a pʋgẽ. B gɛɛlã sebr wilga woto :

-Pagbã sõor yaa tus-kẽemd a nu 5,6 la zaka.

-Rapã sõor yaa tus-kẽemd a yiib 2,2 la zaka

Yaa rẽ tɩ Oni sagend pagbã tɩ b maan gũusg ne rapã yõy wẽgbo, la b waoog-b sõma, tɩ bala, b sõorã ka yɩɩd tus-kẽemd a yiib la zak ye :

-Rapã sʋka, rap tus-kẽemd a ye n zoe n kẽ kãadem.

-Rap nins sẽn kẽ kãadmã sʋka tus-kʋʋng 130 n be bãens rotẽ.

-Rap milyão 70 n be namsg pʋgẽ, zug kaoolg bãas wɛɛngẽ.

Rẽ wilgdame tɩ yaa rap tus-kẽemd a yembr masã, n wẽnd rap sẽn tõe n wa kẽ kãadem, bãmb tus-kẽemdã pʋgẽ:

– Rap koabg pʋgẽ rap pis-nu 50 % n ka tar tʋʋma

-Rap koabg a tãab 3 % n wẽneg n kẽed ne taab pag ne rao wɛɛngẽ

– Rap koabg a nu 5 % n ya labe rãmba, n ka kẽed kãadem ye

-B koabg pʋgẽ bãmb piig 10 % n ya buud a yembre, bɩ rogem

– Bãmb sʋkã neb pis-tã la a yiib 32 % n zoe n tar yʋʋm 66

Rẽ wã, m tãp sõmse gãd-y rapã kãenkã, la b zã-b ne waoore, tɩ rapã sõor na n paooga ãndũni wã pʋgẽ.

 Pagba soonr yaa tus keiemd a nu nu,yoobe la zaka.

 Rapa soonr yaa tus keiemd a yiib yiibu,yiibu la zaka

Yaa rei ti Oni sagend pagba ti ub maan guusg ne rapa yony weigbo, la ub waoog b sonma, ti bala, ub soonra ka yiid tus keiemd a yiib la zak ye :

 Rapa suka, rap tus keiemd a ye on zoe on kei kaadem.

 Rap nins sein kei kaadma suka tus kuung koabg la pistan on be baens rotei.

 Rap milyao pisyopoe on be namsg pugei, zug kaoolg baas weengei.

Rei wilgdame ti yaa rap tus keiemd a yembr masa, on weind rap sein tone on wa kei kaadem, bamb tus keiemda pugei:

– Rap koabg pugei rap pis nu pisnu % on ka tar tuuma

 Rap koabg a taab taanbo % on weineg on keied ne taab pag ne rao weengei

– Rap koabg a nu nu % on ya labe ramba, on ka keied kaadem ye

 B koabg pugei bamb piig piiga % on ya buud a yembre, bi rogem

– Bamb suka neb pis ta la a yiib pistan la a yiibu % on zoe on tar yuum pisyoobe la a yoobe

Rei wa, m tap sonmse gad y rapa kaenka, la ub za b ne waoore, ti rapa soonr na on paooga anduni wa pugei.

Sapaolg kiuug rasem 12 yʋʋm 2025 soab na-zakẽ wã tʋʋm-noor ning sẽn zabd ne :ninsaal yam daabã  ne wẽgbã, la tʋʋm kɛg buud toor-toor sẽn tõe n wa tiis tẽngã taoor kẽnd tɩ b boond tɩ Koraaga, taoor soab a Faruk Azarya Sorg leb n yii Telvzõ nasnall yʋng wakat 9h00 n karem Koraagã mooneg a tãab soaba. B sẽn togs kibarã kɩtbã,  a yaa bũmb sẽn tõe n wa ne zu-loees b yõya koglg wɛɛngẽ. APẽndwẽnde Erik Zinaaba

original:
Pĩndã bi-beesã ra gɩta pagb la rap Tuudbweoog sorã zug n deesd b montɛy la b ligdi. Pagb nins sẽn yikd pĩnd n kẽnd n pɩɩsd soaya tɩ b boond-b t’a Sɩmo pagbã, la sẽn tʋmd-b tẽngã pʋgẽ wã, b ra veooda kẽer n kẽed moogã n tʋmd-b sẽn ka sakda.  La sẽn zems yʋʋm 2024, zu-loe-kãng ra sɩnga weoog kolgre, tɩ bala, b ninga sorã kõntaale la Lampadɛɛr dãmba. Rẽ ra kɩtame tɩ bi-beesã ra ka le tõe n solg n tʋm  tʋʋm-beedã ye.  La yellã yaa “pẽg pag n yaag yal a zẽedẽ”. Tɩ bala, yʋʋmd a yembr poore, bi-beesã tõe n le wa paama solgr zĩiga, tɩ Arõndiisma 4 Delgasẽoespesɛll rãmb sã n ka yik n pĩnd n beoole.

 Rõmpõe ning sẽn be Wẽndyaawẽnd noorẽ wã ne Terã bãng sʋka, Lampadɛɛr rãmb pis-naas n segd be be. Rũndã sapaolg kiuug rasem 11 yʋʋm 2025, Lampadɛɛr dãmb pis-naas sʋka, bãmb pissi la a tãab n ki. Yaool n yaa zĩ-kãng la bi-beesã sẽn da gɩtã. Sagdã zak sẽne  likã rat n lebga wʋsgo. Yaa rẽ tɩ m bõosd Arõndiisma 4 Meer t’a lebs Tuudbweoog sorã Lampadɛɛr rãmba, la a ra bas tɩ kɩɩm kẽ roogẽ t’a yaool n pag ragno-pĩir ye. A Pẽgdwẽnde Erik Zĩnaaba
converted:
Pinda bi beesa ra gita pagb la rap Tuudbweoog sora zug on deesd ub montey la ub ligdi. Pagb nins sein yikd pind on keind on piisd soaya ti ub boond b t’a Simo pagba, la sein tumd b teinga pugei wa, ub ra veooda keier on keied mooga on tumd b sein ka sakda.  La sein zems yuum tuusa yiibu la pisi la a naanse, zu loe kang ra singa weoog kolgre, ti bala, ub ninga sora konntaale la Lampadeer damba. Rei ra kitame ti bi beesa ra ka le tone on solg on tum  tuum beeda ye.  La yella yaa “peig pag on yaag yal a zeiedei”. Ti bala, yuumd a yembr poore, bi beesa tone on le wa paama solgr ziiga, ti Aronndiisma naanse Delgaseioespesell ramb sa on ka yik on pind on beoole.

 Ronmpone ning sein be Weindyaaweind noorei wa ne Tera bang suka, Lampadeer ramb pis naas on segd be be. Runda sapaolg kiuug rasem piig la a yembre yuum tuusa yiibu la pisi la a nu, Lampadeer damb pis naas suka, bamb pissi la a taab on ki. Yaool on yaa zi kang la bi beesa sein da gita. Sagda zak seine  lika rat on lebga wusgo. Yaa rei ti m boonsd Aronndiisma naanse Meer t’a lebs Tuudbweoog sora Lampadeer ramba, la a ra bas ti kiim kei roogei t’a yaool on pag ragno piir ye. A Peigdweinde Erik Zinaaba

original:
Sapaolg kiuug rasem a 7 yʋʋm 2025 soabã Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWOR reega nin-sabls nins sẽn dog Amerik la Eropo, la Karayiib soolmẽ wã Waogdgo. Gom-zug tẽngã zãadb sẽn yãk n deeg-bã, yaa” ne y waoongo, yãmb tẽngẽ wã”. Sõasgã pʋgẽ, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWOR wilgame tɩ neb nins sẽn da yõg nin-sablã n kẽes yembdã ne b sõangdbã  sã n  wʋm tɩ nin-sablsã  rat n sooga b mense, a namsd-b-la wʋsgo, la sẽn ya a soab fãa, nin-sabls tẽnsã kom-bɩɩb  yam pukame.

 A wilgame t’a na n tʋmame tɩ Burkĩna Faso yɩ makre, tɩ neb a taabã bãng tɩ bãmb me tõe sooga b mense. Yaa neb ta bãmb 700 n zẽk b naoor n sig Burkĩna Faso, n na n wilg b sũur belem ne tẽngã taoor soaba a Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE. Tẽngã taoor soab pẽg-b lame, n wilg-b tɩ b yaa Burkĩna Faso no-rɛɛsdba. Bãmb sẽn yi nasaar tẽns n wa zĩnd Burkĩna Faso n gilg n maan b sẽn datã n lebg n kuus ne laafɩ wã, bãmb na n yɩɩ kaseto, tɩ nebã bãng tɩ nasaar wẽnsã sẽn ningd nebã zutẽ tɩ Burkĩna Faso la AES tẽnsã ka gãe bãanã, a ka tar tikr zĩig ye. Tẽngã taoor soab yeel-b-la woto:” tõnd maoorã ka Burkĩna Faso na paam a burkĩndã  bal ye. Burkĩna Faso maooda nin-sabls tẽnsã yĩnga, la nin-sablg buudã fãa na paam a burkĩndã”.  

A wilg-b lame tɩ sẽn kẽed ne b na paam Burkĩna Faso sɛb n tõe n zĩnd Burkĩna Faso wa b sẽn date, gosneerã taoor ra togsame tɩ yaood n be tɩ segd n yao, la yẽ yãka yaoodã n base. B sã n dat n pags tʋʋm-noy bɩ b wa pagse, tɩ gosneer na n maoome tɩ bũmb ra maan-b ye. B na n yãag-b lame tɩ b tõog n tʋm n nafe. Sãambã no-rɛɛsa Dogtɛɛr Arikana Sisombori-Kao togsame tɩ bãmb me na n yãaga tẽngã taoor dãmba, b yam yãkr buud fãa pʋgẽ. A wilgame t’a sũur yaa noogo, ne Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE, ne a gosneerã taoor soaba. A pẽg-b lame, tɩ bala, b sakame tɩ bãmb na n lebg n leb b yãgrẽ wã.

Tẽegre, b  waa Burkĩna Faso zĩ-likr kiuug rasem 26 yʋʋm 2025 n gilg n seg neb ka tɛka, la b kõ kũun buud toor-toore. Wẽnd na leb n wa ne-b yʋʋmd sẽn wata. A Pẽgdwẽnde Erik Zĩnaaba
converted:
Sapaolg kiuug rasem a yopoe yuum tuusa yiibu la pisi la a nu soaba Kapitend Yibrayiim TARWOR reega nin sabls nins sein dog Amerik la Eropo, la Karayiib soolmei wa Waogdgo. Gom zug teinga zaadb sein yak on deeg ba, yaa” nei waoongo, yamb teingei wa”. Sonasga pugei, Kapitend Yibrayiim TARWOR wilgame ti neb nins sein da yong nin sabla on keies yembda ne ub sonangdba  sa n  wum ti nin sablsa  rat on sooga ub mense, a namsd b la wusgo, la sein ya a soab faa, nin sabls teinsa kom biib  yam pukame.

 A wilgame t’a na on tumame ti Burkina Faso yi makre, ti neb a taaba bang ti bamb me tone sooga ub mense. Yaa neb ta bamb kobs yopoe on zeik ub naoor on sig Burkina Faso, on na on wilg ub suur belem ne teinga taoor soaba a Kapitend Yibrayiim TARWORE. Teinga taoor soab peig b lame, on wilg b ti ub yaa Burkina Faso no reesdba. Bamb sein yi nasaar teins on wa zind Burkina Faso on gilg on maan ub sein data on lebg on kuus ne laafi wa, bamb na on yii kaseto, ti neba bang ti nasaar weinsa sein ningd neba zutei ti Burkina Faso la AES teinsa ka gae baana, a ka tar tikr ziig ye. Teinga taoor soab yeel b la woto:” tonnd maoora ka Burkina Faso na paam a burkinda  bal ye. Burkina Faso maooda nin sabls teinsa yinga, la nin sablg buuda faa na paam a burkinda”.  

A wilg b lame ti sein keied ne ub na paam Burkina Faso seb on tone on zind Burkina Faso wa ub sein date, gosneera taoor ra togsame ti yaood on be ti segd on yao, la yei yaka yaooda on base. B sa on dat on pags tuum noy bi ub wa pagse, ti gosneer na on maoome ti bumb ra maan b ye. B na on yaag b lame ti ub toong on tum on nafe. Saamba no reesa Dogteer Arikana Sisombori Kao togsame ti bamb me na on yaaga teinga taoor damba, ub yam yakr buud faa pugei. A wilgame t’a suur yaa noogo, ne Kapitend Yibrayiim TARWORE, ne a gosneera taoor soaba. A peig b lame, ti bala, ub sakame ti bamb na on lebg on leb ub yagrei wa.

Teiegre, b  waa Burkina Faso zi likr kiuug rasem pisi la a yoobe yuum tuusa yiibu la pisi la a nu on gilg on seg neb ka teka, la ub kon kuun buud toor toore. Weind na leb on wa ne b yuumd sein wata. A Peigdweinde Erik Zinaaba

original:
Sa-sik kiuug rasem a 6 n tãag a rasem a 9 yʋʋm 2025 Ministɛɛr ning sẽn get laafɩ wã tʋʋm-noor a ye b sẽn boond tɩ « SIG-eDMP » boola kiba-kɩtb sõor na ta bãmb 50  Zɩnyãre Reezõ de Wubri wã soolmẽ tɩ b zĩnd n pʋɩ taab yam sẽn kẽed ne pagbã ne b kambã sẽn maand kaalem b rogmã wakate, bɩ b rogmã poore. B zĩndgã ne taabã tʋlsem yaa sẽn na n yɩlẽ tɩ kiba-kɩtbã kẽes b toog tɩ b sõng taab n  sagl nin-buiidã, tɩ b naag taab n zab ne-a t’a kolg weoogo. A Silvi Yeri Yul/ Tarwar « DSF »  pag ning sẽn get nin-buiidã ne b zagsã rãmb laafɩ taoor soab wilgame tɩ pagbã ne b kambã sẽn kiid rogmã wakatã , naoor wʋsgo, a mi n naaga ne neb nins sẽn segd n beool n segl n gũud pagã t’a sã n kẽ logtor yirã bɩ bũmb ra paoog n yɩ sabaab n tiis-a wã, yaa bãmb rãmbã n mi n ka kẽes b toog tʋʋlle, n wat ne rẽ.

Wakat ninga b tata ne pagã, n mik tɩ b ka reng n beool n bao zɩɩm bɩ teed kẽer n dʋʋg n da gũud-a ye. A Silvi Yeri Yul/Tarwar wilgame tɩ kiba-kɩtbã sã n sak n kẽes b toog ne sagls la vẽnegr buud toor-toore, wakat sẽn wat pʋgẽ, b na n mikame tɩ b tõoga maoorã. B tʋlsmã sã n pidi,  kambã ne b ma rãmbã kũum rogmã wakat bɩ rogmã poor sã n ka sa me, bɩ a kolg weoogo. A wilgame tɩ bãmb kõo sɩd tɩ kiba-kɩtbã sã n kẽes b toog ne sagls la vẽnegr buud toor-toore, nin-buiidã me na n sak n lʋɩɩsa b toog n yãag pagbã ne b kambã tɩ b paam tɩbsgo, la b ges b pʋsã n tãag b rogem sasa.

Porfesɛɛr Adma Watara wilgame tɩ b sã n yeel tɩ pag kũum tũu ne rogem, yaa pagã sẽn na n wa kẽnd ne rasem 42 pʋga. Rẽ poore, rasem nins sẽn pʋgdã a sã n maan kaalem yaa pʋgã n yɩ sabaabo. Kambã rẽ yaa wala pag sã n dog a rasem a yopoe pʋgẽ tɩ biigã wẽneg n maan kaalem. A kaalmã sabaab tũu ne a rogmã wakate. Sasa kẽere, biigã tõe n kii pʋgẽ wã n yaool n yi, ka rẽ  bɩ a yi n wẽneg n maan kaalem rasem yopoe pʋgẽ.

Burkĩna Faso kom-kũumã ket n beeme. Yʋʋm 2010 kamb tus koabg pʋgẽ bãmb 198 n maan kaalem tɩ tũ ne b rogmã sabaabo. Rũndã zugã pagb tusr bɩ pagb kosbs-wae n maand kaalem sẽn tũ ne b pʋsã sabaabo. Vaeesgã wilgame tɩ Burkĩna wen-vɩɩs a naasã pʋgẽ kamb sẽn maand kaalem b rogmã wakat bɩ b rogmã poore, b sõorã yaa kamb 15000. Yʋʋmd pʋgẽ yaa kamb 9000 bɩ 6000 n maand kaalem sẽn tũ ne rogmã sabaabo. B sõorã sẽn ya wʋsgã wilgdame tɩ kambã kũum ket n yaa wʋsgo. Yaa rẽ la bãngdbã ges tɩ segdame tɩ b sagl nin-buiidã tɩ b kẽes b toog n beool tɩ b gɩdg-a. A gɩdgrã soay yaa wʋsgo. Pipi, ya b reng n segl pagã rogem teedo, a yãagdba, la bũmb nins fãa sẽn na n tɩ sõng-a logtorã yir tɩ bũmb ra paooge, n wa ne zu-loees ye. Zĩ-kãngã kibayã taasg na n sõngame tɩ nebã fãa yɩ wʋmdba, la b sak n kẽes b toogo.

Tʋʋm-noorã geta Pastɛɛr rãmbã kaorengo, la ned buud fãa sẽn karem buudã goam n paam bãngr kaset sebre, n dat n kẽng taoor ne bãngr kaset sɛb wala: Lisãase, Metriisi, Bake, Dogtora…

INSETA pipia karen-biisã kaoreng balb sɩnga Zɩnyãr soolmã Nakamtẽnga, yibeoog wakat 09h sasa. Balbã maana  Miniisr ning sẽn get karen-bi-bãoonesã la buudã piuugri a Zak Sostɛnd DẼNGARA, a Hawa KẼNDRBEOOGO, ned ning Ministɛɛrã sẽn zĩnig t’a get buudã goamã, la karen-biisã karen-saamb kasenga Dogtɛɛt Sãmwɛll KORGO, n paas Burkĩna Merka wã taoor soab kasenga.

Tʋʋl-nif kiuug rasem 30 yʋʋm 2025 soabã, a yɩɩ daar sẽn ka wẽnd a taab Burkĩna Faso la ãnduni wã tẽns a taab pʋsẽ.  Yaa Wanyiyã lagem-n-taar sull kaseng ning b sẽn boond tɩ SENAVESE wã n bool nin-buiidã tɩ b sak n yi n zulum yiib n wilg tɩ b bee ne tẽngã taoor soaba, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE. Waogdgo, yɩɩ Palaasdelarevolisẽo la b seg taaba. Yɩɩ pagba, rapa, karen-biisi, la goosneerã taoor soab a Zã Emanwɛɛl WEDRAOOGO, n paas miniisr dãmb kẽere.

Koeesã   rɩsg sẽn wa n sɩnge, SENAVESE wã taoor soaba a Onoore SAMADULG wilgame tɩ ninbuiidã yiime n wilg b belem ne tẽnga taoor soaba, la b leb n wilg nasaar wẽnsã la neb nins fãa sẽn dat n sãam Kapitend Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE naama tɩ b gũus tɩ ninbuiidã yasa a wɩla.

Sãn yaa ne Amerik Zenerallã a Mikayɛl Lãgle sẽn wilg tɩ kapitend Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE rɩkda Burkĩna Faso sãnma sẽn na n yɩlẽ n paam n koglg a mengã , n basd ninbuiidã, a wilgame tɩ yaa paoogr meng a sẽn paoog tẽnga taoor soaba . A Onore Samadulgu sokame gese rẽn yĩnga Burkĩna Faso naaga Amerik soolme ? bɩ a Lãgle rat n lebga Burkĩna Faso neda ? sãn mikame t’a yaab rãmba sẽn yi nasaara nins yẽ sẽn yaa b yamb rũnda rũnda wã ra yaa Burkĩna Faso faso neba, bɩ a wilg tɩ rẽnda tõe n sõngame t’a paam n yi Burkĩna tẽng n bɩɩga. A wilgame tɩ nasaar wẽngã, ne aa tʋʋmd n taasã sẽn yaa nin-wẽnsã ka tar b zĩig Burkĩna Faso ye.A kẽnga taoor n wilg tɩ AYEYƐSÃ ninbuiid gãda taaba, rẽnd nasaar wẽngã ne a tẽng-n-tɛɛndbã fãa ka na n tõog tɩ b raabã pid ye.

A Labidi NABA, SENAVESE wã tãb biig a yembr wilgame tɩ tigs kãnga yaa ãnduni wã fãa tigsga, a tʋlsma yaa ninbuiidã fãa yãag tẽnga taoor soaba so-sõng ninga a sẽn dɩka zugu, la b wilg nasaar wẽengã, sẽn tar sɩlem ninga n dat n sãam tẽngã t’a raabã ka na n tol n pid ye. A kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ sãn n yaa ne yẽ, koeegã ka lʋɩ muk tʋbrẽ ye, bala zama wã sẽn yi wʋsgã yaa kibar sẽn kõt bɛ wã t’a maan gũusgu.

Gosneerã taoor soaba a Rĩmtalba Zã Emanwɛl WEDRAOOG rɩka koeeg tẽnga taoor soab yʋʋr yĩnga. A koeesã pʋgẽ a reng n tẽega naong ning yaab rãmba sẽn paam yemdã wakatã, ket n yaa na kẽnd kãng la b sẽn le rat n dɩkã, bala ninsabls wʋsg sẽn be nasaarã wã maasme n ket n dat n zãmb b saam biisã n paam b noor rɩɩbo.A wilga neb nĩns fãa sẽn dat Burkĩna Faso ne wẽngã tɩ b gũus b meng tɩ wakat kãng loogame, bala Burkĩna Faso sẽn vɩɩmd bũmb ning yʋʋmd 1987 soabã ka na n le yɩlem ye. Yʋʋm 1987 soabã, nasaar wẽengã talla wogb bũud toor-toore, n wilg t’a Tama SÃNKAR yaa naab sẽn nams a ninbuiidã la a kʋʋd ba, woto yɩɩ sabaab t’a tunug ninsabls tẽns neb kẽere la Burkĩna Faso tẽng kamb sẽn ka tar tagsg tɩ ka b mensa bal n paam n kʋ-a, rũnda rũnda wã, tõnd be yʋʋù 2025 soabã. A kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ ninbuiidã segd n tik n yikame n naag taab n yals tẽnga taoor soab poorẽ, bala yaa zunoog meng-meng ne-ba tɩ b paam taoor soab sẽn yaa bi-bɩɩga n leb yaa ned sẽn yaa ges yɩɩg soaba.

A Rĩmtalba Zã Emanwɛll WEDRAOOG kell n dɩka tẽnga taoor soab koees n taas ninbuiidã fãa a wilgame tɩ tẽnga taoor soab yeelame t’a taas ninbuiidã ta sũur ka kiuusd ye, tɩ ba tʋʋm yoodã bũud toor-toor sẽn tʋʋmdã, a pɛlg ket n yaa kãe-kãe, t’a na n tʋʋm tẽnga na yi nin-wẽnsa nugẽ, la a tõog n kẽng taoore.

Gosneerã taoor soab pasaame tɩ ninbuiidã sẽn yi wʋsg woto wã yaa bũmb sẽn paasd tẽnga taoor soab raoodo, tɩ bala ninbuiidã sãn be a poorẽ, raabem ka be ye. A baasã a koeesã n wilg tɩ zaama wã sẽn tigs woto wã na n namsa neb –kẽere, kẽer na n kẽeme n mak gõeem n koonge.

Tʋʋl nif kiuug rasem 30 yʋʋm 2025 soabã yaa raar sẽn ka na n tol yiime bala, Burkĩna Faso sẽn yãk a toogo, ãduni wã tẽns wʋsg pʋsẽ ninbuiidã yiime n wilg b belem ne Kapitend Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE, bala a yaa ned la ning sẽn na n kɩt tɩ ninsabls tẽnsa tõog n paam b soog-n-meng sɩd sɩda, la b tõog n kẽng taoore.

original:
Wao-fugdg kiuug rasem 28 yʋʋm 2025 soabã ministɛɛr ning sẽn get kaorengã, la buudã goam na kẽng taoorã sigla seg-taab-kaseng Waga deemill sɛkã roogẽ. Tigsgã taoor yɩɩ gosneema taoor soab a Rĩmtallba Zã Emanwɛll WEDRAOOGO, tɩ ba-yãkdgã ya a Zak Sostɛnd DẼNGARA, minisr ning sẽn get kaorengã la buudã goam na kẽng taoorã. Gom-zut b sẽn tik n maan tigsgã, yaa «Afirik zamaana buud goama:  koees sẽn na wa ne manegre, bʋ-sɩd la nin-buiidã burkĩnd pukri, tɩ d me Afirik ning tõnd sẽn datã». «Buudã goam bee sʋka : Ned fãa buud gomd daar sẽn  yãk n kõ ãndũni wã yʋʋm pissi la a nu kɩdengo».

Gosneemã taoor soab sẽn lʋɩ tʋʋmdã taoorã, a rɩka koɛɛg ne moore. A koɛɛgã rɩkr wilgame,  tɩ wakat sẽn looge,  karen-dotã pʋsẽ, karen-biig sã n da gom buudã gomde, b sɩbgd-a lame, hal n ning-a bãnd t’a taabã laad-a. Rẽ fãa yaa nasaara wã sẽn da kẽes nin-sablsã zutẽ,

 tɩ b yĩm b buudã gomde, la b rɩk yẽ rẽ wã, t’a paam n maan nebã a yembse. La rũndã-rũndã, nin-sablsã nin pukame. Rẽ n so tɩ b rɩk na-kẽnda n kẽesd buudã goam karen-dotã pʋsẽ, la tẽngã tẽn-kugr pʋgẽ. Na-kẽnd-kãng wilgdame tɩ d raabã sẽn ya na lebg d sẽn yiẽ wã, a na n paama pidsgu. A Rĩmtallba Zã Emanwɛll WEDRAOOG kosa nin-buiidã tɩ b tik b buudã goama,  tɩ rẽ bal n tõe tɩ b tẽngã kẽng taoore, a yidgrã wɛɛngẽ.

Buudã goam ra-kasengã siglg taoor soab a Awa Kẽndrbeoog wilgame tɩ yaa sũ-noog ne-ba, tɩ bala gosneerã taoor soab sẽn zẽk b naoor n wa lʋɩ tigsgã pʋgẽ. Rẽ zoe n yaa bũmb sẽn wilgd tɩ buudã goam rɩk n kẽes sʋkã be a na-kẽnd-sõng zugu. A kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ nin-sabls tẽnsã rãmb segd n tika b kʋdemdã, la b rog-n-mikã. La b sã n dat n maan rẽ,  rẽndame tɩ  b tik b buudã goama. Bala, «pag ka geta a pog-to peoogo, n lub a wam zaok ye». A koeesã baasgẽ, a wilgame tɩ nin-sablsã ka tõe n yidg tɩ b sã n ka b tik b buudã goam ye.

Tigsgã pʋga, karen-biisã maana reem n bẽd n wilg nin-buiidã tɩ buudã goam tara yõodo.

B kell n wilga buudã goam yõod sẽn tõe n kẽng ne ninsaal taoor toto. Tigsgã baasa ne sũ-noogo, tɩ b kõ taab sɛk yʋʋmd sẽn wate, n na n le segd taab rasem a yopoe wã b sẽn yãk tɩ ya nin-sabls tẽns buudã goam tẽegrã.

A Zill KAFAANDO, ne a Pẽgdwẽnde Erik ZINAABA
converted:
Wao fugdg kiuug rasem pisi la a nii yuum tuusa yiibu la pisi la a nu soaba ministeer ning sein get kaorenga, la buuda goam na keing taoora sigla seg taab kaseng Waga deemill seka roogei. Tigsga taoor yii gosneema taoor soab a Rimtallba Za Emanwell WEDRAOOGO, ti ba yakdga ya a Zak Sostend DẼNGARA, minisr ning sein get kaorenga la buuda goam na keing taoora. Gom zut ub sein tik on maan tigsga, yaa «Afirik zamaana buud goama:  koees sein na wa ne manegre, bu sid la nin buiida burkind pukri, ti d me Afirik ning tonnd sein data». «Buuda goam bee suka : Ned faa buud gomd daar sein  yak on kon anduni wa yuum pissi la a nu kidengo».

Gosneema taoor soab sein lui tuumda taoora, a rika koeeg ne moore. A koeega rikr wilgame,  ti wakat sein looge,  karen dota pusei, karen biig sa on da gom buuda gomde, ub sibgd a lame, hal on ning a band t’a taaba laad a. Rei faa yaa nasaara wa sein da keies nin sablsa zutei,

 ti ub yim ub buuda gomde, la ub rik yei rei wa, t’a paam on maan neba a yembse. La runda runda, nin sablsa nin pukame. Rei on so ti ub rik na keinda on keiesd buuda goam karen dota pusei, la teinga tein kugr pugei. Na keind kang wilgdame ti d raaba sein ya na lebg d sein yiei wa, a na on paama pidsgu. A Rimtallba Za Emanwell WEDRAOOG kosa nin buiida ti ub tik ub buuda goama,  ti rei bal on tone ti ub teinga keing taoore, a yidgra weengei.

Buuda goam ra kasenga siglg taoor soab a Awa Keindrbeoog wilgame ti yaa su noog ne ba, ti bala gosneera taoor soab sein zeik ub naoor on wa lui tigsga pugei. Rei zoe on yaa bumb sein wilgd ti buuda goam rik on keies suka be a na keind sonng zugu. A keinga taoor on paas ti nin sabls teinsa ramb segd on tika ub kudemda, la ub rog n mika. La ub sa on dat on maan rei,  reindame ti  b tik ub buuda goama. Bala, «pag ka geta a pog to peoogo, on lub a wam zaok ye». A koeesa baasgei, a wilgame ti nin sablsa ka tone on yidg ti ub sa on ka ub tik ub buuda goam ye.

Tigsga puga, karen biisa maana reem on beid on wilg nin buiida ti buuda goam tara yoondo.

B kell on wilga buuda goam yoond sein tone on keing ne ninsaal taoor toto. Tigsga baasa ne su noogo, ti ub kon taab sek yuumd sein wate, on na on le segd taab rasem a yopoe wa ub sein yak ti ya nin sabls teins buuda goam teiegra.

A Zill KAFAANDO, ne a Peigdweinde Erik ZINAABA

original:
Wao-fugdg kiuug rasem 24 yʋʋm 2025 soabã pʋgẽ, ministɛɛr ning sẽn get karen-bi-bãoonesã la buudã goam na kẽng taoor tʋʋm-noor ning sẽn tʋmd buudã goam na piuugã yãka Waogdg Samandẽ, “BCD’ Ekoall a ye b sẽn yãk n zãmsd kambã buudã gaom kaorengo, la a gʋlsgo, ne nasaara wã goam kaoreng zĩiga, n tɩ yaas n kõ sore,  tɩ b na n maan nin-sabls tẽnsẽ buudã goam ra-yopoende. Rasem a yopoe wã pʋgẽ, yaa tõnd sẽn dog ne goam ninsã la b na n zĩnd ne taab n ges b sẽn tõe n gãneg soay nins n tõog  t’a yɩ yidgrã la taoorã kẽnd zab-teoogo, nin-buiidã fãa yĩnga. B sɩnga buudã ra-yopoendã arzũma wao-fugdg kiuug rasem 21 n na n tall-a n tɩ tãag kiuugã rasem 26.

 Burkĩna Faso rãmb yãka gom-zu-kãngã: Buudã goam kaoreng la a gʋlsg na kẽng taoor yĩnga, bɩ ned fãa kẽes a meng t’a yɩ sabaab n pak tɩlgr la yidgr sor n kõ nin-buiidã fãa. La sã n ya ne Reezõ di sãntrã, bãmb tika : Buudã goam kaoreng na kẽng taoore: A yõod paoongo, la a alkaol rɩkr ne nin-buiidã yidgr yĩnga.

Bũmb nins sẽn wa ne koe-zutã yãkre, b wilgame tɩ buudã goam kaoreng gʋlsg sɩngr zãrame. A yaa sabaab tɩ neb kẽer tar-a n tʋmd nafd b mense, tɩ rẽ zoe n wilgdẽ t’a yõodã waoogame. La b sã n leb n na n ges yɩɩga, b mikdame t’a karemdbã sõor ka waoog ye. Rẽ fãa wilgda vẽenega, tɩ buudã goam  kaoeng bãngr kom la ko-yũud ket n tara nin-buiidã. Neb sẽn namsd a pʋgẽ yaa kom-bɩɩbã. Burkĩna Faso kamb sõor na ta pisopoe la a zak n ket b ka mi b buudã goam kaoreng la gʋlsg ye.

La b gesame n mik tɩ Fãrendã goam kaoreng la a gʋlsg me sɩngr zãrame. La ba ne rẽ fãa nin-buiidã ket n ka tõe n yidg b mens ye.

B ka tõe n yidg b mensã yãgre, yaa Fãrendã sẽn ka b buudã goama. Yaa rẽ la b yãk rasem a yopoe tõre, n na n zĩnd n tags buudã goam kaoreng la a gʋlsg zugu, n bao yam n pʋɩ taab tɩ zu-loɛɛgã yã tɩɩm. Sẽn sigl-b ra-poendã rãmb wilgame tɩ buudã goam kaoreng sõngda biig t’a yam weke. A leb n sõngda ned t’a ket n tar waoor ning a sẽn dog n mik tɩ nebã waoogd taab toto wã.

A Hawa Sawadgo, miniisrã sẽn yãk ned ning t’a be Ministɛɛrẽ wã n get buudã goama wilgame tɩ buudã goam kaoreng sõngda ned buud fãa t’a mi ned sẽn yɩɩd-a la a waoogd-a. Tẽegre, yaa yʋʋm 1961 la b sɩng-a, n da dɩkd-a n kẽesd Ekoallsẽ wã, la a ka zãag zĩig ye. Sẽn leb n wa ta yʋʋm 1979, b leb n waa ne-a, yẽ ka zãag zĩig ye.

Rẽ fãa wilgdame tɩ buudã goam kaoreng la a gʋlsgo, b ra ka rɩk-a n lʋɩɩs taoor boto ye. Tɩ bala, nasaara wã belga nin-buiidã n yãk bãensã a sẽn da sog b nusã la b nao wã, n leb n kẽ b zutẽ wã n soge. Rẽ kɩtame tɩ b ra yetẽ tɩ yaa nasaara wã buud gomd bal n tõe n sõng-b tɩ b yidgi. La Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWOOR ne gosneer yãka yam n dɩk-a n lʋɩɩs taoore, t’a be tẽngã tẽn-kugr pʋgẽ. Rẽ yaa paoong ne burkĩn buudã fãa.

Burkĩna Faso rãmb kɩdemda buudã goam ra-kaseng b sẽn boond tɩ nin-sabls tẽnsẽ buud goam ra-yopoende. Nin-sabls tẽnsã zãng yãka gom-zu-kãngã: Nin-sabls tẽns buud goam sẽn na n sõng tɩ nebã paam yẽsg ne taaba, la lagem-n-taar ne taaba, tɩ tõnd tõog n me Afrik ning tõnd sẽn datã.

Waogdg soolmã komber tʋma ned t’a wa b yʋʋr yĩnga. Koeesã rɩkr pʋgẽ, nin-kãng soabã wilgame tɩ ra-kasen-kãngã tʋlsem yaa nin-sabls tẽnsã zãadb na naag taab noor a ye sũur a ye, tɩ b kambã paam buudã goam kaoreng la a gʋlsgo, n lebg n bãng b yaab rãmbã soalma, b sɩɩlse, b kibaya, la b yel-bũn gãnegre. Yaa neb ka tɛk n zĩnd zĩigẽ n dɩk koees buud toor-toore. Ekoallã karen-biis maana reem la Tayatr sẽn tar seem tɩ nin-buiidã naag taab n gese. Zʋgnall Rãamd taoor soabã karma Ekoall Samandẽ. Sẽn na yɩl tɩ kamb nins sẽn ledg bãmb zĩigã tõog n paam buudã goam n yãag b mense,   a Rãamd taoor soabã a Yɩrɛne TẼEDRBEOOG kɩsa Zʋgnall Rãamde la kaoreng sebr sẽn boond tɩ “Nonglem yaa bãaga”, tɩ ministɛɛrã taoor rãmb reeg n kõ Ekoallã karen-saam-dãmb ne b karen-biisi, la b yãk n pʋɩ zãma wã sẽn da be zĩigẽ wã.  M kota Wẽnd tɩ b yãag neb nins fãa sẽn tʋmd buudã goam kaoreng la a gʋlsg na kẽngrã, tɩ b tõog n tʋm n pidis tẽngã taoor rãmb yam yãkrã.

Wao fugdg kiuug rasem pisi la a naanse yuum tuusa yiibu la pisi la a nu soaba pugei, ministeer ning sein get karen bi baoonesa la buuda goam na keing taoor tuum noor ning sein tumd buuda goam na piuuga yaka Waogdg Samandei, “BCD’ Ekoall a ye ub sein yak on zamsd kamba buuda gaom kaorengo, la a gulsgo, ne nasaara wa goam kaoreng ziiga, on ti yaas on kon sore,  ti ub na on maan nin sabls teinsei buuda goam ra yopoende. Rasem a yopoe wa pugei, yaa tonnd sein dog ne goam ninsa la ub na on zind ne taab on ges ub sein tone on ganeg soay nins on toong  t’a yi yidgra la taoora keind zab teoogo, nin buiida faa yinga. B singa buuda ra yopoenda arzuma wao fugdg kiuug rasem pisi la a yembre on na on tall a on ti taag kiuuga rasem pisi la a yoobe.

 Burkina Faso ramb yaka gom zu kanga: Buuda goam kaoreng la a gulsg na keing taoor yinga, bi ned faa keies a meng t’a yi sabaab on pak tilgr la yidgr sor on kon nin buiida faa. La sa on ya ne Reezon di santra, bamb tika : Buuda goam kaoreng na keing taoore: A yoond paoongo, la a alkaol rikr ne nin buiida yidgr yinga.

Bumb nins sein wa ne koe zuta yakre, ub wilgame ti buuda goam kaoreng gulsg singr zarame. A yaa sabaab ti neb keier tar a on tumd nafd ub mense, ti rei zoe on wilgdei t’a yoonda waoogame. La ub sa on leb on na on ges yiiga, ub mikdame t’a karemdba soonr ka waoog ye. Rei faa wilgda veienega, ti buuda goam  kaoeng bangr kom la ko yuud ket on tara nin buiida. Neb sein namsd a pugei yaa kom biiba. Burkina Faso kamb soonr na ta pisopoe la a zak on ket ub ka mi ub buuda goam kaoreng la gulsg ye.

La ub gesame on mik ti Farenda goam kaoreng la a gulsg me singr zarame. La ba ne rei faa nin buiida ket on ka tone on yidg ub mens ye.

B ka tone on yidg ub mensa yagre, yaa Farenda sein ka ub buuda goama. Yaa rei la ub yak rasem a yopoe tonre, on na on zind on tags buuda goam kaoreng la a gulsg zugu, on bao yam on pui taab ti zu loeega ya tiim. Sein sigl b ra poenda ramb wilgame ti buuda goam kaoreng sonngda biig t’a yam weke. A leb on sonngda ned t’a ket on tar waoor ning a sein dog on mik ti neba waoogd taab toto wa.

A Hawa Sawadgo, miniisra sein yak ned ning t’a be Ministeerei wa on get buuda goama wilgame ti buuda goam kaoreng sonngda ned buud faa t’a mi ned sein yiid a la a waoogd a. Teiegre, yaa yuum tuusri la kobs wai la pisyoobe la a yembre la ub sing a, on da dikd a on keiesd Ekoallsei wa, la a ka zaag ziig ye. Sein leb on wa ta yuum tuusri la kobs wai la pisyopoe la a wai, ub leb on waa ne a, yei ka zaag ziig ye.

Rei faa wilgdame ti buuda goam kaoreng la a gulsgo, ub ra ka rik a on luiis taoor boto ye. Ti bala, nasaara wa belga nin buiida on yak baensa a sein da sog ub nusa la ub nao wa, on leb on kei ub zutei wa on soge. Rei kitame ti ub ra yetei ti yaa nasaara wa buud gomd bal on tone on sonng b ti ub yidgi. La Kapitend Yibrayiim TARWOOR ne gosneer yaka yam on dik a on luiis taoore, t’a be teinga tein kugr pugei. Rei yaa paoong ne burkin buuda faa.

Burkina Faso ramb kidemda buuda goam ra kaseng ub sein boond ti nin sabls teinsei buud goam ra yopoende. Nin sabls teinsa zang yaka gom zu kanga: Nin sabls teins buud goam sein na on sonng ti neba paam yeisg ne taaba, la lagem n taar ne taaba, ti tonnd toong on me Afrik ning tonnd sein data.

Waogdg soolma komber tuma ned t’a wa ub yuur yinga. Koeesa rikr pugei, nin kang soaba wilgame ti ra kasen kanga tulsem yaa nin sabls teinsa zaadb na naag taab noor a ye suur a ye, ti ub kamba paam buuda goam kaoreng la a gulsgo, on lebg on bang ub yaab ramba soalma, ub siilse, ub kibaya, la ub yel bun ganegre. Yaa neb ka tek on zind ziigei on dik koees buud toor toore. Ekoalla karen biis maana reem la Tayatr sein tar seem ti nin buiida naag taab on gese. Zugnall Raamd taoor soaba karma Ekoall Samandei. Sein na yil ti kamb nins sein ledg bamb ziiga toong on paam buuda goam on yaag ub mense,   a Raamd taoor soaba a Yirene TẼEDRBEOOG kisa Zugnall Raamde la kaoreng sebr sein boond ti “Nonglem yaa baaga”, ti ministeera taoor ramb reeg on kon Ekoalla karen saam damb ne ub karen biisi, la ub yak on pui zama wa sein da be ziigei wa.  M kota Weind ti ub yaag neb nins faa sein tumd buuda goam kaoreng la a gulsg na keingra, ti ub toong on tum on pidis teinga taoor ramb yam yakra.

Nasẽozĩni tʋʋm-noorã bee Burkĩna Faso 1966 yʋʋmdã. Zĩ-likr kiuug rasem 24 yʋʋm 2024 soabã, b sega kiba-kɩtbã Nasẽozini tʋʋm-noorã ro-kaseng sẽn be Waogdgã. Sɛkã võore, yaa sẽn na n wilg-b zems-n-taar na-kẽndr b sẽn gãneg n na n tʋm ne Burkĩna Faso.

Madam Karoll Foloor Semerzeniyak sẽn ya Nasẽnzĩni tʋʋm-noorã taoor soab wilgame tɩ yaa sula 33 n naag taaba, la bãmb pissi la a nu wã  tʋmda nin-buiidã vʋɩɩm sõmblem paasg wɛɛngẽ.

A togsame tɩ tʋʋm-noorã bee Burkĩna Faso n yãagd gofneerã, a maoorã buud fãa pʋgẽ, sẽn na yɩl t’a tʋm tɩ nin-buiidã vʋɩɩm yolse. Tʋʋm-noorã yãagda gofneer kaorengã wɛɛngẽ, yõ-koglgã wɛɛngẽ, rɩɩb wɛɛngẽ, la zu-loees a taab wala fu-gobse, la pĩ-gãase. Burkĩna Faso wen-vɩɩs a naasã pʋgẽ, b tara no-rɛɛsdba. A wilgame tɩ raab sẽn wa n be babg ning fãa, bãmb sõndame tɩ zu-loɛɛgã paam welgre. B sõngda kom-bɩɩbã la pagbã, b  vʋɩɩmã manegr wɛɛngẽ. 

Yʋʋm 2023 n na n tãag yʋʋm 2025 b gãnega tʋʋma, n na n yãag gofneem tẽngã zãab pʋgẽ, la b sõng-b tɩ zab ne yõ-koglg kaalmã, tɩ nin-buiidã paam laafɩ, la b paam bũmb nins fãa sẽn segd ne-ba.

Yʋʋm 2023 Nasẽozini sõnga tẽngã zãad-b ne Milyaar 445, sẽn na yɩl tɩ b tõog n manes bũmb nins fãa, b sẽn dat n mange. B leb n yẽsda ne gofneem tɩ b mao tɩ ninsaal yalẽ wã paam waoogre. Madam Karoll Foloor Semerzeniyak togsame tɩ Nasẽozĩni tigs-kaseng naoor 79 sẽn loogã, a wilga sullã taoor rãmb tɩ b ges n yols yalã tɩ Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidã vʋɩɩm maneg n paase.

A wilgame tɩ Nasẽozini rãmb sakame n na n yãag Burkĩna Faso tẽngã zãadba, b sẽn be maoor ningã pʋgẽ. Sõasgã kell n yɩɩ tʋʋma b sẽn tʋm tɩ looge, la b sẽn gãneg tʋʋma n na n tʋm la b rɩk n taas kiba-kɩtbã.  Sẽn kẽed ne a Barbara Manzi nengẽ wã, Madam Karoll Foloor Semerzeniyak togsame tɩ “zaamẽ saag looga ne a waoodo”. Yẽnda waame n na n tʋm tẽngã zãad-b sẽn dat tɩ b tʋm ne taab toto wã.

Naaba a Saag me sẽn zĩnd kadensã miniisr yʋʋr yĩngã pẽgame, la b kell n kos nebã tɩ b bas welgre, sũ-kiiri,  la beem buud toor-toore, la b gãd taab nusi, tɩ ba-yirã bɛ yaa nin-yende. B kell n bẽda tigsgã pʋg n wilg b su-sãams ne yel-beed ning sẽn zĩnd Barsaolg tɩ neb ka tɛk maan kaalmã.

Yaa rẽ tɩ  tẽns a tãabã miniisr dãmb  gʋls sebr n kõ a Mikayɛl Yimrand KANU, Sɩɩraleyond tẽngã no-rɛɛsa, tɩ bala, bãmb tẽngã bee Nasẽozini sullã pʋg n get tẽng na gãand bãanã.

Sebrã pʋgẽ miniisr dãmbã kosa Nasẽozini rãmb tɩ b rɩk na-kẽndr Yɩkrɛnd sẽn yãk yam n yãagd nin-wẽnsã ãnduni wã, sẽn yɩɩd fãa Sayɛllã soolmẽ. Yɩkrɛnd sẽn sõng nin-wẽnsã yɩɩ sabaab tɩ Mali ne Nizɛɛr yals zoodã ne-b sa-sik kiuug rasem a 4 ne a rasma a 6 yʋʋm 2024 soabã.

Tigrã ba-yãkdg a Patrik KƲRAOOG wilgame tɩ Kolɛktifã reem tara seem wʋsgo, la segdame tɩ ned sẽn ya Buls biig n nong  ba-yirã, n ya burkĩna, bɩ a yãag-ba. Yaa rẽ n kɩt t’a zẽk a naoor n zĩnd sʋka. A pẽga reemã wʋsgo. A wilgame tɩ tẽnsã yidg yãgr yaa tõnd rog-n-mikã. A taoor kẽnd me sɩngda ne tõnd kʋdemdã la rog-n-mikã. Rẽ wã, a sũur yaa noogo, ne yɩɩlã sẽn boond nin-buiidã tɩ b zems-taabã. Dogtɛɛr KƲRAOOG wilgame tɩ nan yaa sɩngre, la b sẽn wa n dat-a wakat ning fãa bɩ b bool-a, t’a me sẽn tar yam bɩ tõog ninga, a rɩkdame n yãag-ba.

Namendtẽng reem-rɛɛmdbã lagem-n-taar sull taoor soab a DAMIBA Lasãne tɩ b boond t’a Balak wilgame t’a Sɩdnooma Yisɛka KABOOR gesame tɩ yõ-koglg kaalmã sẽn kẽ Namendtẽng tɩ nin-buiidã tagsg ka le teesd taab zãngã a lebsda tẽngã poorẽ. Rẽnd ra segdẽ lame t’a tik Namend kamb nins sẽn be reemã pʋgẽ wã n sõng-b tɩ b yɩɩl n gom sugr goama, la nin-buiidã zems-taab n vʋɩɩmde, t’a yaa ba-yirã yidgr yãgre.

Yaa wa moos sẽn maan b kibare : « sã n moe sagb n kõ a kom-n-da-tar-ma, yaa yaas n wʋk teedo ». Raarã sẽn yãke, nin-buiidã wʋsg yĩns ra kɩrdame, tɩ b gũud-a. Sig-noy kiuug rasem 15 yʋʋm 2024 yibeoog wakat a yoobe, Waogdg nin-buiidã ra yõsda taaba, n kẽnd Pãngẽ, n na n tɩ paam n ges Pãngsoab yiisgã. Yibeoog wakat a yoobe, rẽ tɩ d yasa Pãng soab rago-nengã “Rap noore”. Kiba-kɩtbã ned fãa ra kʋmsda masĩn t’a yõg foto rãmb la filme. D sẽn tar kʋmsgo, d wa n wʋmame : « foto ka yõkd ka ye. Filing ka filimd ka ye ».

Wakat a yoobã sẽn wa n ta, sõgen-kamb ra yasa goabg la rɩtgo, n maneg b sẽgene, n da yas wa pagba. Wakat a yoob sẽn wa n loog minit 45 sasa, d wʋmdame:” Pãngsoab yiime! Naab a Bãoog yiime”. D sẽn zẽk d neng n gese, d mikame tɩ b ninga te-peelse, n fũgun b Maanfo, n dɩk b Fublg n palg b bãoko, tɩ d ket n yas n tar gesgo. B sẽn zĩnd n sa, Kamsãoognaab sẽn ya na-pagã bãmb n lʋɩ taoore, tɩ Wiidnaab ne b poor n dãmb yika ne b sʋ-wogdo, tong taaba, n kẽnda. B sẽn wa n kolge, b tek n zĩndame n ning kãn-tɩ-wogdo. Kãn-tɩ-wogdã yaa kãn-tɩɩsã n mamsda tẽnga, n vẽsd nusã. Kãn-tɩɩg fãa yaa ne a goama. Pipi soabã sʋkda Pãng ne b zak rãmb laafɩ. Rẽ Pãngsoab yʋʋmbã ra bee Bɩnda zãndẽ. Bãmb sẽn wa n looge, Pãngsoab yʋʋmbã ninga fut sẽn wẽnd gãense, n kẽng n kolg n bilfu, tɩ yaas n tolg Pãngsoaba, n wẽedẽ. B sẽn wa n wẽ n sa, b sulgame n tẽeg b nusã n maan wa b na n tik tẽnga. Bãmb me kãngã ning la b sẽn maanã. Bãmb sẽn lebg n leb b zãndẽ, Kamsãoognaab ne Wiidnaab rãmb sullã le yikame n kẽng b sẽn da tek zĩig ningã n leb n ning kãnga. Kãn-tɩ-kãng soabã, b rɩka b kãn-tɩɩsã n tik tẽnga, n yaool n zẽk nusã n wat tʋbã baobgo. Bãmb sẽn pʋʋs n lebg n wat b zĩigẽ, b poorẽ dãmb me yikame n babs-b n tɩ ningd kãnga, tɩ Pãngsoab yik n kẽedẽ.B sẽn kẽ n sa, zamã kaoogame n leb b sẽn deegd sãambã zĩigẽ. Pãngsoab kẽemẽ n tɩ yi Ragno-bɛɛgẽ “Pagb noore”. D sẽn gilg n ta, d mikame tɩ neb yas ne wed-moose, n deemdẽ. Pãng soab wa n yii be, tɩ d kolg tɩ d na n yõg foto rãmb la d filim, tɩ b le gɩdge. La kiba-kɩtb kẽer ra paam n sɩngame. Wakat a yopoe sẽn wa n ta n loog minit 27 sasa Pãngsoab kẽeme n tɩ yi Ragno-bɛɛgẽ n zomb zaooga. Tɩ d yet tɩ d na n kolge, d wʋmda b sẽn yeta:” sã n ka kiba-kɩta, ned ka kẽngd be ye. Sẽn ka-a kiba-kɩt raw a kẽng n bao a yãnd ye”. Rẽ poore, b kɩsa Kaadyoognaaba, la Bagnaaba. Rũmsã fãa kõbg fãa ya a yembre. Kosgã me yaa kos-yɛngã. Rẽ poore, d lebgame n kẽng zĩig ning b yãk n na n sõse, n wilg nin-buudã rog-n-mikã rãmb tẽebo, b yaab rãmb sɩnge, la b Wẽnd minim sẽn ya a soaba.Wakat piig sẽn wa n looge, pʋg-tãp n deng n wa n na n sɛgl n deeg Pãngsoab ne kilsgu, la nu-pogse. Pãngsoab kom-dibli, wã wa n ning-b-la kãnga, n wilg naam sẽn waoogd toto. Rẽ poore, b kom-pugli wã me wa n ning-b-la kãnga, n wilg pag sẽn ningd kãng toto. Bãmb poore, Pãngsoab yagensã wa n ninga kãnga.Koɛɛgã rɩkr wakate, yaa Wiidnaab n dɩk koɛɛg Pãngsoab yʋʋr yĩnga. Wiidnaab wilgame tɩ Pãngsoab yeelame tɩ Pãngsoab pẽga Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm Tarwoore ne a gosneema. B maana Pẽgr kaset sebr n na n kõ Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm Tarwoore. La b wilgame tɩ sũ-noogã yaa wʋsgo, ra segdẽ la ne kɩdengo, la tẽngã nu-gãag sẽn ya a soabã b kotame tɩ nin-buiidã kɩdem n zemse. Gosneer tʋma Waogdg Komberã “Guvɛgneerã” t’a wa b yʋʋr yĩnga. Yẽ me rɩka koeese, la b fãa koeesã yaa sũ-noogo, raarã b sẽn tõog n yãk-a tɩ b maand-a wã. Rẽ poore, Waogdg Gʋng Bɩnnaab rɩka koɛɛg n wegs kʋdemd la rog-n-mik n wilg nebã. Koeesã sẽn wa n kolg weoogo, a Naana bɩbɛɛt tɩ b boond t’a Bibɛɛtkoɛɛg wa n deeme, yʋʋmbã reemame. Wakat piig la a ye sẽn wa n looge, Pãngsoab yik n kẽeme tɩ sãambã yaa wʋsgo. Rẽ poore, Saonaab a Kãoong wilgame tɩ masã yaa bãng-bɛd sẽn karem n vaees sɛb n lebgdba, bãmb n na n wegs kʋdemdã la rog-n-mikã n wilg nebã. Yaa Miniisr kʋdr a Albɛɛr WEDRAOOGO, Dogtɛɛr Vẽesã SEDGO, la Wiidnaaba. Sõasgã sɩnga ne maand sɩngre, kʋdemde… Sõasgã wa n tɩ baasa ne sʋgsgo, la leoobo.Nebã fãa sẽn zĩnd zĩigẽ wã b sũur yɩɩ noogo, tɩ b kotẽ Wẽnd la yaab rãmb yãag-b tɩ b maan a taab yaka. D sẽn wa n sa, Pãngsoab bool-d-la zakẽ n yiis rɩɩb b sẽn segl bãmb meng zakã pʋga, tɩ d rɩ. Rɩɩbã poore, b yeelame tɩ kiba-kɩtbã sẽn wa n yã zĩig ning sẽn ka zems bɩ b togse, tɩ yʋʋmd sẽn wat bɩ b manes tɩ zemse. Kiba-kɩtbã pẽgame la b wilg tɩ fãa zemsame. B kota Wẽnd ne ba-rãmba, la yaab rãmb tɩ b kell n yãag-ba, tɩ b maandẽ-a wakat fãa ne laafɩ la sũ-noogo. D wa n sãeega taab zaabr wakat a nu sasa. Wẽnd na kell n kɩt tɩ d maan a taab yaka, n maan n bãge.A Pẽgdwẽnde Erik Zĩnaaba

Gosneer sẽn zĩnd ub rasem a yopoe poe sekã ; ub wilgame ti ub yãka sig noy kiuug rasem piig la a nu, yuumd fãa ti na on lebg kudemdã la rog n mikã raare. Raarã ka tumd ye, la ub yaoodame. Raarã sẽn yãke, nin buiidã wusg yĩns ra kirdame, ti ub gũud a. Sig noy kiuug rasem piig la a nu yuum tuusa yiibu la pisi la a naanse yibeoog wakat a yoobe, Waogdg nin buiidã ra yõsda taaba, on kẽnd Pãngẽ, on na on ti paam on ges Pãngsoab yiisgã. Yibeoog wakat a yoobe, rẽ ti d yasa Pãng soab rago nengã “Rap noore”. Kiba kitbã ned fãa ra kumsda masĩn t’a yõg foto rãmb la filme. D sẽn tar kumsgo, d wa on wumame : « foto ka yõkd ka ye. Filing ka filimd ka ye ».

Wakat a yoobã sẽn wa on ta, sõgen kamb ra yasa goabg la ritgo, on maneg ub sẽgene, on da yas wa pagba. Wakat a yoob sẽn wa on loog minit pisnaanse la a nu sasa, d wumdame:” Pãngsoab yiime! Naab a Bãoog yiime”. D sẽn zẽk d neng on gese, d mikame ti ub ninga te peelse, on fũgun ub Maanfo, on dik ub Fublg on palg ub bãoko, ti d ket on yas on tar gesgo. B sẽn zĩnd on sa, Kamsãoognaab sẽn ya na pagã bãmb on lui taoore, ti Wiidnaab ne ub poor on dãmb yika ne ub su wogdo, tong taaba, on kẽnda. B sẽn wa on kolge, ub tek on zĩndame on ning kãn ti wogdo. Kãn ti wogdã yaa kãn tiisã on mamsda tẽnga, on vẽsd nusã. Kãn tiig fãa yaa ne a goama. Pipi soabã sukda Pãng ne ub zak rãmb laafi. Sẽm mi bã tara sugsg woto on ti tãag Pãngsoab ne ub na yir deemba, ub kag zĩidba…Bãmb sẽn yik on lebd ub kugẽ, yarsã tonga taab ne Murf fubli, ti Kamsãoognaab le lui taoore, on yãag b ti ub kẽng on ti ning kãnga, la ub yãkd doose, on wobgdẽ ti Pãngsoab me wobgd ub nenga. Rẽ Pãngsoab yuumbã ra bee Binda zãndẽ. Bãmb sẽn wa on looge, Pãngsoab yuumbã ninga fut sẽn wẽnd gãense, on kẽng on kolg on bilfu, ti yaas on tolg Pãngsoaba, on wẽedẽ. B sẽn wa on wẽ on sa, ub sulgame on tẽeg ub nusã on maan wa ub na on tik tẽnga. Bãmb me kãngã ning la ub sẽn maanã. Bãmb sẽn lebg on leb ub zãndẽ, Kamsãoognaab ne Wiidnaab rãmb sullã le yikame on kẽng ub sẽn da tek zĩig ningã on leb on ning kãnga. Kãn ti kãng soabã, ub rika ub kãn tiisã on tik tẽnga, on yaool on zẽk nusã on wat tubã baobgo. Bãmb sẽn puus on lebg on wat ub zĩigẽ, ub poorẽ dãmb me yikame on babs b on ti ningd kãnga, ti Pãngsoab yik on kẽedẽ.B sẽn kẽ on sa, zamã kaoogame on leb ub sẽn deegd sãambã zĩigẽ. Pãngsoab kẽemẽ on ti yi Ragno beegẽ “Pagb noore”. D sẽn gilg on ta, d mikame ti neb yas ne wed moose, on deemdẽ. Pãng soab wa on yii be, ti d kolg ti d na on yõg foto rãmb la d filim, ti ub le gidge. La kiba kitb kẽer ra paam on singame. Wakat a yopoe sẽn wa on ta on loog minit pisi la a yopoe sasa Pãngsoab kẽeme on ti yi Ragno beegẽ on zomb zaooga. Ti d yet ti d na on kolge, d wumda ub sẽn yeta:” sã on ka kiba kita, ned ka kẽngd be ye. Sẽn ka a kiba kit raw a kẽng on bao a yãnd ye”. Tõnd a kiba kitbã yẽ yõsgame on ta.B yiisa no ra peel a tãabo, la pe ra peelle, ti Pãngsoab rik ub nug on siis pesgã on kis Waogdgnaaba, ti ub ku on bõos ti gãand bãane, la ub bõos sa ko sõngo, la ub kos yaab rãmb ti nebã ko ne laafi. Rẽ poore, ub kisa Kaadyoognaaba, la Bagnaaba. Rũmsã fãa kõbg fãa ya a yembre. Kosgã me yaa kos yengã. Rẽ poore, d lebgame on kẽng zĩig ning ub yãk on na on sõse, on wilg nin buudã rog n mikã rãmb tẽebo, ub yaab rãmb singe, la ub Wẽnd minim sẽn ya a soaba.Wakat piig sẽn wa on looge, pug tãp on deng on wa on na on segl on deeg Pãngsoab ne kilsgu, la nu pogse. Pãngsoab sẽn wa on watẽ pug tãpã yãkda ub fut on tiuudẽ ti tabg naam tabgre, on gengd naam gengre. Sẽn da be b pugẽ wã yika yĩngri. Pãngsoab sẽn wa on kẽ, ub kõo noor ti ub zĩndi. Koeesã ray a ub modg on wub kambã wa Pãngsoab sẽn yet wakat fãa on ka basdẽ wã. “Yamsem ka be korgẽ ti ub mak on wilg ye. Pãngsoab kom dibli, wã wa on ning b la kãnga, on wilg naam sẽn waoogd toto. Rẽ poore, ub kom pugli wã me wa on ning b la kãnga, on wilg pag sẽn ningd kãng toto. Wiidnaab wilgame ti Pãngsoab yeelame ti Pãngsoab pẽga Kapitend Yibrayiim Tarwoore ne a gosneema. B maana Pẽgr kaset sebr on na on kõ Kapitend Yibrayiim Tarwoore. La ub wilgame ti sũ noogã yaa wusgo, ra segdẽ la ne kidengo, la tẽngã nu gãag sẽn ya a soabã ub kotame ti nin buiidã kidem on zemse. Gosneer tuma Waogdg Komberã “Guvegneerã” t’a wa ub yuur yĩnga. Yẽ me rika koeese, la ub fãa koeesã yaa sũ noogo, raarã ub sẽn tõog on yãk a ti ub maand a wã. Rẽ poore, Waogdg Gung Binnaab rika koeeg on wegs kudemd la rog n mik on wilg nebã. Koeesã sẽn wa on kolg weoogo, a Naana bibeet ti ub boond t’a Bibeetkoeeg wa on deeme, yuumbã reemame. Wakat piig la a ye sẽn wa on looge, Pãngsoab yik on kẽeme ti sãambã yaa wusgo. Rẽ poore, Saonaab a Kãoong wilgame ti masã yaa bãng bed sẽn karem on vaees seb on lebgdba, bãmb on na on wegs kudemdã la rog n mikã on wilg nebã. Yaa Miniisr kudr a Albeer WEDRAOOGO, Dogteer Vẽesã SEDGO, la Wiidnaaba. Sõasgã singa ne maand singre, kudemde… Sõasgã wa on ti baasa ne sugsgo, la leoobo.Nebã fãa sẽn zĩnd zĩigẽ wã ub sũur yii noogo, ti ub kotẽ Wẽnd la yaab rãmb yãag b ti ub maan a taab yaka. D sẽn wa on sa, Pãngsoab bool d la zakẽ on yiis riib ub sẽn segl bãmb meng zakã puga, ti d ri. Riibã poore, ub yeelame ti kiba kitbã sẽn wa on yã zĩig ning sẽn ka zems bi ub togse, ti yuumd sẽn wat bi ub manes ti zemse. Kiba kitbã pẽgame la ub wilg ti fãa zemsame. B kota Wẽnd ne ba rãmba, la yaab rãmb ti ub kell on yãag ba, ti ub maandẽ a wakat fãa ne laafi la sũ noogo. D wa on sãeega taab zaabr wakat a nu sasa. Sull ning sẽn get kibayã remsg sega kibayã kũun rot taoor dãmb sig-noy kiuug rasem 13 yʋʋm 2024 soabã. Seg-taabã pʋgẽ b wilga kibayã kũun rot taoor rãmba, b sẽn segd n dɩk na-kẽnda nins tɩ lẽmpo ra wa pag b tʋʋm-noyã, la soay nins b sẽn tõe n dɩk tɩ b tʋʋm-noyã kẽng taoore.

SƐSSE” CSC”taoor dãmbã wilgame tɩ sɛkã, yaa sẽn na yɩl n sagl kibayã kũun tʋʋm-noy taoor dãmba, lẽmpo wã yaoob wɛɛngẽ. B meng wilgame tɩ kibayã kũun rot ka tar ligd sẽn sekd b na yao b tʋm-tʋmdbã wa sẽn segd ye.

 A Yɩsmayall WEDRAOOGO, sẽn televizẽo rãmb nins sẽn so b mensã sull taoor soab togsame tɩ bãmb ra gũuda seg-taabã, tɩ bala, b paame n na n sogs-sogsg buud toor-toore, sẽn kẽed ne kibayã kũun rot vʋɩɩm wɛɛngẽ.

Rẽ poore, a Yidriisa WEDRAOOGO SƐSSE « CSC » taoor soabã  kosa kibayã kũun rot taoor dãmb tɩ b maan b pãng sẽn tõe sẽn, tɩ lẽmpo rãmbã, ƐSBETE « SBT », bɩ BEBEDEYA « BBDA » ra pag b tʋʋm-noyã ye. A togsame tɩ bãmb sega ministɛɛr ning sẽn get arzɛkã taoor dãmb n wilg zu-loees nins sẽn be kibayã kũun rot pʋsẽ. Seg-taabã poore, ministɛɛrã wilgame tɩ bãmb ka pagd tʋʋm-noor zĩig pʋgẽ ye. Sã n wa sek tɩ b na n pag tʋʋm-noore, mikame tɩ bãmb sẽn gãneg na-kẽnda nins ne tʋʋm-noorã ka paam tũubu.

Yaa rẽ tɩ SƐSSE « CSC » taoor soabã kos kibayã kũun rot taoor dãmb tɩ b maan modgre, n tõog n tũ na-kẽnda nins lẽmpo wã rãmb sẽn gãneg ne-ba.

Kibayã kũun rot taoor dãmb sõdga zu-loees buud toor-toor sẽn kɩt tɩ tʋʋm-noyã ka kẽndã. Pipi, b wilgame tɩ tʋʋma ka le kẽnd sõma ye, sẽn paasde, gosneerã tʋʋm-noy la tʋʋm-noy kẽer tara kibayã kũun rot sam n ka yaood ye, rẽ kɩtame tɩ ligdã ka kẽedẽ ye.

SƐSSE « CSC » taoor soabã togsame tɩ tʋʋm-noyã taoor dãmb segd n dɩka na-kẽnda n bao ligd zĩis a taab n paam n kẽes b tʋʋmdã pʋgẽ.

Zĩ-kãnga, kiba-kɩtbã tʋʋm-noy  taoor dãmb kosa SƐSSE « CSC » tɩ b yẽs ne ministɛɛr ning sẽn get arzɛkã t’a maan modgre, n yao kibayã kũun rot taoor dãmb sama.

Tẽegre, tʋʋl-nif kiuug rasem 24 yʋʋm 2024 soabã, lẽmpo wã rãmb ra tɩ paga « Radiyo Savand ɛf ɛm » tɩ b tara samde. Yaa sẽn na yɩl tɩ zu-loe-kãng buud ra le yɩlem la SƐSSE “CSC” rãmb seg kiba-kɩtbã taoordãmbã.

Tuul nif kiuug rasem pisi la a yoobe yuum tuusa yiibu la pisi la a naanse soaba, ub na on talla sonasga. Sonasga pugei, ub na on togsa soay nins ub sein tone on tu, ti ba teinga sein ka gae baana, bi ub toong on naf sunda fut tuum puge. Sein pugde, sun wugdba taoor damb sein be Burkina Faso reezon ramba faa pusa na on sega taab on ges ub tuuma zu loeese, la ub bao a  yidgra sein tone on tu sor ninga.

 Baasga na on yii tigr ub sein boond ti « dine gala » wa la ub na on maane, ti boond ti Faso danfani yungo. Badaar na on yii reem buud toor toore, la “defile” la ub na on maan ne sunda futu. Neb me la ub na on yak ti ub yi sunda fut wugdb no reesdba, la ub kell on kon neb keier waoor kuuni.

Tuumda baoosgei ub koon sor ti raaga pak a kuilense, ti ned faa tone on keing on ti ra fut nins sun wugdba nus sein tume.

A Zill KAFAANDO

Jules KAFANDO

Tʋʋl-nif kiuug rasem a 4 yʋʋm 2024 soabã, miniisr dãmbã maana b rasem a yopoe-poe tigsgã. Yaa tẽngã taoor soaba, kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWORE n lʋɩ seg taabã taoore. Sɛkã loogr poore, gosneem no-rɛɛs wilga noy kẽer b sẽn dɩke.

Yaa rẽ n kɩt tɩ Fada Yinivɛrsite wã lebga Yinivɛrsite Yembila Abdulae TOGYENI. Wayugy Yinivɛrsite wã lebga Yinivɛrsite Ledeya Bɛgnaar WEDRAOOGO.  Dedugu Inivɛrsite wã lebga Yinivɛrsite Dãnyall Wenzẽ KULBALI.

Ministɛɛr ning sẽn get Burkĩna Faso ne zamaan-zẽns zoodã zĩigẽ, gosneem rɩka noor tɩ b zĩnig sull t’a tigimd  Burkĩna Faso kamb sẽn be zamaan-zẽnsã. Miniisr Karamoko Zãnmaari TARWORE wilgame tɩ sull n da be n tigimd-ba, la b mikame tɩ sullã tara zu-loeese. Yaa rẽ n kɩt tɩ b yãk yam n zĩnig sull sẽn tar pãng n yɩɩd pipi soabã t’a na n ges rẽ yelle. Sullã na n sõngame tɩ Burkĩna Faso kamb sẽn be zamaan-zẽnsã kẽesd b toog tẽngã taoor kẽnd pʋgẽ, la b kell n bẽd n pʋɩt taab b zu-loees sẽn mi n be.

Ministɛɛr ning sẽn get arzɛkã la moeendã zĩigẽ, noy a yiib la b rɩk yã. Pipi noorã gomda ministɛɛrã la tʋʋm-no-bedr fãa sẽn segd n sigl ligd tʋʋm-noore. A yiib n soabã ya a na sõng arzɛkã ministɛɛr t’a tõog n paam ligd bilf tʋʋm-paalg ning b sẽn zĩnig tɩ get tʋmtʋmdbã kiuug yaoob sɛb b sẽn boond tɩ ” E biletẽ”wã. B wilgame tɩ sẽn sɩng ne masã, tʋmtʋmd sã n menes a yaoob sebr n lebg n dat tɩ b  maan n kõ-a, a segd n yao wakɩr 200 sã n mik tɩ yaa yʋʋmdã pʋgẽ. La sã n loog yʋʋmde,  a yaooda wakɩr 300. Miniisr NAKANABO wilgame tɩ b sã n dat tʋʋm-noor ning b sẽn boond tɩ ” E biletẽ ” wã n maan loogom wal Bãnk rãmbã n date, b segd n yaoome.

Meesã sɩngrẽ, Waogdg tigung roogã ba, Moseyẽer Porspɛɛr KÕNTIYEBO pʋʋsa Burkĩna Faso evɛkr rãmbã, pɛrɛtr dãmbã, la tẽns a taab perɛtr sẽn zẽk b naoor n wa naag masɛɛr dãmbã tɩ b maan yʋʋm koabgã bark pʋʋsgo. Kapitend Yibrayiim Tarwar  wilg b lame ti kiis piig la a nu wa puga, bamb sein wa naamei wa teka, toeeng zinda gosneer tuum noya pusei, la teinga koglg weengei. Yuum paalla sein dikda, segdame ti ub rik na keind paal tuum noya la teinga yinga.

B togsa tum tumdba ti ronanda, taraziseio wa taoor ramb na on puk ub nin on zab ne weigba, la wat tuuma on vaandei bi ka wat pinda, t’a saamda goosneer tuuma. B togsame ti zabra ne nin weinsa keinda taoore, la ziis wusgo, tekra nan ka tolg on be fasi ye. Yaa rei ti ub rik na keindre,  on keoog tum tumdba sein na  yil ti ub wume, la ub zaag ub mens ne weigba, nin zaals tuumei la sodaara ziigei.

Kapitenda wilgame ti yuum tuusa yiibu la pisi la a naanse soaba zab be weigba la wat tuuma on keossdei bi tolg on ka watei wa.

B wilgame t’a sibgra na on yi veienega, bala, ub zoe on sagla nin buiida ti ub mi tiiri, rei wa sugr ka na on zind yaas ye. Ned kam faa segd on tuma tuum ning ub sein puus a t’a tuma. La buka neb wusg yimda ub tuuma wa, on bas on tumd ub sein date. Ya arei ti ub sa on bas b tuuma ti ub ka tumd on kont teinga, bi neb keier on yik on yiisd noy ziisa faa on wilgdei ti ka segd ye. Zi kanga Kapitenda wilgame ti noor ba a ye ka tone on yi ziig a to on wa kei bamb sein ganeg na keindr ning gosneer tuum noya pusei wa ye.

Taraziseio wa taoor soab wilgame ti gosneera tumtumd keier  tara ub toorei tuum noya. B ministeera bi ub sein tumd ziig ninga pugei, gosneem daasa sa on wa, bi gondgd on kont ub mense, ti yaa bamb tuum noora on paame.  B wilgame ti rei faa yaa weigbo, la a segd on saame. Yaa rei ti ub kos ti gosneer tuum noya faa pusei ub zinig sull ti tumtumd sa on wa tum ti ka zemse bi ub bool a on deieg nugu, wall ub tolg on bas a tuuma.

Kapitend Yibrayiim leb on wilgame ti kooba, guulga, la tuum a taab sein na sonng ti riiba seka, yaa taraziseio wa maoore, sein yil ti neb nins sein be naong pugei wa me toong on paam on yidgi.

Yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem a 6 yʋʋm 2024 soabã, gosneer miniisr dãmb kẽer kẽnga Bagre, n tɩ wʋr b mui.

Miniisr ning sẽn get wen-vɩʋʋgã koglg wilgame tɩ Bagre pagbã sõng-b-la b tʋʋmdã pʋgẽ. Yaa zĩig yalem sẽn ta Ɛgtaar 1 la pʋsʋk la b rɩk n ko. Yaa mui buud toor-toor a tãab la b bʋd yã. Mui buudã, yaa mui ning b sẽn boond tɩ REMAR 13, Bitõkini, la Neemakosi 1. Miniisrã wilgame tɩ tũu ne karen-bi-bɛd sẽn yit ANVARE vaeesg sull a yembr sõngre. A togsame tɩ tʋʋmdã yaa karen-biisã n pʋg n gese.

A Moyiis KOGO sẽn pʋg n ges tʋʋmdã wilgame tɩ mui buud ning b sẽn boond tɩ Neema wã tõee mui bãasã. La Bitõkini wã, ka zoet war ye. Mui buud fãa woma toand a 7 n tar n dɛbd toand piiga. Mui buud nins b sẽn ko wã yaa kiuug a tãab mui. Rat n yeel tɩ rasem 118 n tar dɛbd rasem 120.

Miniisrã pẽga karen-bi-bɛdã, la neb nins sẽn ges tʋʋmdã, miniisrã a sẽn sak n lʋɩ tʋʋmdã taoorã.

A wilgame tɩ koobã yaa tẽngã taoor soab sẽn yãk yam n dat tɩ rɩɩbã sek nin-buiidã n kɩt tɩ miniisr dãmbã tuk pʋto.

Miniisr ning sẽn get Karen-bi-bɛdã la bãngra baoob a Adgima TŨMBƐƐNO pẽgame. A wilgame tɩ b pʋtã sakame n wom sõma. A togsame tɩ koobã rɩta ligd wʋsgo, la a sõngdame tɩ vaeesdbã tʋʋmd paamd pãnga, la segdame tɩ b rɩk na-kẽnda tɩ tʋʋmda n paase, tʋʋmdã na yɩ neer wɛɛngẽ. A pẽga miniisr dãmb nins sẽn sak n kẽes b toog tʋʋmdã pʋgã, tɩ b yam yãkrã kɩtame tɩ b tõog n bãng mui bu-paal sẽn tõe n wom toto.

Miniisr dãmbã sẽn ko mui ningã b na n yãkame n sõng neb nins sẽn zoe n bas b tẽnsã. B kell na n kẽesa b toog n yãag tʋʋmdã.

original:
Yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem a 4 yʋʋm 2024 soabã, miniisr ning sẽn get laafɩ wã, Doktɛɛr Robɛɛr Lusẽ KARGUUG kõo sor tɩ b pak logto-yir b sẽn boond tɩ  «Kilinik  pẽrensɛɛs Saara». Ya a EBOMAF tʋʋm-noorã taoor soab a Mahamuudu BÕNKŨNG n me-a t’a be  Waga demilli.

Logtor yirã tara tɩbsg zĩis katɛka. A tara: pog-rogs-roogo, kamb tɩbsg zĩiga, operasẽo zĩiga, gĩinã,  kõabã, sũurã, fulfuudã, yĩn-gãongã, sugdsã, zutã bãase, yẽna, nin tɩbgs zĩisi, laboratoaare, ekogarafi, ɛskaneere, radiyo la vaeesg tʋʋm-teed a taaba. Tɩbsg nins b sẽn sõdgã fãa na n tɩbsda pʋgẽ be. Logtor yi-paallã na n sõngame tɩ neb nins sẽn da yit Burkĩna Faso n kẽnd n tɩbsd tẽns a taab ra le yi n kẽng kɛɛng ye. Logtoɛɛmb sẽn na n tʋm a pʋgẽ, yaa Tirki logto-kẽenga, la Burkĩna Faso logtoɛɛmba.

Logtor-yirã taoor soab a Dogtɛɛr Zili HOKNAE wilgame tɩ tɩbsgã teed wʋsg zoe n beeme. La rẽ na n sõngame tɩ b tõog n tɩbs bãad rãmbã. A wilgame tɩ yaa bãad rãmb gãas 35, la tɩbsg rot katɛk n be a pʋgẽ.

Porfesɛɛr Rolã AKA geta suyã tɩbsgo, la a bee Kodenvoare. Yaa yẽ n yɩ logtor-yirã pakr ba-yãkdga. Mise Rolã wilgame tɩ sũya bãas tɩbsg zĩig sẽn paama, a na n sõnga Burkĩna Faso la tẽn-yagsã.

EBOMAF tʋʋm-noorã taoor soab a Mahamuudu BÕNKŨNG wilgame t’a sẽn gesame tɩ tɩbsgã zĩis ka waoog Burkĩna Faso ye. Yaa rẽ n kɩt t’a yãk yam n me logtor-yirã. A wilgame tɩ Kovɩɩdã wakatẽ, ra yɩl n tall bãad rãmb n tɩ tɩbs zamaan-zẽnsã ra ka nana ye. Tɩ bala, tẽnsã fãa ra paga b toose.

Yaa rẽ fãa n wa ne logtor-yirã pakre. A togsame tɩ logtor-yirã tara tʋmd-n-taar ne Tirki logtor-yir a yembre, yaa rẽ n kɩt tɩ Tirki logtoɛɛmb wʋsg na n zĩnd n sõngd ne tɩbsgã.

Dogtɛɛr Robɛɛr Lusẽ KARGUUG wilgame tɩ logto-yirã wa n sõnga Burkĩna Faso ne a tẽn-yagsã nin-buiidã. A wilgame tɩ b Ministɛɛrã pipi zu-loɛɛg yaa nebã na paam tɩbs-sõngo. Miniisrã kẽnga taoor n wilg tɩ Reezẽodesãntra pʋgẽ, logto-yi sẽn so b mens sõor yaa bãmb 492. B sʋkã logto-yi-bɛd  sẽn so b mens b sẽn boond tɩ Kilinikã yaa bãmb 70, la “Kilinik Pẽrensɛɛs Saara” sẽn wa n  paasã.

original:
Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR rɩka koɛɛg yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 31 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, n pʋʋs Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidã fãa ne b taabo. A koeesã pʋgẽ, a goma : tẽngã nug-gãaga, zab ne nasaar wẽnsã, la zab ne wẽgb buud toor-toor sẽn be tẽngã. Tẽnga taoor soab wilgame tɩ b na n maana b pãng sẽn tõe, tɩ tʋʋm-noy katɛk la b tõog n pagse. Yaa koobã tʋʋma, la tʋʋm a taaba, sẽn na yɩlẽ tɩ tẽngã tõog n kẽng taoore. A kosame tɩ yʋʋm 2024 soabã yɩ laafɩ, nonglem, la zu-noog yʋʋmde, Burkĩna Faso nin-buiida fãa yĩnga.

Tẽngã taoor soab koeesã:

Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidu, sẽn zabd-b  soog-m-mengã, laafɩ wã la soog-m-meng sɩd-sɩdã na waw ã rãmba. Yaa sũ-noog ne maam, tɩ m dɩkd koɛɛg yʋʋm-paallã sɩngrẽ, n na n pʋʋs Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidã, sẽn be-b yir ka la sẽn be-b zamaan-n-zẽnse. Burkĩna Faso zo-rãmba, la a tʋmd-n-taasã, ne-b yʋʋm paalle, yʋʋm 2024 soabã taabo. D pẽgda Wẽnnaam b sẽn sõng tõnd tɩ d ta ra-kãngã, yʋʋm 2023 soabã yaoolem daarã. D kos Wẽnd tɩ  neb nins sẽn zab tẽngã soog-m-meng yĩng n maan kaalmã, tɩ b sɩɩs gãand laafɩ. D leb  n kota Wẽnd tɩ b kõ neb nins fãa sẽn paam sãmpogr zabrã wɛɛngẽ wã fãa laafɩ. D wilgda d belem ne neb nins sẽn zoe n bas b tẽnse, nin-wẽnsã tʋʋm-yood yĩngã.

M saam-biisi, yʋʋm 2023 soabã yɩɩ yʋʋmd tõnd maana vaees-zulung Burkĩna Faso sẽn be nug-gãag ningã zugu. Yɩɩ yʋʋm tõnd sẽn zĩnd n bao zu-loees nins sẽn namsd tõnd tẽngã tɩɩm, yaa rẽ n kɩte, tɩ d rɩk noy katɛka. Pipi noore, d ratame n yi yembdã nasaar wẽngã sẽn maandã. Yãmb ka tõe n kos ned t’a sõng yãmb tɩ y gẽes bũmb sẽn meneme, tɩ yaool n ya yẽ soabã n fãag yãmb bũmbã ye.

Yʋʋm 2023 soabã, yɛl-kẽer paama tɩʋʋsgo. Yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 11 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, d wilga na-kẽnda nins tõnd sẽn dɩke, laafɩ wã wɛɛngẽ, rɩɩbã na sek nin-buiidã, la na-kẽnda wʋsgo, tẽngã taoor kẽnd yĩnga. Yaa rẽ tɩ m pʋʋsd Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidã fãa, b kẽes-m-mengã, la b sẽn wʋmd zabr ning tõnd sẽn be a soab pʋgẽ wã võor yĩnga.

Yʋʋm 2024 soabã na n yaa yʋʋmd tõnd sẽn na n kẽng taoor ne zabrã. Tõnd na n kẽnga taoor n zab ne yemd ning b sẽn kẽes tõnd a pʋgẽ wã, la d zab ne nasaar-wẽnsã sẽn dat n gɩdg tõnd yidgrã sorã.

Yʋʋm 2024 soabã pʋgẽ, tõnd na n kẽnga taoor ne zab n deeg tẽngã. Yaa rẽ tɩ sodaarã wɛɛngẽ, d na n zĩniga sodaas sull b sẽn boond tɩ Birgad ɛspesɛll dẽntɛrvãsẽo rapɩɩdã, yaa sodaas sull sẽn na n tigim sodaasã buud toor-toore. Woto fãa kẽeda ne tõnd sẽn dat n lebg n siglg sodaarã tʋʋma , la d maneg n kʋms-a sẽn na yɩlẽ n paas zabrã pãnga. Yʋʋm 2023 soabã pʋgẽ, d paama zab-teedo, n tõog n lebg n sigl sodaarã. Tʋʋm-kãens na n kell n kẽnga taoor yʋʋm 2024 soabã pʋgẽ. Bala, tʋʋm-te-paal  sẽn na kogl sodaasã la a sõng tɩ b pãngã paase, la d na n paame. Sẽn leb n paasde, bãng-y tɩ yʋʋm 2024 soabã na n yɩɩ yʋʋmd d sẽn na pids pʋlems nins d sẽn maana. Sẽn yɩɩd fãa lebg n deeg tẽngã, la neb nins sẽn zoe n bas tẽnsã na tõog n leb b tẽnsẽ wã, la b paam koglgo.

Wa m sẽn da togs yãmba, yʋʋm 2023 soabã pʋgẽ, na-kẽnda wʋsg d sẽn dɩkã, d sɩnga tʋʋma la yʋʋm 2024 soabã, tʋʋm-kãens segd n kẽnga taoore. Sẽn yɩɩd fãa tẽngã taoor soab sẽn dɩk noor ning sẽn kẽed ne rɩɩbã wɛɛngẽ wã, n paas ministɛɛr ning sẽn get koobã yell sẽn segd n maan tʋʋm nins koobã la gʋʋlgã pʋgẽ. Sapaol-koobã zoe n sɩngame.  Woto wilgdame tɩ na-kẽnda a  yiibã tẽngã taoor soab ne koobã ministɛɛr sẽn dɩkã zoe n bee tʋʋmd zugu. Tʋʋm-kãens na n sõngame tɩ yʋʋm 2024 soabã pʋgẽ bɩ rɩɩbã tõog n sek nin-buiidã fãa. Ba t’a sã n wa n ka sek zãng me, bɩ rɩɩbã ra paoog wʋsg ye.

Yaa tɩlae ne tõnd tɩ tʋʋm-kãensã fãa tõog n pidi. Yaa rẽ tɩ m boond Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidã tɩ b kẽes b mens n tʋm tʋʋma, b sẽn beẽ fãa, sẽn na yɩl tɩ gosneer me tõog n yãag-ba, tɩ b tʋm tɩ b tʋʋmdã tõog n pidi. Sã n ya ne tʋʋm-no-bɛdã zinigr pʋgẽ, la tʋʋm nins fãa sẽn tõe  n sõng sẽn lɛɛbdbã sẽn maood tɩ bũmbã fãa tõogd n sãeeg n kẽ Burkĩna Faso tẽns wʋsg pʋsẽ wã, na-kẽnda wʋsg la d na n dɩk zĩ-kãng me, n tõog n yãag-ba. Apɛkã tʋʋm zoe n sɩngame, a na n sõngame tɩ d paam tʋʋm-no-bɛd kẽere. Yʋʋm 2024 soabã pʋgẽ na-kẽnda a taab la d na n leb n dɩke.

Yʋʋm 2024 soabã pʋgẽ tõnd na n kosa Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidã fãa tɩ b kẽes b toogo, n tõog n yãag  na-kẽnda nins tẽngã taoor soab sẽn dɩk tẽngã taoor kẽnd wɛɛngẽ wã. D sẽn maan vaees-zulung laafɩ wã wɛɛngẽ, yaa wa d sẽn da yeel yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 11 yʋʋm 2023 soabã pʋgẽ wã. Rẽndame tɩ d lebg n ges d tẽnsã siglg yelle, la d kɩt tɩ b lebg yɩlgemde. Rẽndame tɩ nin-buiidã fãa kẽes b toog tʋʋmdã pʋgẽ, n tʋm tɩ yɩlgemdã zĩnd zagsã la tẽngã fãa pʋgẽ. Rẽ na n kɩtame tɩ d tõog n gil bãas nins tõnd sẽn yã yʋʋmd ning sẽn loogã pʋgẽ, tɩ b ra le puk yʋʋm-paallã pʋgẽ ye.

Tõnd sẽn be maoor ning zug rũnda wã, yaa tõnd rog-n-mikã me maoore. Wala yãmb sẽn gũus n gese, vaeesg sẽn maan zu-loeesã pʋgẽ, d bãngame tɩ nasaarã wã wa n yiisa tõnd d rog-n-mikã pʋgẽ. Tõnd rog-n-mikã menemame, tõnd rog-n-mik ning sẽn gãd tõnd laafɩ wã, vɩɩmd-n-taarã, la sõng taabã. Tõnd rog-n-mika menemame. Yaa rẽ la tõnd sẽn zabd n dat tɩ d rog-n-mikã lebg n paam a zĩig tõnd maoorã pʋgẽ wã.

Yaa rẽ fãa n kɩt tɩ tõnd rɩk d buudã goam n ning sʋka, la d le ning sull b sẽn boond tɩ kõnsay nasẽonall de kominote. Yaa laloa depite rãmbã sẽn nan dɩk rasma noore. Woto fãa segd n kɩtyame tɩ tõnd lebg n wa d sɩngrẽ wã, d kʋdemdẽ wã, d rog-n-mikẽ wã, sẽn na yɩl tɩ sõng-taabã la vɩɩmd-n-taarã sẽn paoogd tõndã tõog n lebg n wa tõnd tẽngã pʋgẽ, laafɩ , bas tɩ looge , la sõng-taab rog-n-miki.

Sẽn kẽed ne wẽgbã wɛɛngẽ, yʋʋm 2023 soabã, wẽgbã ra ket n beeme. Yʋʋm 2024 soabã, tõnd datame n sɩd wɩkd mens n zab ne-a. Yaa wakat mam sẽn  na n kos tʋʋm-noy nins sẽn zabd ne wẽgbã tɩ b wɩk b mense, sẽn na yɩl t’a menem tõnd tẽngã pʋgẽ.

M ka tõe n baas m goama, n ka pʋʋs Burkĩna nin-buiidã sẽn wʋm maoorã võore, n sak kẽes b mens wĩndg la yʋng n maood n na n gũ tãrãzisẽo wã ne nao-kẽndr toor-toore. D bãng vẽeneg tɩ bɛ wã nan ka sik a lokã ye, bɩ d gũusi. Nasaar-wẽngã la bɛɛb nins sẽn be Burkĩna Faso ne  kɛɛngã ket n tʋmdame n dat wẽnga.

M pʋʋsda Burkĩna nin-buiidã barka, b maoorã yĩnga. M pʋʋsda neb nins sẽn be yir ka, bɩ kɛɛnga, tɩ yaa  Burkĩna Faso bɩ tẽn-taase, dũni wã fãa pʋgẽ  n sak n teend tõndo, la b sõngd Burkĩna Faso, mao-kãngã pʋgẽ wã.

A wakatẽ wã goama yɩɩ wʋsg tɩ tʋm-tʋmdbã ra yi n wilg tɩ b ratame tɩ b yao-b b ligdã, tɩ b ne Meeri wã taoor rãmb ka tol n wʋm taab ye. Yʋʋm a tãab loogr poore, zu-loɛɛgã ka tol n paam welgr n wa ta kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWARE.

Yaa rẽ t’a Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR  kẽes a toog n kose, tɩ ministɛɛr ning sẽn get kadensã la ministɛɛr ning sẽn get tʋm-tʋmdbã yẽs ne Meeri wã tɩ b mao tɩ zu-loɛɛgã paam welgre. Yẽsgã sɩd woma biisi. Tɩ bala, yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 29 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Meeri wã taoor dãmb yãk yam n na n yao-ba. Yaa milyão 300 la b rɩk na n yao  tʋm-tʋmdb 573. La b sʋkã, yaa neb 20 n maan kaalem. Waogdg Meeri wã delegasẽo ɛspesɛll taoor soaba, a Moris KONATE wilgame t’a sũur yaa noogo,  wʋm taabã sẽn lebg n kẽ sʋkã. A togsame tɩ sũ-puurã ra waa ne zũndri, tɩ yɩl n wʋm taabã meng  ra lebg toog tʋmtʋmdbã ne Meeri wã taoor rãmb sʋka. La rũndã a pẽgda Wẽnde. Tɩ bala, zu-loɛɛgã paama tɩɩm.

Mise  KONATE wilgame t’a na n yẽsa ne Senesɛs rãmba, tɩ neb nins sẽm tʋmd ne sagdã wʋkre, soayã pɩɩsgã paam b retrɛtã  (vʋʋsma) yaoodo. Neb nins sẽn maan kaalmã, a Moris KONATE kosa Wẽnd tɩ b maneg b reng taoore. A  pʋʋsa neb nins fãa sẽn kẽes b toog tɩ wʋm taab tõog n zĩnd Meeri wã taoor rãmb ne tʋm-tʋmdbã sʋkã. A kosa tʋm-tʋmdbã tɩ b sigs b sũya, la b wa tɩ b gãd taab nusi, n tʋm tɩ Waogdg Meeri wã tõog n yidg kẽng taoore. A togsame tɩ ligdã b sẽn na n yao-bã, sɩngda wakɩr tus a wɛ n talla n kẽng taoore. A Moris KONATE baas a koeesã ne yʋʋm-paallã taab pʋʋsgo.

Tʋmtʋmdbã no-rɛɛs a Edoaar WEDRAOOG pẽga tẽngã taoor soaba, ne Meeri wã taoor soaba, bãmb fãa  sẽn sak n lʋɩsa toog tɩ b zu-loeesã paam welgrã. Mise WEDRAOOG wilgame tɩ yʋʋm a tãabã pʋgẽ sɩd yɩɩ zu-loeese, bãmb ne Meeri wã taoor dãmba. La rũndã, b yaa sũur yaa noogo, tɩ bala, b zu-loɛɛgã welgame tɩ b na n yao-ba. A wilgame t’a sũ-noogã, nin-kẽembã, la pʋg-yãansã sẽn be bãmb sʋka, n na n paam b tʋʋlgã biisã. Bãmb sʋkã me, kɩɩbse, la pʋg-kõap bee be. Rẽnd bãmb zu-leesã sẽn paam welgrã, a ya b fãa sũ-noogo. A kosame tɩ Wẽnd sõng-do, tɩ d  tɩ tẽngã gãand bãane. Yaoodã sɩngda ne yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 29 n tãag a rasem 30 daare yʋʋm 2023 soabã.

Ministɛɛr ning sẽn get zamaan-zẽns zoodã, la Burkĩna Faso kamb sẽn be zamaan-zẽnsã pʋgẽ, b yãka Minisr Olviya Roamba, t’a sõangd a Karamaoko Zãmaari TARWAR led-a. Ministɛɛr ning sẽn get tẽn-gãongã arzɛk la sãnmã tʋʋm-noyã pʋgẽ,  b yãka miniisr Sɩmo Pɛɛr BUSIM t’a Yakuba Zabre GUBA ledg a zĩigẽ wã. A Zak Sostɛnd DẼNGARA sẽn da ya gofneerã seb-gʋnd-kasengã, reega miniisr Ãndere Zozɛf WEDRAOOG zĩiga, n na n ges karen-bi-bãoonesa, la buudã goam taoor kẽnd ministɛɛre. Gofne-paallã pʋgẽ miniisr Rĩmtallba Emanwɛɛl WEDRAOOGO, miniisr ning sẽn get kiba-kɩtbã la kʋdemdã, lebga na-zakẽ miniisri. A Matiyaas TARWAR sẽn da ya na-zakẽ seb-gʋndã, lebga Gofneerã seb-gʋnd n led a Zak Sostɛnd DẼNGARA zĩigẽ.

Zĩ-likr kiuug rasem 16 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Pap Farensoa gʋlsa sebr n wilg tɩ b kõo Waogdg tigung roogã ba sẽn da ya Kagdinaal Filip WEDRAOOG vʋʋsem. Yaa yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 16 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, la Musoyẽer Porspɛɛr KÕTIYEBO reeg b naam teedo, b sẽn boond tɩ posesẽo Kanonikã, n lebg Waogd tigung roogã ba. Pʋʋsgã, yaa Pap no-rɛɛsã n lʋɩ taoore, ne Evɛk rãmba, la Pɛrɛtr dãmb kõn bãng n sõde.

Nand tɩ b zĩnig Evɛk paallã, Kagdinall Filip WEDRAOOG rɩka koɛɛga. B koɛɛgã pʋgẽ, b pʋʋsa tigung katolik kambã sẽn be Waogdgã ne b paoongo, la b kosa Wẽnd tɩ b kõ Evɛk paallã pãnga t’a tõog n zã Waogdg tigung roogã ne zemsgo.

Yaa Musoyẽer Porspɛɛr KÕTIYEBO, n kẽed Waogdg roogã ba rãmb a yoob-n-soaba. Musoyẽer Zoani TEVENU, Musoyẽer Emil SOKE, kagdinaLl Poll ZŨNGRAANA, Musoyẽer Zãmaari KÕMPAOORE, la Kagdinall Filip WEDRAOOGO. Evɛk paallã koees pʋgẽ, a wilgame tɩ ka tũ ne a bãngre, bɩ a sõmblem yĩng la Pap yãk-a t’a lʋɩ Waogdg tigung roogã taoorã ye. Yaa bũmb sẽn ta Wẽnd meng raabo, yaa Wẽnd n tʋʋlge, t’a ne Waogdg tigung roogã kamb soay yek taaba. Musoyẽer Porspɛɛr pẽga Kagdinall Filip WEDRAOOGO, tʋʋm nins a sẽn tʋm Woadg tigung roogã kamb yĩngã. A pʋʋsa dĩinã buud toor-toore, la rog-n-mika taoor dãmbã. A wilgame t’a me na n kell n kẽnga taoore, tɩ zems-n-taar ning sẽn da be wã paam pãng n paase. Pap no-rɛɛsã pʋʋsa Evɛk paallã ne a paoogo, la a kos Waogdg tigung roogã kamb fãa tɩ b pʋʋs tɩ Wẽnnaam kõ-a tõog t’a tõog n zã tigung roogã wa Kirista meng sẽn date.

Yaa kirisneb kõn bãng n sõde, la dĩin buud toor-toor dãmba, n paas gofneem neb kẽer zẽk b naoor n tɩ zĩnd n maan kaset tɩ Musoyẽer Porspɛɛr KÕTIYEBO reeg a tõogã.

Yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 15 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Labe Sɩmo Zɩɩd KÕNSƐƐG maana sɛb a yiib la a yɩɩl zulukri. Yɩɩlã zĩigẽ, yaa bãmb ne Labe Ardno Wãngrao n naag taab n deem.

Seg-taabã, yaa sẽn na n leb n ges raarã sẽn kell rũnda ne beoogã seglgã bee nen-bʋgo. Sõasgã sɩngr wakate, b reng n tẽega seg taab ning sẽn zĩnd kiuugã rasem 23 soabã, b sẽn gãd noy ninsi. Rẽ poore, siglgã taoor soaba, Mise Ɛlferɛɛd wilgame tɩ siglgã kẽnda sõma. A Sɩdnooma Yisɛka KABOOR togsame tɩ Savand Medɛ sõasg ning b sẽn boond tɩ Bõnzʋʋr le Faso wã, bool-a t’a kẽng n tɩ sõse, n wilg bũmb ning võor sẽn kɩt b yãk wakatã t’a ya Sãntr noor kambã na seg taab n dɩ rogem noog wakatã. A wilgame tɩ Rtb tel Zinita la Radiyo nasnall yeelame tɩ b tʋm neb tɩ b wa sõse, n wilg rasem a tãabã tʋʋm sẽn na n kẽn toto. Sawand Fm me leb n boolame tɩ b wa sõs Sõorã sõasg pʋgẽ, la Bõnzʋʋr le Faso wã zug n paase. A wilgame tɩ kibaya sãeegr wɛɛngẽ, bɩ b bas rabeem, tɩ b na n paama yãagre. A togsame tɩ b sega kiba-kɩtbã a yibeoogẽ, la rẽ fãa yaa sẽn na yɩl tɩ rɩk kibaya n taas nin-buiidã. Tɩ bala, kʋdemdã Miniisr yeelame t’a ka na n zĩnd ye, la a na n tʋma ned tɩ zĩnd a yʋʋr yĩnga. A leb n na n sõng-b-la gosneer kiba-kɩtbã tɩ b wa rɩk koeesã n taas nin-buiidã. Ligdã wɛɛngẽ pʋlem nood ket n kẽnda taoor n paasdẽ, tɩ b saagdẽ ka la ka, b rãmb na pidis b pʋlengo. Mise KABOOR wilgame tɩ b boonda Sãnt noorã kamb gilli, b ka welg tɩ gurma, tɩ silmiiga, tɩ moaaga, bɩ buud a taab sẽn be soolmã pʋg ye. B boonda b fãa, la b ratame tɩ b tall b pagb la b kamb n wa wʋsgo. Rasãndaagã sɩngda lamusa sapaolg kiuuugã rasem 30 n ta hatã yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem a tãabo. Zãna ketame, la sẽn dat-a fãa, a ket n tõe n paamame. Reemã zĩigẽ Buls kamb piig la a nu n zoe n segl n sa, n na n deeme n kõ nebã. Ƙoaasdbã na n sega taab yibeoog wakat a nii kiuugã rasem 30. Badaar zaabr wakat a naas la reem-rɛɛmdbã na n sɩnga badaar zaabr wakat a naase. Raar fãa b na n deemame n ta yʋng wakat a nii. Tigrã pakre, la koeesã rɩgsg na n yɩɩ sibrã kiuugã rasem a yi raare, zaabr wakat a naase. Rẽ poore, b na n gilgame n ges zãna.

Pẽgdwẽnde Erik Zĩnaaba

Tigra pakre, la koeesa rigsg na on yii sibra kiuuga rasem a yi raare, zaabr wakat a naase. Rei poore, ub na on gilgame on ges zana.

 B bẽndame n pʋʋs Burkĩna Faso gosneerã ne nandg pãng ning b sẽn maand nin-buiidã sõngr wɛɛngẽ wã. Sullã no-rɛɛs wilgame tɩ b na n pʋgdame n getẽ sõngrã b sẽn kõtã tõog n tat neb nins sẽn a sẽn segd ta wã.

Sapaolg kiuug rasem 23 yʋʋm 2023 soabã ADRCN sẽn ya Sãntr noor kambã lagem-n-taar sull tɩ b boond tɩ Asosɛsẽo Lagemtaabã talla sɛk ne b soolmã kamb kẽere. Seg-taabã võore, yaa ADRCN Lagem-taaba, ne Liniyãopʋʋrledevelopemadelaporvẽesdisãnematẽnga tɩ b kʋʋg koɛɛg n boond tɩ UDPS Natigimzanga, n paas Asosɛsẽo Nayɩneerepʋʋrledevelopemadelaporvẽesdinamentẽnga tɩ b kʋʋg koɛɛg n boond tɩ ANDN, la lagem-n-taar sula a taab sẽn be Bam soolmã, n get Bam porvẽesã yidgri. Sula kãens fãa naaga taab noor a ye, la sũur a ye, n yãk sapaolg kiuug rasem 30 n ta yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem a tã yʋʋm 2023, Sãntr noor kambã sẽn be Waogdgã zĩnda ne Miize nasnallã zak pʋga. Ya b soolmã kamb na paas b nonglem ne taaba, la b zĩnd-n-taarã sõmblem pãnga. Yaa rẽ tɩ b yãk tɩ wakatã ya zĩnd n yẽse, n bao yam-dãmba, b soolmã na yidgi, la a nin-buiidã me na zems-taaba, n naag taab n zab ne yõ-kaalmã.

Gom-zug b sẽn tiki, yaa « Sãntr noor kambã tik b kʋdemdã la b rog-n-mikã, n tõog n kɩt tɩ b soolmã yi yõ-koglg kaalmã pʋgẽ».  Bũmb ning sẽn kɩt tɩ b na n maan raarã, yaa sẽn na yɩl tɩ b tõog n seg taaba, n bãng taab n paase, la b rɩ rogem noogo . La sẽn na yɩl n paas wakatã b sẽn yãk na n seg  taab n sõsã yamleoogo, b maana Rasãndaaga. La b yãka yam tɩ na n yɩ Sãntr noor soolmẽ wã rɩ-rãmbã la bũmb nins fãa b sẽn maand Sãnematẽnga, Namendtẽnga, la Bam soolmã pʋgẽ, la zãna rɩkd-b na n  koose. Rasem a tãabã pʋgẽ, b na n dɩka koees buud toor-toore. Koeesã fãa yaa nin-buiidã na wʋm taab n vʋɩɩmde, la sugr koeese. Koeesã rɩgsg poore, b na n gilgame n ges zãna.

Siglgã taoor rãmb wilgame tɩ b ratame tɩ Sãntr noorã kamb wa ne b pagb la b kamba, la b zo-rãmba. B ratame tɩ tall b kambã tɩ b wa ges tõnd kʋdem-teedã sẽn be zakã pʋgã. Rasãndaagã ka yaood n kẽ ye. La kẽ n ges Miize wã pʋg teedã yaoodame. ADRCN rãmb tʋlsmã ya b mao n paas soolmã kamb zems-taaba, la b wʋmd-n-taarã pãnga, Burkĩna Faso wen-vɩɩsã pʋgẽ. “Zabr yikd beoog ka kõt weef ki ye”.

Sẽn na yɩl n bãng siglgã kẽnd toto, b sega taab sapolg kiuug rasem 23 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Waogdgo, Miize nasnallã zak pʋga. Koeesã rɩkr pʋga, a Sɩdnooma Yisɛka KABOORE, ADRCN taoor soabã wilgame tɩ Busum Dĩma a Sigr sakame n na n sõng-ba. Tigrã ba-yãkd-kaseng yaa Busum Dĩma a Sigri, tɩ Kagdinall Filip WEDRAOOG ne a Loorã SEDG pʋgda, la Bam soolmẽ wã b ra nan ka paam ned ning b sẽn na n yãk t’a paasã ye. A wilgame tɩ sõandb kẽer n zoe n pʋlmame tɩ b na n kõ-b-la ligdi, tɩ kẽer pʋlem tɩ b na n sõng-b-la ne reem-teedo, mobile, la bũmb buud fãa b me sẽn tõe n paam n kõ-b tɩ b reeg n segl tigrã. Reem-rɛɛmdb na n zĩnda sʋka, la yaood kae ye. Yaa reem-rɛɛmd fãa reem n wilg a bãngre, tɩ zãma wã bãng-a n paase. Lamusã ne arzũma reemã rãmb na n sɩnga zaabr wakat a naas sasa, n tãag yʋng wakat a nii. Sibrã ne hatã, b na n sɩnga zaabr wakat a yoob sasa, n deem n tɩ sik yʋng wakat a nii. Kibayã kɩsg wɛɛngẽ, saagr be, tɩ b na paam yãagre. MISE BAAGMOOG sẽn ya Savand fm kiba-kɩtã pʋlmame t’a na n kẽes a toog n kos Savand fm la Savand Tv tɩ b yãag-ba. Sõasgã yɩɩ gom-n-kõ-taaba, tɩ ned fãa bãng siglgã sẽn be zĩig ninga.

Sapaolg kiuug rasem 20 n tãag a rasem 22 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, kiba-kɩtb nins sẽn gʋlsd ne buudã goama sega taab Noomgãana Lʋmbil komindã pʋg n maan zãmsgo. Zãmsgã  gom-zug yɩɩ «Buudã goam  kibay gʋlsdb sẽn segd n maan toto n kẽ nasaara nug tʋʋm-te-paalã pʋgẽ». Tũu ne sull b sẽn boond tɩ AYEPEZIYƐLƐNDÃ paama sull ning sẽn sõngd kibayã kũun rot ne ligdi, b sẽn boond tɩ FAPÃ sõngre, tɩ kiba-kɩtb nins sẽn gʋlsd ne buudã goam lagem-n-taar sull tõog n paam zãmsgã n kõ b kiba-kɩtbã.

Yɩɩ kiba-kɩtb 20 sẽn gʋlsd moore, Silmiirẽndi, Zʋlle, la Gʋrende, n paam zãmsgã. Karen-saamb yɩɩ mise Rasɩɩd TARWAR sẽn tar bãngr nasaara nug tʋʋm-te-paalã wɛɛngẽ n dɩk zãmsgã n taas-ba. Nand tɩ tʋʋmdã sɩnge, Kiba-kɩtbã sull taor soaba a Tasɛɛr Kĩnda pʋʋsa nebã ne b waoongo, la a pẽg

Fap taoor dãmbã, b sẽn sak n yãagd-ba, tɩ b paamd zãmsg buud toor-toor n kõt b kiba-kɩtbã. A wilgame tɩ wakat ning zamaanã sẽn be wã, segdame tɩ ned kam fãa sak n tũ tekrã. A wilgame tɩ zãmsg ning kiba-kɩtbã sẽn paama, a yaa bũmb sẽn tar yõod wʋsgo.

A tõe n sõng-b lame tɩ b kẽ zamaan paalgã tʋʋm-teed pʋgẽ b sẽn boond tɩ Nimerikã. A kell n kosa kiba-kɩtbã tɩ b tũ zãmsgã sõma t’a na n sõng-b lame tɩ b tõog n lebg n vʋʋg b Zʋgnalsã, b sẽn da be kũum sor zugã.

AYEPEZIYƐLƐND yel-gɛta a Evaris ZÃONG wilg tɩ zãmsgã yaa bũmb sẽn tar yõod wʋsg ne kiba-kɩtb nins sẽn gʋlsd ne buudã goama. Tɩ bala, Zʋgnall rãmbã ka le raad ye. Seb-vãt nins b sẽn tar n yiisd sɛbã me ligd lebga toogo, la sã n kẽ nasaara nug tʋʋm-te-paala pʋgẽ, nebã fãa tõe n paamda kibaya faag-faaga. A leb n sõngdame me tɩ buudã goam gʋlsdb paamd nafr a pʋgẽ. A Evaris wilgame tɩ b na n dɩka AYEPEZIYƐLƐNDÃ t’a yɩ wa Zʋgnall kasenga, tɩ kiba-kɩtbã gʋlsd a zugu, tɩ b kibaya naagd n piuugd zamaanã pʋ wakat yende. Zãmsgã sɩngrẽ, b reng n wilga kiba-kɩtbã la buudã goam sẽn be zĩig ning Burkĩna Faso tẽn-kugrã pʋgẽ. Wegsgã pʋgẽ, sã n sɩd getẽ, mikdame tɩ Burkĩna Faso zãadb kẽer ra ka rɩk buudã goam n ning sʋk ye. B ra gomd-a-la ne noor bala. Tʋʋma b sẽn tʋmd a pʋgẽ me, ra ka tũud zãng ye. Ba ne nin-buiidã wʋsg sẽn ka wʋmd nasaara wã goam la b mi kaorengã, b baas n ka rɩk buudã goam n da ning taoor ye. Ra yaa Radiyo rãmba, la Televizẽo rãmb nins sẽn gomd buudã goamã n, da sõngd nebã tɩ b paamd kibayã.
