Zi likr kiuug rasem piig la a naanse yuum tuusa yiibu la pisi la a taanbo soaba, gosneera taoor soab a Apolineer KELEM ti rigla logto yi kaseng ub sein boond ti SEYASI Sein Magtei de Pores pipi tan koeemde, Gana sein be Rulg kominda Kombisr soolmei.

Logto yira na on sonnga karen bi bed nins sein be Yiniversite Sein Dominik sein be Gana, Kombisr soolmei wa ti ub paam on biis ub bangr logtoeemda kaoreng weengei. Yaa ziig yalem sein zems Ɛgtaar piiga la ub yak on na on me a.  Logtorr yira na on toong on deeg li ramb kobs i baad ramba yinga. Yaa vugs katek la ub ganeg a meeba na keindre. Pipi, ub rika milyaar pisyoobe on na on  tum ti ka ne yuumda yiibu, bi logtoeemba toong on  zoe on sing ub tuuma.

Metr Apolineer KELEM wilgame ti logto yira wa on pidsa gosneera tulsem, sein ya a na mao ti  nin buiida faa paam laafi wa. A leb on na on sonngame ti ub paam logtoeem sein tar bangre. A keinga taoor on paas ti logto yira na on sonnga nin buiida ti ub paam ub yinsa laafi. Miniisra paasame ti Katolika karen dot pusei ka kaorenga bal la ub zamsd karen biisa ye. B wilgd b la viima na keindre, la bumb nins faa ub sein tone on tik ti ub viima yi sonma. A wilga veieneg ti yei sein ya a soab runda wa yaa kaseto, ti Katolika karen dot pusei, ub zamsga tara yoond wusgo.

A yeelame ti ub sein dik, a Martei de Pores, yuura on pud logtor yira yaa sonma. Ti bala, a yaa ned sein  sein da tar maag m menga, la a rikd a viuug faa on sonngd a taaba.  Yaa rei ti ub rat ti Karen biig faa sein na on kei karen do kanga rik a na keindra on me a zamaana. Miniisr KELEM paasame ti b  sa on get runda runda neba na keindre, ub ka tar maag m menga, ub leb on yaa saamdba. A Apolineer KELEM koeesa baasgei, a wilgame t’a suur noomame, ti bala,  logtor yira waame ti Reezeio di Santr siid nin buiid na on  paam laafi on paase.

Dogteer Ãndere SAVADOG sein get YIYƐSDAWO Yiniversite wa porze ramb togsame t’a meeb tuu ministeer ning sein get Karen bi beda la bangra baoob no ganegdi. Ministeera no ganegdi wilgame ti Ƴiniversite sa on tar logtoeemd kaoreng ziiga, segdame t’a paam logtor yir ti karen biis be be on biisd ub bangre. Yaa rei me on kit ti ub yak yam on na on me a.

Ti bala,  ziiga sein zar ne Waogdg bilfa kitame ti karen biisa ka tone on keind Waogdg on karemdei, la ub lebgdei ye. La logtor yira sa on pei, ub zamsga yita nana. Logtor yira tara tibsg wil toor toor wala: kom baoonesa tibsg ziisi, zuta baas tibsg ziisi, fulfuuda baase tibsgo, la radyo ramba, la tibsg a taaba. Sein na yil ti ub gibl wakata yinga, ub puii tuumda vusgs a yiibu. B na on deng on mee rota, on paam on sing tibsga. Pipi tuumda na on yika milyaar pisyoobe, la ub ratame ti yei soaba sa ka ne yuumd a ye pugei.

Sein pugda, yaa tuum a taab sein tone on paas logtor yira pang la ub ganeg ya. Ganeg kang soaba yika milyaar kobs i la pisnu.

Veinegre, ya a Dominik sonng buud Moonpeer damb on yak yam on na on me logtor yira. Yuum tuusa yiibu la piig la a nii soaba sein looga, ub reng on mee Yiniversite kaseng ub sein boond ti YIYƐSDAWO wa. Kell on yaa Yiniversite kang pug la ub na on me logtor yira. Permye miniisra sein dilg tan koeemda poore, Kagdinall Filip WEDRAOOGO, Waogdg tigung rooga ba ninga ziiga barka, ti ub kell on naag taab on sel tiiga.

Kibara yii Faso.net

original:
Zĩ-likr kiuug rasem 18 n tãag a rasem 22 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Burkĩna Faso na n deega sãamb sẽn yit tẽns wʋsg pʋsẽ, sẽn tũud ne Fɩlɛpã naoor 10 soabã. Sẽn na yɩl n wilg tʋʋmdã siglg sẽn ya a soaba, siglgã taoor rãmb sega kiba-kɩtbã.

A Gezuma SANOOGO, Filɛpã siglg taoor soab wilgame tɩ koabg zugu 90 wã fãa zoe n pidame. A togsame tɩ b na n maana sõs-kasenga, n paam n pak tʋʋmdã kʋɩlense.  Sõasgã taoore, yaa depite rãmba taoor soab la b yãk t’a na n yɩ ba-yãkdga. Tigsgã loogr poore, yaa sõs-bula a yopoe la b na n maan rasem a naasã pʋgẽ. soãsga pʋgẽ, b na n goma kibayã kɩsg sẽn segd n yɩ toto tẽnsã sẽn be zu-loees pʋgẽ wã, la kibayã kɩsg sẽn segd tũ soay ninsi.

B na n kell n dɩka waoor kũun b sẽn boond tɩ piri Norbɛɛr ZÃONGÃ n kõ kiba-kɩt ning sẽn tʋm-a n yɩɩg a taab kibaya vaeesg wɛɛngẽ b sẽn boond tɩ Ẽnvɛstigasẽo wã. Wags-taabã pʋgẽ, tʋʋmdã siglg taoor rãmb wilgame tɩ yaa kiba-kɩtb 118 sẽn yit tẽns 29 n kẽes b mens wagsgã pʋgẽ.

Siglgã taoor rãmb wilgame tɩ b sigla raag b sẽn boond tɩ Foaarã. Raagã na n paka a kʋɩlens zĩ-likr kiuug rasem 14 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Fɛspako wã zak pʋga. Foaarã pʋga, tõnd rog-n-mik rɩ-rãmbã buud toor-toor la teed a taab na n zĩnda sʋka, n paas reem-rɛɛmdba. Reem-rɛɛmdbã ya a Folobi a Ƙayaawoto la Dide Awadi.

Filɛp vuk 10 soabã, neb 108 sẽn yi tẽns 31, la kiba-kɩtb nins sẽn zabd ninsaal yalẽ wã na paam koglg bãmb 200 n wat n na n naag tigsgã pʋga.

Gom-zug  b sẽn tik Filɛpã naoor 10 soabã yaa «  Kibayã kũun rot tʋʋmd zabã la vɩɩmd-n-taarã wɛɛngẽ nin-sabls tẽnsã pʋsẽ. » Yaa bãng mitb sẽn be kibayã kũun pʋgẽ, la ninsaal yalẽ wã wɛɛngẽ, bãmb n na n zĩnd n pʋɩ taab bãngre, sẽn na yɩl tɩ kiba-kɩtbã soog-m-meng paam pãnga, sẽn yɩɩd fãa yõ-koglg kaalmã wɛɛngẽ.

Sẽoog kiuug rasem 16 yʋʋm 2023 soabã ANDN sullã maana tik-kaseng Waogdgo,  Meeri wã kom-bɩɩb zakẽ. B goma Buls ne Pʋytẽng sorã gudrõ, b sẽn dat n viig-a  n tɩ yi Sãagẽ Baraasã Diig zugu, tɩ: Zʋgo, Pĩisi, la Yẽeg rãmb ka rat n sakã, la  nin-wẽnsã tʋʋmd sẽn tar yãngr beoog fãa, tɩ VDP rãmbã ne Buls Zãndarmiiri wã taoor rãmb ka wʋmd taab noor a ye, n tõe n naag taab n zab ne bɛ wã. Koe-baasdgã yɩɩ Sãntr noor nebã na wʋm taaba, la b naag n vʋɩɩmde.

Yaa ANDN taoor soabã a Filibɛɛr BEEMBÃMB n lʋɩ sõasgã taoore. Mise BEEMBÃMB wilgame tɩ gosneem rasem yopopoe seg-taabã pʋgẽ, b goma Buls sorã yelle. B goama pʋgẽ, b wilgame tɩ b zoe n kʋmsa fãa tɩ sa. B paama sorã maaneg ligdi, tɩ pidi, n kell n yãk raar n sɩnge, la gom-bãoones n ket a pʋgẽ. Boto me: Zʋg ne Pĩisi, la Yẽeg rãmb ka na n paam t’a yi b tẽngẽ wã ye. Yaa rẽ tɩ b yeel tɩ b ka na n sak tɩ b viig-a ye. A koɛɛgã pʋgẽ, a gomamme n paoog pag ning sẽn maan sorã vaeesgo, n wilg t’a ka tõe n dʋʋg a Kʋlwookã ye. A yeelame  tɩ pagã yagda zigi. Mise BEEMBÃMB wilgame tɩ sẽoog kiuug rasem a 2 L’ looge, b pẽnega Bulsnaab n wilg tɩ b na n tɩ kosa sugri. La Bulsnaab sũur yɩɩ noogo, tɩ b ra yet tɩ b na n zẽka b naoor n zĩnd sʋka, la b wa n tʋma Baannaab t’a kẽng b yʋʋr yĩnga. Bãmb ne Baannaab kẽngame, la pagã sũur yɩɩ noogo. ANDN taoor soabã sẽn taas moorã,  neb wʋsg sakame tɩ b yi ne sorã Sãagẽ, tɩ fãa yaa Namendtẽng paoongo.

A Loorã SEDG sẽn da yɩ koobã, la koomã ne a pʋgẽ teedã Miniisr wilgame tɩ Sãagẽ Baraasã yaa Baraas a yiib n soab Zigã soabã loogr poore. Sãagẽ Baraasã na n sõnga Kugpɛɛla, Pʋytẽnga, Zorgo, Bulsa, la tẽns a taab neb tɩ b paam ko-yɩlgemd n yũuda. A Loorã kõo vẽenem wʋsgo. A togsame t’a meng gesã bãngdbã sẽn vaees n wilg tɩ rẽndame tɩ b viig sorã bũmb ning sẽn kɩte. A Loorã SEDG sẽn goma neb wʋsg wilgame, tɩ b sakame tɩ b viig-a t’a yi Sãagẽ. La b ges b sẽn tõe n yẽs yẽsg ning tɩ b sõng Zʋgo, Pĩisi, la Yẽeg rãmb tɩ b me ra pa zaalem fasɩ ye.Nin-buiidã naaga taab noore, n yeel tɩ b rɩka na-kẽnda, la b ra tiis taaba, tɩ b wa rɩk sorã n toeem zĩig ye. Rẽ poore, ANDN taoor soabã kell n togsame tɩ tẽngã taoor rãmb wilgame tɩ b leb n bee na-kẽndr zugu, n na n ges Buls ne Kaya sorã me gudrõ yelle, t’a sõngdame tɩ b tõe n paam n zab ne nin-wẽnsã, tɩ yõ-koglgã paam pãnga. 

Yõ-koglg kaalmã wɛɛngẽ, zama wã kosa ANDN taoor rãmbã tɩ b maan b pãng sẽn tõe, n bõos tẽngã taoor rãmb tɩ b sõng-b ne Kã militɛɛre. VDP rãmbã ne Buls Zãndarmiiri wã taoor soab ka wʋmd taab ye. B wek nebã yam tɩ b zãag b mens ne Reezososo rãmb pʋs kibay t’a ka sõngd zabrã na leb poorẽ wakat kẽer ye. Buls biig a ye sẽn ya Zãndarma, a DAMIBA Sʋle paasa a Loorã SEDG gomdã zugu. A wilgame tɩ b sagl nebã, tɩ bãng tɩ bɛ wã tũnugda tẽngã kamb sẽn dɩkd yalã n mi n dogend taabã t’a raabã pitẽ. Bɛ wã tõe n kãna nebã ne taab tɩ b ka tol wʋm taaba, n tõe n naag noor a ye n zab zabrã ye.  Koees sẽn be wã pʋgẽ  Sɩdnooma Yisɛka KABOOR togsame tɩ sẽoog kiuug rasem 29 sẽn watã Busum Dĩm a Sigri ne Kagdinall Filip WEDRAOOGO, la a Rasmaane SÃANA n paas soolmã nin-bɛd na n zĩnda ne taab Kaya, n ges b sẽn maan toto, tɩ nin-buiidã zems taab n vʋɩɩmde.

Miniisr Basolma BAZIYE sẽn zĩnd tɩɩsã daar naoor a nu soabã, tẽngã taoor soab yʋʋr yĩngã, a wilgame tɩ tɩɩg tara yõod wʋsg ninsaal vɩɩmã pʋgẽ. Tɩɩsã daar vuk a nu soabã pʋgẽ kiba-kɩtb nins sẽn gom-ba,  bɩ sẽn gʋls-b kibay tɩɩsã zug paama waoor kũuni.

Yaa miniisr ning sẽn get wen-vɩʋʋgã koglgo yɩlgemdã la koomã Doktɛɛr Ogʋstẽ KABOOR n yɩ tʋʋmdã ba-yãkdga. Yɩɩ yʋʋm 2010 soabã, la « Envirinfos » zʋgnallã pak a kʋɩlense. La yaa sɛb zut la b ra gʋlsd-a t’a yit kiuug a tãab-tãabo. B ra yiisd-a lame b pʋɩt Karen-biisã zaalem karen-dotẽ wã, ne sula nins sẽn so b mensã, la tʋʋm-noy kẽer pʋsẽ.  Sẽn sɩng ne yʋʋm 2010 soabã n tãag yʋʋm 2023 yaa zʋgnall rãmb 20 000 la b yiis yã.  A Lazaar DULKUM Zʋgnallã taoor soab wilgame tɩ bũmb ning sẽn kɩt tɩ b ning-a ẽntɛgnetã zugã, yaa wakatã sẽn tek tɩ nebã fãa lebg n kẽ nasaarã nug-tʋʋm-te-paalã pʋsã n wa ne rẽ.

Miniisr Zã Emanwɛl WEDRAOOG wilgame tɩ biig sã n dog zak pʋga, yaa sũ-noog ne zaka rãmba. Yaa rẽ t’a wilg t’a sũur noomame. Bala, a gomda wen-vɩʋʋgã yell nasaara nug-tʋʋm-te-paalã pʋgẽ tɩ neb wʋsg tõe n paam n karem. Miniisrã kosa nin-buiidã tɩ b maan b sẽn tõe fãa n kẽedẽ ẽntɛgnetã pʋg n karemd kibay nins « envirinfos » sẽn yiisdã, t’a na n sõng-b lame tɩ b tõog n kogl wen-vɩʋʋgã.

Tʋʋmdã ba-yãkdg a Ogʋstẽ KABOOR wilgame tɩ Burkĩna Faso yaa war tẽnga. Rẽ n so tɩ wen-vɩʋʋgã koglg segd n yɩ tɩlae ne nebã fãa. « Envirinfos » sẽn kẽes-a nasaara nug-tʋʋm-te-paalã pʋgã, t’a leb n tar sags buud toor-toor sẽn sagendã, a na n sõnga nebã tɩ b kẽes b toog wen-vɩʋʋgã koglg pʋgẽ. Kell n yɩɩ wakat Zʋgnallã taoor soab sẽn bẽde, n dɩk kaset sɛb n kõ neb sẽn tʋm Zʋgnallã pʋga, a sɩngrã wakat n tãag rũndã.

A wilgame tɩ kũun ning b sẽn dɩk n kɩs kadensã la yõ-koglgã ministɛɛrã, a na n sõng-b lame tɩ b zab ne bi-beelmã la nin-wẽnsã.

Sig-noy kiuug rasem 26 yʋʋm 2023 sẽn watã, Burkĩna Faso ne Sɩnd na n maneg n sigla b zoodã, la b maan a yʋʋm a 5 tẽegre. Rẽ tɩ Sɩnd no-rɛɛsã wilg tɩ b na n dɩka na-kẽnd paala. Na-kẽnd-paala pʋga, b na n sõnga Burkĩna Faso a taoor kẽndã wɛɛngẽ. A pasaame tɩ tẽnsa a yiibã nadg pãng na n kɩtame tɩ b zoodã tõog n wom biisi. Kolonell Bukare ZŨNGRÃAN pʋʋsa Sɩnd dãmba, la a wilg tɩ teedã b sẽn paama  na n paasa b pãnga. A nan sõnga neb nins sẽn tʋmd yõ-koglgã wɛɛngẽ tɩ b tõog n tʋme. Yaa rẽ t’a rɩk koɛɛg gosneerã yʋʋr yĩnga  n pʋʋs barka. A kell n wilgame tɩ b na n zãa kũunã neere.

Metr Pasere Titẽng wilgame tɩ nin-sablg yẽgr ya a kʋdemde. Yaa rẽ n kɩt tɩ b lugl nin-kẽems nins sẽn tar kʋdemdã bãngr sulli, tɩ b tʋm tɩ kʋdemdã kẽng taoore, la b rɩk-a n wilg kom-yaoobã. Burkĩna Faso rɩka rasema a yopoe n bool rog-n-mik reem-rɛɛmdba, la kʋdemd-teed buud toor-toor rãmb tɩ b seg taab n maab wags-taaba. Neb nins sẽn zĩnd tigrã pʋg wilgame t’a yɩɩ sõma.

Miniisrã kosame tɩ buud fãa kell n gãd a rog-n-miki, t’a tõe n sõng-b lame tɩ b zab ne nin-wẽnsã.

Sull ning sẽn ges tʋʋmdã siglg seb-gʋnd a Kiristɛnd Maari SÃNU wilgame tɩ ESƐNSE wã naoor 20 soabã, yɩɩ sõma wala, bãmb sẽn da ratã. A kɩtame tɩ Burkĩna Faso kʋdemdã leb n kẽng  taoor n paase. A leb n sõngame tɩ nebã na n kẽes a b toogo. A wilgame tɩ wags-taabã pʋgẽ, yɩɩ neb 600 la zak n wa ne b kʋdemdã teed-buud toor toore, la b rog-n-mik n maan wagsgã. Neb sẽn zẽk b naoor n tɩ gilg n ges taa neb 30 000.

Tig a taabã sẽn sigla wagsgã buud toor-toor bãmb b nu. Yɩɩ rog-n-mik yĩn-wɩsgre, rog-n-mik rɩɩb sɛglgo,  reem buud toor-toore, la te-naandse, la sẽn kẽ-b wagsgã tall n wags-taaba.

Eɛnsɛnse wã sẽn pag a kʋɩlens b kõo neb nins sẽn lʋɩ b taabã taoor kũuni. Rog-nik reemã zĩigẽ, yɩɩ reem sull yʋʋr b sẽn boond tɩ turup Kãtigi n lʋɩ taoore. B taoor soabã a Yakuba KULBALI wilgame t’a sũur yaa noogo, a sẽn paam n lʋɩ a taabã taoorã. A wilgame tɩ yʋʋm 2016 sẽn loogã, a naaga wagsgã pʋgẽ. Yʋʋm-kãnga, a pʋg tãab n soab zĩigẽ. Yʋʋm 2018 soabã, yɩɩ paame. Rõanda soabã me leb n yaa yẽ n paame. Reemã zĩigẽ neb nins sẽn lʋɩ b taabã taoorã rãmb no-rɛɛs wilgame tɩ kũunã b sẽn paama kenga b pelse tɩ b na n kẽng taoor ne tʋʋmdã.

Yaa gossneema taoor soaba, Apolineer KELEM n lʋɩ taoor tɩ b pag tigrã kʋɩlense. A pagbã wakate, gosneemã taoor soab wẽe Balafõ wã naoor a yoobe, n wilgd tɩ ESƐNSE naoor 20 soabã paga a kʋɩlense. B kõo taab sɛk a naoor 21 soabã sẽn watã.

Burkĩna Faso rãmb sigla bogb n na n zab ne weooga bãaga

Tʋʋl-nif kiuug rasem 25 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Miniisr Robɛɛr KARGUG sẽn get  laafɩ wã yellã, tɩ lʋɩɩ taoor tɩ b maan daar ning b sẽn yãk n zabd ne weoogã bãagã.

Sẽn na n yɩl n zab ne weoogã bãagã, Burkĩna Faso rãmb yãka tʋʋl-nif kiuug rasem 25 yʋʋmd fãa tɩ ya daar b sẽn yãk n zabd ne weoogã bãaga. Gom-zug b sẽn yãk rõanda yʋʋmdã yaa « wakat taame tɩ weoogã bãag ka le segd n zĩnd ye: d kẽes-d toogo, d kẽng taoor ne zabrã, la d rɩk na-kẽndre »

 Miniisr ning sẽn get laafɩ wã wilgame tɩ daarã b sẽn yãkã yaa sẽn na n zĩndɩ n maan, gɛɛla b sẽn zabd ne weoogã bãaga. A leb n yaa wakat b sẽn segd n kẽng taoor ne tʋʋm nins b sẽn tõe n tʋm tɩ weoogã bãag kolg weoogo.

Miniisrã togsame tɩ logtog-yiyã logtoɛɛmbã sẽn segd bãad rãmbã, b koabg pʋga, 38 yaa weoogã bãag bẽedba. Koabg zugu neb 15 n maand kaalem weoogã bãag sabaabo.

Yʋʋm 2021 soabã,  Burkĩna Faso, neb milyão 12 n bẽ weoogã bãaga. B sʋkã neb 4 000 n maan kaalem. La ka segd ye. Woto fãa segd n saame. Yʋʋm 2015 soabã pʋgẽ, neb 1000 sʋka, neb 451 n da bẽed weoogã bãaga. Yʋʋm 2021 soabã, b mikame tɩ neb 1000 sʋka, neb 569  n bẽed bãagã. Rẽ wilgdame t’a ka lebd poorẽ ye.  A sẽn zabd neb rãmb n yɩɩd yaa kamb nins sẽn ka ta yʋʋm a nu wã, la pagb nins sẽn tar pʋsã.

Miniisr Robɛɛr KARGUG kẽnga taoor n togs tɩ weoogã bãag segd n saa zãng ka ne yʋʋm 2030 soabã, la rẽndame tɩ b rɩk na-kẽnda wʋsgo. Segdame tɩ nebã kell n gãe fu-rotã b sẽn boond tɩ  MILDA  pʋse, la b kẽng taoor ne vaeesg ning b sẽn maand sẽn na yɩl n paam weoogã bãag bokre.

A kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ ka ne ƴʋʋm 2024 soabã, Burkĩna Faso na n sɩnga bogb ning sẽn zabd ne weoogã bãagã. Yaa neb milyão la b na n deng n boke, la  yaa ligd sõor sẽn ta milyaar la gosneerã rɩk n kẽes a pʋgẽ.

Sẽn kẽed ne zab ne weoogã bãag pʋgẽ, Burkĩna Faso rãmb paama yãagr b tʋmd-n-taas kẽer nengẽ. A Sayidu kulbali ãnduni sull ning sẽn get laafɩ wã yell b sẽn boond tɩ OWƐMƐS no-rɛɛs sẽn be Burkĩna Faso, wilgame tɩ tẽngã sẽn vʋɩ yõ-koglgã kaalem pʋgẽ wã,  kɩtame tɩ neb wʋsg yik n bas b zagse, la b na n deng n sɩngã bãmb bogbo. A togame tɩ yaa tʋʋm-te-paal b sẽn boond tɩ ( RTSS la R21) la b na n tall n bog-ba, la b kõ-b-la fu-ro-yũnugdsã.

Yaa Lekoll b sẽn boond tɩ Patris LUMUMBA sẽn be Waogdg Arõdiisma a 6 pʋgẽ la b maan daar ning b sẽn yãk n zabd ne weoogã bãagã. Yɩɩ yʋʋm 2007 soabã, la b rɩk noor n yãk tʋʋl-nigf kiuug rasem 25 yʋʋmd fãa tɩ ya daar b sẽn zabd ne weoogã bãaga.

Sɛkã poore a Alɛgsi SALTIKOV wilgame tɩ b sõsa tẽns a yiibã tʋmd-n-taar yelle. A yeelame tɩ rasma noore, b zoodã paama pãnga. Burkĩna faso depite rãmbã sẽn zẽk b naoor n tɩ naag tigs-kaseng ning sẽn zĩnd Mosku wã, yaa kaseto. A togsame tɩ Burkĩna Faso ne Risi zoodã sɩngr kaoosame.

Yõ-koglg kaalmã wɛɛngẽ, Ãmbasadɛɛrã yeelame t’a ne depite rãmbã taoor soab zoe n dɩka na-kẽnda, sẽn kẽed ne zĩ-kãnga, tɩ bala, Risi tẽngã taoor soab a Valadimiir PUTIND ratmã ya b tolg n zab ne nin-wẽnsã, la b mao tɩ laafɩ lebg n zĩnd Sayɛllã ssolmẽ. A PUTIND rat n sõng-b lame tɩ Sayɛll tẽnsã kẽng taoore, tɩ bãmb ne Risi zoodã paam pãnga.

Tʋʋl-nif kiuug rasem 10 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Azãas rãmb a yopoe sẽn naag taab sull a ye pʋg n sigind tẽeb so-togsã nin-sabls tẽnsẽ la nasaar tẽnsã talla sɛk ne kiba-kɩtbã Waogdgo, Katdrall zakã pʋga.

B sõasgã pʋgẽ, b wilgame tɩ yʋʋm 2023 soabã tẽeb so-togs sɩngda sẽoog kiuug sẽn watã pʋgẽ.

 Pipi yaa Zeerizalɛm  tẽeb so-toakã. Yẽ soabã ligd yaa milyão la tus koabg la pisopoe. Yiib soaba, yaa Fãrense, Yitali, la Bosni. So-tog-kãng yaa sa-sik kiuugu. Yẽ soabã ligd yaa milyão la tus koabg la pis wɛ.

Bõn-bɩʋʋng kiuug rasem  10 n tãag a rasem 30 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, yaa Kanada.  A ligdã yaa milyão a tãabo.

Nasaar tẽnsã kẽnd loogre, yaa Kodenvoaar tẽnse, wala : Boakɩ, Yisya, Yamusokoro,  la Abidzã. Kodenvaar kẽndã yaood yaa na-kẽndr a yiiba.

Sẽn na n kẽ-b Kaarã yaooda tus pis-naas la  a nu. Sẽn yãk-b yam n na n kẽ-b Sɩlgã,  bãmb yaooda tus koabg la pis-naase. Kẽnda sɩngda sa-sik kiuug rasem a 9 n tãag a rasem 19. Kodenvaarã, yaa Sẽnt Filimend n sigind-a.

Sullã seb-gʋnd a Severind TARWARE, Azãaz Kezas taoor soabã,  wilgame tɩ ned ning sẽn dat n kẽng tẽeb so-toakã  Zerizalɛɛm, a segd n yɩɩ kirisneda, n tar a soob sebre. Sẽn paasde a soab segd n tara a paaspoore, Koviidã bogb sebre,  bɩ a vaeesgã sebr b sẽn boond tɩ peseyɛɛrã.

Sã n ya nasaar tẽnsã, a soab segd n tara a paaspoore, la sɛb a taab Ãmbasaadã sẽn kõ tɩ b boond tɩ viiza Sẽngendã. Seb-kãng poore, sɛb a taabã sẽn ketã yaa Ãmbasaadã n gete.

Tigung katolik sull ning sẽn get tẽeb so-togsã siglg taoor soaba Razãagnaab wilgame tɩ sula wã  tʋʋm pʋgẽ, b maanda b pãng sẽn tõe sẽn na n yɩlẽ tɩ Azãaz rãmb nins sẽn segend tẽeb-so-togsã bãng na-kẽnda nins b sẽn segd n dɩke. Razãagnaab paasame tɩ tigung sẽn kõ sor tɩ b na n sigind tẽeb so-togsã, segdame tɩ bãmb pʋgd n get sulã rãmb sẽn sigind-a toto.

Azãaz rãmb a yopoe wã taoor rãmb togsame tɩ tẽeb so-toak yaa tẽeb tʋʋmde, yaa pʋʋsgo. A ka gilg n ges yel-soalem bal ye. Rẽ n so tɩ bãmb get nebã yʋʋma la b  gʋlsdẽ. B wilgame tɩ tẽeb so-toak fãa, yaa neb 50 la b rɩkda. Sã n ya ne kẽndã lagd-yaoodga,  yaa Azãaz fãa sẽn yãk bãk ning la b kẽngd n tɩ yao. Neb nins sẽn dat vẽenem tẽeb so-tookã wɛɛngẽ, n paase, b rãmb tõe n kẽnga Radyo Marya.

Tʋʋl-nif kiuug rasem a 5 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, moeembã ne kiris nebã tɩ naaga taab Arsevese sẽn be Waogdgã n maan no-kaoore. Yɩɩ dĩin buud toor-toor taoor rãmba : rog-n-mikã zĩigẽ,  moeemba, Kagdinall Filip WEDRAOOGO, la kadensã Miniisri.

Yaa yʋʋm 2021 soabã sẽn loogã, la « Liig Islamik pʋʋr la pɛ » ne Tigung Katolik sull ning sẽn get moeebã lane kiris neba wʋm taabã yãk yam sigl naag taab n kao noorã. Nand tɩ b kao noorã kiris nebã reng n maana b zabr pʋʋsgã, b sẽn boond tɩ vɛprã. Rẽ poore, moeembã me taka b Laandãan Arsevese zakã pʋga, n kõ sor tɩ b sɩng no-kaoorã. Moeembã kell n pʋʋsa  no-kaorã poor pʋʋsgo.

Liig Islamik taoor soaba a Lahagi Useeni Tãpsoab yeelame tɩ Burkĩna Faso,nebã sẽn naag taab n vʋɩ saam-biir la ma-biiri. Yaa rẽ n kɩte, tɩ bãmb sullã yãk yam yʋʋma noore,  tɩ b ne Tigung Katolikã taoor dãmbã segd taab n maand no-kaoore. Rẽ yaa kaset sẽn wilgd tɩ dĩinã a yiibã gãda taab nusi n dat n mao tɩ laafɩ zĩnd Burkĩna Faso. A togsame tɩ yaa boto me la b sullã rata.

Kagdinall Filip WEDRAOOG me togsame tɩ no-loeerã a yiibã sẽn seg taab rõanda wã, a yaa makre, sẽn na yɩl tɩ  dĩinã a yiibã sɩd gãda taab nusi, tɩ b fãa yaa Wẽnd kamba. Rẽnd ka segd tɩ welgr zĩnd b sʋk ye. B segd n gãda taab nus n zab ne nin-wẽnsã tɩ b ra tõog n welg tẽngã kamb ne taabã. Kagdinall kosame tɩ b pʋʋs n kõ tãrãzisẽo wã taoor dãmba, sodaasã, la neb nins fãa sẽn kẽes b toog n zabd n tẽngã yĩng tɩ b tõog n tʋm tɩ laafɩ lebg n wa a zĩigẽ. Kagdinall Filip kẽnga taoor n wilg tɩ Tigung Katolik na n kell n zĩnda moeembã poorẽ wakat fãa. B togsame tɩ yaa rẽ n so tɩ wakat fãa no-lokre, bɩ kibsa, bãmb zẽkda b naoor n tɩ zĩnda moeembã pʋʋsgẽ.

Miniisr Kolonell Bukare ZŨNGRÃNA wilgame  tɩ nand tɩ ned tuub n yɩ more, bɩ kiris neda, maan-kʋʋda, wall tũudum a to neda, a soab reng n yaa Burkĩna Faso biiga. Rẽnd naag taab n vɩɩmdã yaa tɩlae. Nin-buiidã segd n basa welgr buud toor-toore, la b gãd taab nus n tʋm tɩ tẽngã paam laafɩ. A wilgame t’a sũur yaa noogo. Bala,  moeembã ne Kiris nebã naaga taab zĩig a ye n kao-noorã.

Liig islamikã ne Tigung Katolik sull ning ning sẽn get dĩin dãmb na wʋm taabã taoor dãmb kõo taab sɛk yʋʋmd sẽn wate.

B togsame ti yaa rei on so ti wakat faa no lokre, bi kibsa, bamb zeikda ub naoor on ti zinda moeemba puusgei.

Nin buiida segd on basa welgr buud toor toore, la ub gad taab nus on tum ti teinga paam laafi. A wilgame t’a suur yaa noogo. Bala,  moeemba ne Kiris neba naaga taab ziig a ye on kao noora.

Liig islamika ne Tigung Katolik sull ning ning sein get diin damb na wum taaba taoor damb koon taab sek yuumd sein wate.

Tʋʋl-nif kiuug rasem a 3 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Burkĩna Faso gosneerã taoor soab  a Apolineer KELEM kẽngame tɩ sull ning sẽn get ligd na kẽ tɩ b paam n zab ne bɛɛbã kʋms ligdã sẽn kẽ wã gɛɛlã.

Bɛɛrã tʋʋm-noor b sẽn boond tɩ Sodibo wã, kẽesa milyaar a 5. Sɩgaarã zĩigẽ kẽesa milyõ 395 la zaka. Bɛɛr ning b sẽn boond tɩ Libsã kẽesa milyõ 36.

Arzɛk kẽesg Miniisri, a Bubakar NAKANABO, togsame tɩ b na n dɩka ligdã n ges neb nins sẽn kẽes b toog ne yamleoog n na n zabd n fãag tẽngã yaoob yelle. Ligdã b sẽn paama, na n sõngame tɩ b yao b kiuugu, la b zãms-b zabrã na-kẽnda buud toor-toore,  la a tõog tɩ b  paam zab-teedo. A yeelame tɩ b na n lugla sull t’a pʋgd n getẽ ligdã yiisg sã n tũuda sor wala sẽn segde. Miniisrã wilgame tɩ rasem a yopoe fãa, b na n segda taab n get tʋʋmdã na-kẽndre.

Ba kibayã sẽn ka tolg n yit wʋsg zabrã zĩigẽ wã, nebã sɩd sakame n kẽesd b toogo. Yaa rẽ tɩ sullã rãmb kos tɩ b rɩkdẽ vẽenmã rasem a yopoe-poe n taasdẽ nebã.

Tʋʋlg kiuug rasem 23 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR sega  Sãtrnoor  taoor dãmba, la kom-bɩɩbã.  A sõasgã pʋga a goma zab ne yõ-koglg kaalmã yelle.

Yɩɩ Kaya sɛkã ro-kaseng pʋg la a seg Sãntrnoorã taoor dãmb n wilg a sẽn kẽes a meng toto n na n sɩd zab n fãag tẽngã, la a tʋm tɩ laafɩ la yõ-koglg hakɩk tõog n lebg n wa, tɩ tẽngã kẽng taoore.

A koeesã pʋga, a wilgame t’a ka na n tol n bas tẽngã tɩ lʋɩ ye. Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR bẽda be n bool kom-bɩɩba fãa tɩ b sak n kẽes b toog n sõng zab n fãag tẽngã. A pẽga nebã sẽn sak n sɩd kẽes b toog n na n zab n fãag tẽngã. A wilgame t’a bee tʋʋm zugu, sẽn na yɩl n tõog n sõng neb nins sẽn vʋɩ Sãntrnoor soolmã pʋgẽ, la neb nins fãa sẽn namsd yõ-koglg kaalmã yĩngã.  A wilgame t’a na n tʋmame tɩ b tõog n paam ko-yɩlgemde, tɩ kambã me tõog n paam kaorengo.

Tẽngã taoor soab kell n wilga nebã tɩ zab-teedã pãng pasaame, la a na n sõnga sodaasã tɩ b tʋʋmdã pãng paas wakat sẽn wat pʋgẽ.

Kapitɛnd TARWAR leb n kosa nebã la kom-bɩɩbã, tɩ b maan gũusg ne kibayã kũun ẽntɛgnetã zugu, bala a tõe n yɩ sabaab n koms sodaasã tʋʋmde.

Sãntr noor soolmã taoor rãmb pẽga nadg pãng ning tẽngã taoor soab sẽn tarã, sẽn yɩɩd fãa Burkĩna Faso na lebg n paam laafɩ wã. B wilgame tɩ b bee tẽngã taoor soab poorẽ wakat fãa. B kell n dɩka zu-loees sẽn be yõ-koglgã wɛɛngẽ, la reezẽo wã taoor kẽnd wɛɛngẽ n taas tãrãzisẽo wã taoor soaba.

Tẽngã taoor soab wilgame t’a tʋmda sẽn na yɩl n paam a tɩɩm, la rẽnd tɩ ned kam fãa kẽes a toogo.

LUTTE CONTRE L’INSÉCURITÉ : LE CHEF DE L’ETAT RÉAFFIRME SA DÉTERMINATION ET APPELLE LA JEUNESSE À RESTER DEBOUT
converted:
Tuulg kiuug rasem pisi la a taanbo yuum tuusa yiibu la pisi la a taanbo soaba, Kapitend Yibrayiim TARWAR sega  Satrnoor  taoor damba, la kom biiba.  A sonasga puga a goma zab ne yon koglg kaalma yelle.

Yii Kaya seka ro kaseng pug la a seg Santrnoora taoor damb on wilg a sein keies a meng toto on na on sid zab on faag teinga, la a tum ti laafi la yon koglg hakik toong on lebg on wa, ti teinga keing taoore.

A koeesa puga, a wilgame t’a ka na on tol on bas teinga ti lui ye. Kapitend Yibrayiim TARWAR beida be on bool kom biiba faa ti ub sak on keies ub toog on sonng zab on faag teinga. A peiga neba sein sak on sid keies ub toog on na on zab on faag teinga. A wilgame t’a bee tuum zugu, sein na yil on toong on sonng neb nins sein vui Santrnoor soolma pugei, la neb nins faa sein namsd yon koglg kaalma yinga.  A wilgame t’a na on tumame ti ub toong on paam ko yilgemde, ti kamba me toong on paam kaorengo.

Teinga taoor soab kell on wilga neba ti zab teeda pang pasaame, la a na on sonnga sodaasa ti ub tuumda pang paas wakat sein wat pugei.

Kapitend TARWAR leb on kosa neba la kom biiba, ti ub maan guusg ne kibaya kuun eintegneta zugu, bala a tone on yi sabaab on koms sodaasa tuumde.

Santr noor soolma taoor ramb peiga nadg pang ning teinga taoor soab sein tara, sein yiid faa Burkina Faso na lebg on paam laafi wa. B wilgame ti ub bee teinga taoor soab poorei wakat faa. B kell on dika zu loees sein be yon koglga weengei, la reezeio wa taoor keind weengei on taas taraziseio wa taoor soaba.

Teinga taoor soab wilgame t’a tumda sein na yil on paam a tiim, la reind ti ned kam faa keies a toogo.

LUTTE CONTRE L’INSÉCURITÉ : LE CHEF DE L’ETAT RÉAFFIRME SA DÉTERMINATION ET APPELLE LA JEUNESSE À RESTER DEBOUT

original:
Sẽn na yɩl tɩ Burkĩna Faso ne Mali tʋʋmd-n-taarã kẽng taoore, neb 19 n yi Bamaok Mali soolmẽ wã n kẽn nao n wa Waogdgo. B kẽe tʋʋlg kiuug rasem 21 yʋʋm 2023 soabã la b ta Waogdgo, rẽ tɩ b yi Mali a rasem 22 yĩnga.

Yɩɩ Wao-fugdg kiuug rasem 27 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, la neb yãk yam n yi Bamaoko, Mali soolmẽ wã n kẽn n wa Burkĩna Faso na-tẽngã pʋga. Kẽndbã ra zãada Burkĩna Faso ne Mali tãb-kaorã. Yaa Mali, Burkĩna Faso,  Gine, la Kõngo kom-bɩɩb sẽn zabd nin-sabls tẽnsã na paam a soog n meng hakɩɩka, bãmb n naag taab n sigl kẽndã. B kẽndã tʋlsem yaa sẽn na n wilg Burkĩna Faso tẽngã taoor dãmb tɩ b ratame tɩ b tʋm tɩ nin-sabls tẽnsã gãd taaba nusi.

A Sãngare,  kẽndbã sʋk ned a ye, sẽn ta yʋʋm pisoob rɩka koɛɛg n wilg tɩ rũnda-rũndã, nin-sabls tẽnsã segd n tik n yikame. La bũmb ning sẽn kõt bãmb raoodã, ya a Asimi GOETA, ne a Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWARE, la a Mamadi DUMBIYA sẽn dɩk nin-sabls tẽng yikrã sorã. Yaa rẽ tɩ b me yik n na n yãag-ba, tɩ b tʋm tɩ tẽns a taabã me rɩk b na-kẽndrã. A kẽnga taoor n paas t’a Asami GOETA ne Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR sã n gãd taab nusi, n dat tɩ b tẽns a yiibã naag taab n zabe, yaa tɩlae tɩ b yãag-ba. Bala yaa bãmb sẽn zabd n dat bũmb ningã la b sẽn maandã.

A Yusuf BOARI kẽndã siglg taoor soab wilgame tɩ yaa kɩlo 862 la b sẽn kẽna. A togsame tɩ b raabã yaa tɩ toaag ra le zĩnd Burkĩna ne Mali sʋk ye. Yaa sẽn na yɩl tɩ tẽns a yiibã lebg bũmb a ye. A kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ wakat sẽn looge, tẽns a  yiibã  ra yaa wa tẽn-yende, la rũnda , b sã n gomd naag taabã yelle neb wʋsg sãbdame tɩ yaa naab a yembr n na n zã tẽns a yiibã.  Naag taabã, yaa  nin-buiidã sẽn na n paam sor n kẽnd tẽns a yiibã pʋgẽ wa b sẽn date, tɩ nasaar wẽnga sẽn da maan toos ninsã ka le naag sʋk ye. Sã n  yɩ  boto tẽns a yiibã na n kẽnga taoore, b soog-b-mensã paamda pãng n paase.

Yaa nin-buiid katɛk n yi n deeg kẽndbã. B yɩɩla Burkĩna Faso ne Mali tẽngã soog-b-mens yɩɩla. Yɩɩ Memoryall Toma Sãnkarã la b seg-ba.

Sein na yil ti Burkina Faso ne Mali tuumd n taara keing taoore, neb piig la a wai on yi Bamaok Mali soolmei wa on kein nao on wa Waogdgo. B keie tuulg kiuug rasem pisi la a yembre yuum tuusa yiibu la pisi la a taanbo soaba la ub ta Waogdgo, rei ti ub yi Mali a rasem pisi la a yiibu yinga.

Yii Wao fugdg kiuug rasem pisi la a yopoe yuum tuusa yiibu la pisi la a taanbo soaba, la neb yak yam on yi Bamaoko, Mali soolmei wa on kein on wa Burkina Faso na teinga puga. Keindba ra zaada Burkina Faso ne Mali tab kaora. Yaa Mali, Burkina Faso,  Gine, la Konngo kom biib sein zabd nin sabls teinsa na paam a soog on meng hakiika, bamb on naag taab on sigl keinda. B keinda tulsem yaa sein na on wilg Burkina Faso teinga taoor damb ti ub ratame ti ub tum ti nin sabls teinsa gad taaba nusi.

A Sangare,  keindba suk ned a ye, sein ta yuum pisoob rika koeeg on wilg ti runda runda, nin sabls teinsa segd on tik on yikame. La bumb ning sein kont bamb raooda, ya a Asimi GOETA, ne a Yibrayiim TARWARE, la a Mamadi DUMBIYA sein dik nin sabls teing yikra sora. Yaa rei ti ub me yik on na on yaag ba, ti ub tum ti teins a taaba me rik ub na keindra. A keinga taoor on paas t’a Asami GOETA ne Yibrayiim TARWAR sa on gad taab nusi, on dat ti ub teins a yiiba naag taab on zabe, yaa tilae ti ub yaag ba. Bala yaa bamb sein zabd on dat bumb ninga la ub sein maanda.

A Yusuf BOARI keinda siglg taoor soab wilgame ti yaa kilo kobs nii la pisyoobe la a yiibu la ub sein keina. A togsame ti ub raaba yaa ti toaag ra le zind Burkina ne Mali suk ye. Yaa sein na yil ti teins a yiiba lebg bumb a ye. A keinga taoor on paas ti wakat sein looge, teins a  yiiba  ra yaa wa tein yende, la runda , ub sa on gomd naag taaba yelle neb wusg sabdame ti yaa naab a yembr on na on za teins a yiiba.  Naag taaba, yaa  nin buiida sein na on paam sor on keind teins a yiiba pugei wa ub sein date, ti nasaar weinga sein da maan toos ninsa ka le naag suk ye. Sa n  yi  boto teins a yiiba na on keinga taoore, ub soog b mensa paamda pang on paase.

Yaa nin buiid katek on yi on deeg keindba. B yiila Burkina Faso ne Mali teinga soog b mens yiila. Yii Memoryall Toma Sankara la ub seg ba.

Kibara yii Burkina pisi la a naanse

original:
ESƐNSE wã yaa kʋdemdã, la reem buud toor-toor tig-kaseng b sẽn maand Bobo soolmẽ. Rõandã soabã ya a naoor 20 soaba. A na n sɩnga tʋʋl-nif kiuug rasem 29 n tãag sig-noy kiuug rasem a 6 yʋʋm 2023 soabã. Sẽn na yɩl tɩ tigrã soglg tõog n kẽn wala sẽn segde, miniisr ning sẽn get kʋdemdã, a Rĩmtallba Emanwɛll WEDRAOOG zĩniga sula Bobodɩʋla tɩ b na n ges tʋʋmdã siglgu.

Gom-zug b sẽn tiki, n na n maan a naoor 20 soabã tig-tẽegre, yaa « Rog-n-mikã reemã buud toor toor sõngda naag taab n vɩɩmdã wɛɛngẽ ». B yãka neb 20 tɩ b ges tʋʋmdã siglgu.  Ya a Fidɛll TAMINI ministɛɛr ning sẽn get kʋdemdã seb-gʋnd-kaseng la b yãk t’a lʋɩ sulã taoore. Sulã taoor soab pʋgd a yiib n soab a Kiristɛnd Sano KULBALI wilgame, tɩ lebga vẽeneg tɩ ESƐNSE wã na n tõogame.

 A togsame tɩ ka ne kiis a yiib pʋgẽ bala, Bobo soolmã na n vɩɩmda rog-n-mik buud toor-toor tig-kaseng pʋgẽ. Tigrã sɩnga yʋʋm 1983 soabã, a tʋlsem ya a sõng tɩ Burkĩna Faso kʋdemdã la a rog-n-mikã buud toor-toor tõog n kẽng taoore, la a sõng tɩ neb nins sẽn be kʋdemdã tʋʋm pʋgẽ wã tõogd n paam n segd taab zĩig a ye, n pʋɩt taab yam-dãmba. Yɩɩ wao-fugd kiuug rasem 15 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, la gosneer wilg tɩ ba tẽngã sẽn be zu-loees nins pʋgẽ wã, b n na n maan-a lame.

Kʋdemdã miniisr a Rĩmtallba Emanwɛll WEDRAOOGO sẽn zĩnig tʋʋmdã sigindb sul loogr poore, a rɩka wilgame tɩ ESƐNSE wã maanda wakat ning tẽngã sẽn ka gãe bãane, la ba ne rẽ fãa tẽngã taoor soab sak n kõo sor tɩ tigrã na n tõog n zĩndi. A pasaame tɩ ka sorã kũun bal ye. Tẽngã taoor soab kẽes a toogo n na ges tɩ tigrã tõog n kẽn wa sẽn segde. Yaa rẽ tɩ miniisrã kɩt neb nins sẽn na n ges tʋʋmdã siglg tɩ b kẽes b toog tɩ tʋʋmdã tõog n yɩ wa tẽngã taoor soab raabã. Miniisrã kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ tig-kãngã segd n yɩɩ pʋɩ taab la wʋm taab pʋgẽ. Bala tẽngã bee zu-loees pʋgẽ. Tigrã maaneg wilgdame tɩ Burkĩna Faso ka kɩll ye. A na n kõo neb nins sẽn get kʋdemdã reezẽo wã pʋgẽ sor tɩ b lʋɩ taoor n tõog n yãag tʋʋmdã. Boto na n sõngame tɩ b bãng bãmb me tʋʋm sẽn ya a soaba. ESƐNSE wã seb-gʋnd-kaseng pʋʋsa tẽngã taoor soab barka a sẽn sak n kõ sor tɩ tigrã 20 soabã na n tõogã, t’a noogda Bobo rãmb sũuri.

ESƐNSE wa yaa kudemda, la reem buud toor toor tig kaseng ub sein maand Bobo soolmei. Ronanda soaba ya a naoor pisi soaba. A na on singa tuul nif kiuug rasem pisi la a wai on taag sig noy kiuug rasem a yoobe yuum tuusa yiibu la pisi la a taanbo soaba. Sein na yil ti tigra soglg toong on kein wala sein segde, miniisr ning sein get kudemda, a Rimtallba Emanwell WEDRAOOG ziniga sula Bobodiula ti ub na on ges tuumda siglgu.

Gom zug ub sein tiki, on na on maan a naoor pisi soaba tig teiegre, yaa « Rog n mika reema buud toor toor sonngda naag taab on viimda weengei ». B yaka neb pisi ti ub ges tuumda siglgu.  Ya a Fidell TAMINI ministeer ning sein get kudemda seb gund kaseng la ub yak t’a lui sula taoore. Sula taoor soab pugd a yiib on soab a Kiristend Sano KULBALI wilgame, ti lebga veieneg ti ESƐNSE wa na on toongame.

 A togsame ti ka ne kiis a yiib pugei bala, Bobo soolma na on viimda rog n mik buud toor toor tig kaseng pugei. Tigra singa yuum tuusri la kobs wai la pisnii la a taanbo soaba, a tulsem ya a sonng ti Burkina Faso kudemda la a rog n mika buud toor toor toong on keing taoore, la a sonng ti neb nins sein be kudemda tuum pugei wa toongd on paam on segd taab ziig a ye, on puit taab yam damba. Yii wao fugd kiuug rasem piig la a nu yuum tuusa yiibu la pisi la a taanbo soaba, la gosneer wilg ti ba teinga sein be zu loees nins pugei wa, ub on na on maan a lame.

Kudemda miniisr a Rimtallba Emanwell WEDRAOOGO sein zinig tuumda sigindb sul loogr poore, a rika wilgame ti ESƐNSE wa maanda wakat ning teinga sein ka gae baane, la ba ne rei faa teinga taoor soab sak on koon sor ti tigra na on toong on zindi. A pasaame ti ka sora kuun bal ye. Teinga taoor soab keies a toogo on na ges ti tigra toong on kein wa sein segde. Yaa rei ti miniisra kit neb nins sein na on ges tuumda siglg ti ub keies ub toog ti tuumda toong on yi wa teinga taoor soab raaba. Miniisra keinga taoor on paas ti tig kanga segd on yii pui taab la wum taab pugei. Bala teinga bee zu loees pugei. Tigra maaneg wilgdame ti Burkina Faso ka kill ye. A na on koon neb nins sein get kudemda reezeio wa pugei sor ti ub lui taoor on toong on yaag tuumda. Boto na on sonngame ti ub bang bamb me tuum sein ya a soaba. ESƐNSE wa seb gund kaseng puusa teinga taoor soab barka a sein sak on kon sor ti tigra pisi soaba na on toonga, t’a noogda Bobo ramb suuri.

Tʋʋlg kiuug rasem 19 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, Pabr Parwaasã  Zozɛf sõng maana a yʋʋm koabg kibsa. B maana tigrã ne Wẽnnaam bark pʋʋsg mees kasenga, la  yɩɩ Kagdinall Filip WEDRAOOG n lʋɩ meesa taoore. Goosneerã taoor soab a Apolineer KELEM zĩnda zĩigẽ wã tẽngã taoor soab yʋʋr yĩnga.

B kell paasame tɩ yʋʋm koabgã bark pʋʋsg sõngame tɩ b tẽeg neb nins sẽn tʋm a pʋgẽ, a hal a sɩngrẽ.

Parwaasã Kɩɩre, labe Vẽesã YƖLBƲƲD wilgame tɩ yaa Parwaasã kamb sẽn be Pabre, la zamaan-zẽns  la b zo-rãmb a taab sõng-ba, tɩ b tõog n pids b tʋlsme. A yeelame tɩ bũmb ning sẽn noog Pabr kirisnebã sũuri, ya b Wẽnd-doogã b sẽn lebg n maneg t’a tar rasãndã. A paasame tɩ tʋʋm sẽn ket ya b modg n paam sɛk roogo, la b mao tɩ lekollã tõog n paam kom-bãooneg kaoreng zĩig b sẽn boond tɩ matɛgnellã, n paam kolɛɛse, n paas masɛɛr dãmbã zak manegre, la labe rãmbã zak meebo.

Tʋʋlg kiuug rasem 14 yʋʋm 2023 soabã, a Maari Zistind Filip Wedraoogo, pag ning sẽn maood a pãng tɛka, tɩ Burkĩna Faso rog-n-mikã la tẽn-peelmã na paam a zĩigã, sega Zɩnyãr soolmẽ tẽng soben-dãmbã. Sɛg-taabã tʋlsem, yaa tẽng-n-biisã b sẽn boond b rãmb tɩ tẽngsoben-dãmbã, na lebg n paam b zĩiga, tẽngã zãab pʋgẽ Burkĩna Faso. Yaa Geoogẽnaab ne b zãma wã na kẽes b toogo, t’a Bilɛɛs lebg n kẽ ba-yirã, la a ra pa weoog ye.Sõasgã sɩngrẽ, yaa Geoogẽnaab n deng n dɩk n koɛɛga, n pʋʋs zama wã. Rẽ poore, b yeelame:” mam yaa Geoogẽnaaba. Mam sẽn wa n deeg naamã, m mikame tɩ m ya m ye. Katoliki, Moeemdo, la Merka, reega kamba. Tɩ mam na n kẽn n bao m saam-biisi. M kẽna tẽns ka tɛka, n seg tẽngsoben-dãmbã. Rũnda, d lebga wʋsgo. La Giulung tẽngsob kae ye. Bãmb sẽn kae wã, roogã nan yaa vɩʋʋgo. Sãambã sẽn wa wã, b waa ne b sũur koeese. Yaa rẽ la m bool-y-yã tɩ wa tɩ d kelg-ba. Sãambã sẽn tar koees ninsi, b na togs tɩ d kelge”.

Geoogẽnaab sẽn kõ noor poore, yaa Kaya Gawa tẽngsoab a Ãdem Sawadg n dɩk koɛɛga. A wilgame:”yaa yʋʋm ka tɛk la pagã sẽn zĩ wã, a Maari Zistind Filip Wedraoog ne a tũud-n-taas a yiib wa n yã Gawa rãmba, tɩ b yita Tẽnkʋdg Rĩmtẽnga, la b ratame n bãng tẽn-peelmã pãnga sẽn taẽ, la a tʋʋma. B reng n watame tɩ d lebsd-ba, tɩ b leb tɩ Rĩmtẽngnaab kõ-b sore. B kẽngame n tɩ paam b naabã noore, n wa tɩ d lebs-ba. Tãab-n-soabã, b waa ne sebre, tɩ tõnd tik rẽ n tall-b n kẽng Gawa, la Loaaga.Yʋʋm ka tɛkã d sẽn be ne taabã, m ka tõe n yeel tɩ m ka mi-b ye. D tʋma ne taaba, m mi-b lame. Yaa minim-kãng n kɩt tɩ m tall-b tɩ b wa yãmb nengẽ, tɩ d yaa tẽngsoben-dãmb buudu. B ratame tɩ rog-n-mikã la tẽn-peelmã paam pãnga, tõnd me bee rẽ yĩnga. Mam yaa Tɩɩbsoab biiga, m le yaa tẽng soab biiga. M dogame, n mik Tɩɩbsoaba. M dogem yʋʋm piig yĩng la b maan kaalem. M buga tẽngsoab korgã yʋʋm pissi la zaka, n da tʋkd koom yãagd-b tɩ b kẽnd n kʋʋda. La Moeemdo, Katolik la Merka wa n deega zĩig n yãmbe. Tẽngsobendã yaa rẽgd ne neb kẽere. A yaa rẽgd sẽ, la a tar yõ-wooko. Tẽngsoab wa n kaeeme tɩ nebã ket n watẽ tɩ b rata sõngre, yagens beeme, la yengs sẽn ka rẽgd ka be ye. Yaa rẽ tɩ m yeele, tɩ tẽn-peelem yaa buudu. M sẽn yasã, m dat n yɩ poɛɛga, ka tõe ye. M ka na n yɩ sãy la. La yaa sãy n kõt maam m kukurã. M dat n yɩ buud a to me, ka tõe ye. Tẽngsobendã ya m buudu. Yaa rẽ tɩ m lebg n gãd rẽ, tɩ rẽ la m yãgre. M yasa, m ka yũud tẽn-taag koom ye. Ya m rog-n-mikã yĩnga. La m bõos-y lame, tɩ tõnd sẽn wa ne bũmb ningã, bɩ y reeg-a. Tõnd sẽn togs yãmb koees ninsã, tɩ bal-y-a, n tũus sẽn sakdã”.Gawa tẽngsoab koeesã poore, b kõ a Maari Zistind Filip Wedraoog sore, t’a togs bũmb ning sẽn kɩt t’a s’gd Geoogẽnaab ne b poorẽ dãmbã. A yeelame : « m kabsda tẽngsoben-dãmbã fãa. M kabsda naab a Zɩɩdwẽnd ne a pag a tẽnga. M yaa biiga, m sẽn wa n gom n yõsgẽ, bɩ y maan m sugri. Mam sã n wa be y taoor rũnda, yaa raab b sẽn dat tɩ m yals y taoore. Sã n ka rẽ Tiugungkatolik karen-saamb biiga, pastɛɛr paga, kõn wa n yas yãmb taoor ye. Mam wa n karma Bɩɩblã, n yã tẽn-peelmã goam a pʋgẽ wã. M karma Gɛɛla 16 soabã pʋgẽ, n yã t’a Moyiis goma ne tẽn-peelmã Yɩsralyall kambã yĩnga. Tɩ mam sʋk m menga : rẽ yĩngã tẽn-peelmã yell sẽn gomd Bɩɩblã pʋgã, a yɩɩda tõnd yaab rãmbã tẽn-peelem la? Tɩ m na n bao neb n sʋgs tɩ b wa tees maam Gawa tẽngsoaba, tɩ m sʋk bãmb tɩ m na paam vẽenem. Tɩ mam na n yõgen kẽna.

La vẽneg-kãng poore, a wa n yii be, tɩ lebg tẽngã yelle. B wilgda maam naamã zãabã, sẽn ka tũud sorã. B reng n wilga maam Dĩinã zĩigẽ wã. B togsa maam tɩ m wilg Dĩinã taoor rãmb tɩ b sẽbga nebã. B weooga tẽedbã, n tudg-ba, tɩ b bas b rog-n-miki, n bas b yaab rãmba, la b bas-b tɩ b rɩk b yaab rãmbã sore. La b sã n ka yols nin-buiidã n bas-b tɩ b leb b yaab rãmbã sorẽ, yell n na n wa. Yellã pãng na n yɩɩga bãmb sẽn gãd yell n ning n tarẽ wã, la b pĩnd n bas-b tɩ lebg n dɩk b yaab rãmbã sore. Tɩ mam tol n gʋls sebre, n kõ Pastɛɛr a ye: Wẽnnaam yeelame tɩ y yols nin-buiidã, n wilg-b b yaab rãmbã sore. Yaa Bɩɩblã pʋg la mam tɩ yã yel-kãngã. Y sã n ka maan rẽ me, yellã sã n wa, y na n wa ratame t’a leb poorẽ la y ka na n tõog ye.Rẽ poore, mam le gãandame tɩ koɛɛg a to wa, tɩ m yeel perzidã Bilɛɛs Kõmpaoore. B wa n ka reeg me, b sẽn ya tẽngã naabã, bãmb n segd n yik n yalse, n gom ne nin-buiidã tɩ b bao b yaab rãmbã sore. La b sã n kell n ka reeg gomdã, b yãka raar sõor n kõ-ba. Raarã sõor sã n ta, b ka na n le rɩ naam ye. Seb-kãng yii Zʋgnallẽ wã yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 22 yʋʋm 2014 soabã. Zĩ-likr yʋʋm 2014 soabã, b naam Bilɛɛs lʋɩɩme. La yaa gomdã la b ka paame. Tʋʋm-noor ning sẽn be na-zakã pʋg n get rẽ wã, reega sebrã, la b ka sõd-a wa gom-zug ye. B ka rɩk-a n taas-b ye. La sẽn da yeel tɩ b sã n ka yik n gese, bãmb mengã naamã na n lʋɩɩme wã, sɩd yɩɩ woto.Rẽ loogr poore, yaa Tãrãzisẽo. T’a Yakuba Yizak Zɩɩda wa. La bãmb ra wẽnegame n dat n leb Dĩm dãmbã nugẽ, tɩ mam yet tɩ woto, a ka zems zãng ye. La bãmb sã n ka rɩk a sorã, b na n wa zoeeme tɩ b ka rig-b ye. Bãmb me naamã ne a wa yet t’a na n saame, b zoeem tɩ b rig-b ye. Tɩ bãmb loog tɩ perzidã Rok Kaboor wa. Tɩ tõnd yeel tɩ biig ka rigd a ba n deeg naam ye. A Bilɛɛs yaa yãmb ba politikã pʋgẽ. Bãmb n zãms yãmb plitikã, bãmb n wilg-a yãmba, tɩ y ning-b yãnde, n dig-ba, tɩ b yi n tɩ be kɛɛnga. Tẽeg-y tɩ Moog ka, a buud zĩndame. Naab a Zombre, b rig-b lame tɩ b kẽng Bigtoogo, n tɩ zĩnd yʋʋm a tã, tɩ b na n yõg sees tɩ b lebg n deeg b naam.Yãmb me segd n yõga sees n lebs y ba wã a zĩigẽ wã. B sã n wa n ka rɩ naam me, ka sãam ye, la y segdame n maoome tɩ b lebg n wa, la b ra pa weoog ye. Koe-kãng la tõnd taas perzidã Kaboore. D wilg-b lame tɩ b modg tɩ ka ne yʋʋm-sar kiuug rasem 31 yʋʋm 2021 t’a Bilɛɛs Kõmpaoor sã n ka wa, b naamã na n lʋɩɩme. Yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug rasem 22 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, a naamã lʋɩɩme. Tɩ bãmb loog t’a Damib wa. Tɩ d yẽrg n kolg-ba, n yeele: yaa sɩda. B yãka raar toor n yeel t’a Bilɛɛs segd n lebg n waame. La raarã loog t’a ka wa ye. Tõnd na n bõosa yãmb kiuug a yoobã pʋga, yãmb naamã zãabã pʋga, tɩ y modge, n wa ne perzidã Bilɛɛs Kõmpaoore. Ka yet tɩ y wa kõ-b naamã ye, yãmb we n wa ne-b tɩ b wa zĩnd ba-yirã la b ra be moog ye. Yaa Wẽnnaam meng n tik n da kõ-b yʋʋm 27 wã, tɩ bũmb kõn tol n maan tẽngã ye. Bee Alkʋrãanã la Bɩɩblã pʋga, tɩ b tõe n karem tɩ ya vẽenega. Tõnd togsda yãmba, d ka maand politik ye.Naab ning sẽn wa-a fãa tõnd togsd-a-la vẽenega. Y sã n ka modg tɩ b wa, yãmb me naamã na n saame. A Damib rãmb sẽn kelg tõndo, tɩ tõnd lebg n kuli, b ka le bool tõnd ye. Tɩ tõnd me zĩ n getẽ. B sẽn wa n mik tɩ wakatã sẽn da kõ wã, kẽeme n bõoge, b yika yãg-yãge. B ka wilg tõnd ye. B ka segl baafɩ ye. B yikame n tɩ tall a Bilɛɛs n wa, tɩ nebã ka sak ye, tɩ b le lebs-ba. Rẽnd b waoongã ka pid ye.La a Yɩbrayɩɩm Tarwar sẽn deegã. Ket n yaa koe-yende. Rẽnd tɩ perzidã Bilɛɛs Kõmpaoor wa, tɩ d lebg n yɩ sugr dãmba, n bas tɩ looge, la b tik d yaab rãmb n bõos sugri, tɩ tõnd rag n basa yaab rãmbã sore. D menemame n da tɩ be tẽn-taas sorẽ, la masa wã, d segdame n bãng d yaabã sore, tɩ d na n tõoga nin-wẽnsã. Bugraadã tʋʋmd bee be, la ka bugraadã bal tʋʋmd ye. Rẽnd tɩ rog-n-mikã paam pãnga, tɩ tẽn-peelmã lebg n paam tũubu. Sã n da ya bugraad pãng bala, woto tɩ yellã kolgẽ la weoogo.La yãmb a tẽngsoben-dãmbã me tara y tʋʋmd a pʋgẽ. Bala, b sã n yeel tɩ b yolsa nin-buiidã Dĩin dãmbã la tũudum dãmbã zĩigẽ, b na n lebg n waa yae? Yaa yãmb nengẽ la b na n wa. Yaa rẽ tɩ d rat n bõos-y tɩ b sã n wa wa, bɩ y reeg-ba. La y sã n ka bãng b waoongã tiiri, y na n deeg-b-la wãn-wãna?Rẽ la tõnd me yet tɩ d na n kolga yãmba. Nasaar wẽngã la sẽn be d sʋkã. Nasaar wẽngã me yellã, mam le wa n gãandame tɩ b yet tɩ m kolg tẽngsoab n bõos tẽn-peelmã tɩ nasaar wẽngã tõog n loog la a bas tẽngã. Tɩ sã n ka yẽ n yi, d ka na n soog d tẽngã zãng ye. Tɩ tõnd na n bõos tẽngsoaba, tɩ b sɩd tʋm tʋʋmdã, n yet tɩ d reeg gomdã n tɩ togs-a. D reega gomdã, la d ka tõe n togs-a-la. Yãmb la sẽn mi la. Nasaar wẽngã, d zoet-a lame. Sã n yet t’a menem tẽngã, la d yaool n ka tẽng taoor dãmba. D reega yellã, la d ka tõe n ta n togs ye. Yaool n yaa tɩlae tɩ d ta n togs-a. Sẽn wa n zems kiuugu, d tagsame tɩ tõnd tʋʋmdã ka zems zãng ye. A tõe n lebg n paa ne tõndo. Tɩ tõnd kell n gʋls sebrã n tool Ãmbasaadã, n togs Fãrensnaabã yʋʋre. D yeelame tɩ ka la kiuug a tã, rẽnd tɩ b sã n ka yi la b bas tẽngã, n lebg n zems ne tõnd nanambsã la b bas b zãmbã tʋʋma. Kiuugã a tãabã sã n loog tɩ b ka maan rẽ, sẽn pʋgdã yaa Burkĩna tẽn-peelmã n na n zab n sõng tẽngã.

Tɩ kiba-kɩt a ye reeg maam a sõasg pʋg Radiyoburkĩna, n sʋk maam tɩ m tẽedame tɩ tẽn-peelmã ket n tũuda sɩda ! Tɩ m yet t’a keta a zĩigẽ. Tẽn-peelem na n tʋma a tʋʋma. Tõnd kõta Fãrens bõnbɩʋʋng kiuug pipi raare. A sã n wa yeel t’a na n taame yãmb na n wʋma nasaar tẽngã rãamde. Nasaar wẽngã, na n loog ka. Bõnbɩʋʋng kiuug la tõnd sẽn kõ wã, wakat kãng sẽn wa n ta, la a Yibe nebã sẽn wa n ta n yeel tɩ b loogã. Rũnda-rũnda, b saga b teedo. Rat n yeel tɩ tekr ning sẽn tekd tɩ ya perzidã Yibe n be taoorã, ad yaa tẽn-peelem n tʋmd a tʋʋma. Tõnd yẽ tʋma tʋʋmdã, la yaa yãmb n be taoore. Sã n da ka yɩẽ woto, ka yɩt naana ye. ,Tõnd baoome n na n kolg sẽn be-b tẽngã taoor n togs-ba tɩ b bãng tɩ tʋʋmd n deng n tʋme, la b ka reeg tõnd ye. D ra ratame n togs-b tɩ b bãnge, la b me naag b toogo, la b kẽes tẽn-peelem sʋka, la b ka kelg tõnd ye. Hal n tãag woto, tõnd ka paam n gom ne-b ye. B ka kelgd tõnd ye. Bãmb sã n ka lebg n wa yellã sor zugu, ka na n zems ye. Rũnda tõnd sẽn yas yãmb taoorã, yaa sẽn na n togs-y tɩ y bãng nind sẽn be. D ratame tɩ y togs-ba, tɩ b lebg n vʋʋg tẽn-peelem ne a pãngã fãa, ne a tõogã fãa, tɩ d tẽngã paam n gãand bãane. Yãmb a tẽng-n-biisã segd n yik n deega y tʋʋma. D ka yet tɩ y sik naabã ye. La y segd n deega y tẽn-peelem tʋʋma, tɩ naamã yaa tẽn-peelmã naam. Yãmb a tẽngsoben-dãmbã n deng n beẽ tɩ nasaar naamã yaool n wa. original: Le yaa wa b sẽn sɩng n maandẽ. Yʋʋmd fãa, Nowɛllã kibs sãn wa pẽnege, Waogdg tigung rooga ba, Kagdinall Filip WEDRAOOG boonda kiba-kɩtbã, n dɩk Nowɛll kibsã, la yʋʋm-paallã pʋʋsem n taas-ba, tɩ b  pʋɩ ne Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidã la Kiris nebã.Kagdinall Filip WEDRAOOG koeesã la woto:” M saam-biisi m neb sõm yã, Waogdg tigung roogã yʋʋr yĩnga, m dat n pʋʋsa y zãng fãa ne y taabo, Nowɛllã la yʋʋm-paallã kibs yĩnga. Wẽnd na pids ned kam fãa sũur raabo, la a sik laafɩ, la sũ-noogo, nin-buiidã fãa yĩnga. Yaa sɩda, sẽn zems yʋʋm a 8 woto, Burkĩna Faso zamaanã tara zu-loeese, bɩ Wẽnd kelg-do, la b kell n yols n kõ-do. Nowɛll kibsã gomd la woto: “Wẽnnaam paam pẽgr yĩngri, la ninsaalbã kamba, bãmb sẽn nongã, paam laafɩ tẽng zugu”. D kotame tɩ Wẽnd meng tek d suyã, tɩ d mao tɩ laafɩ zĩndi, tɩ ninsaalbã fãa vʋɩɩmd laafɩ pʋgẽ, tɩ ninsaal buud fãa paam waoogre. Yaa bõe n wat ne nin-kʋʋrã? Yaa ninsaal vʋɩm waoogr kaalem. Sɩda, la zemsg kaalem. Yaa rẽ fãa, n wat ne zu-loeese, n wat ne namsgo. La tõnd tara zu-noogo, tɩ Wẽnnaam naana tõnd fãa, pagb la rapa, tɩ d fãa ya bãmb meng wẽnego, tɩ d fãa ya Wẽnnaam kamba. Ba-biisi, la ma-biisi. Woto ya d sẽn na n bas bug-raadã sɩɩ, la d bao yẽsgo, la zood ne taaba, tɩ rẽ bal n kengd d saambiirã pãnga. Rẽ bal n wat ne laafɩ.D sẽn tog n gãd n paase, yaa tɩ d fãa yaa ba-yir a yembr kambã, Burkĩna Faso tẽng-n-biisi. Bɩ d rɩ rogem ne taaba, la d sak n kos Wẽnnaam sugri n tõog n kõ taab sugri, tɩ saam-biir la zems-taab bui d zamaanã. Bɩ d siig beem lalsã, sũ-kĩir lalsã, la d me radse (põ) rãmba, sẽn ya wʋm taaba, kõ taab sugri, saam-biir la ma-biiri, nong taab ne sɩda. Yaa sɩda, Burkĩna Faso zãadbã wilga d fãa zu-loees nins pʋg d sẽn be wã. Yaa zu-loees meng-menga, la b ratame, tɩ d tik n yik n naag taaba, rapa, pagba,kasemba, la kom-bɩɩba, tɩ d zab ne d bɛɛbã, la d tʋm ninbãan-zoeer la nonglem tʋʋmde, ne neb nins fãa sẽn be-b namsg pʋgẽ wã. Sẽn le paasde, d fãa miime tɩ d tara zu-loees wʋsgo. Bɩ ned kam fãa mao t’a manesem ra paasdẽ d zu-loeesã ye. Bɩ ned kam fãa mao tɩ d ba-yirã leng-lengã sa , tɩ nin-kʋʋrã sa. Bɩ d kɩs taab sɩda, la d maan pʋ-pelem ne taaba. D rɩk y d teegre, n teeg soaala Wẽnde, ne b bi-nongrã , tõnd soaal a Zeezi kiristã sẽn wat ne saagre, la fãagre dũni wã tõr yĩnga. Tõnd ba sõngo, Pap Farensoa, kõo tõnd sagl-sõngo n yetẽ: ” Zamaan pʋgẽ, kom-bɩɩbã tara b zĩiga, la b tʋʋmde, bãmb n kõt zamaana pãnga, t’a tõe n kẽng taoore, la nin-kẽemba me, bãmb n paasd b pãnga ne b sagl-sõmse”. Ya d zãag fãa naag taab n tʋme, tɩ laafɩ tõog n zĩndi. Bɩ d mao n kelg kom-bɩɩbã , la d sõng-ba, b zu-loeesã fãa pʋgẽ.M neb sõma , tõnd soaala Zeezi kirista waame, n na maan b meng yamba, sõgne, n kõ-b vʋɩɩmã kʋʋngã yĩnga, dũni tõr yĩnga, woto yaa kaseto, tɩ taoor soab fãa yaa yamba, la sõgne, yaa kõ-m-meng vʋɩɩm zãnga, nin-buiidã na yɩ neer yĩnga. Bãngda Yizae ra pĩnd n wilgame: ” sẽn da kẽnd-b likẽ wã, b yãa vẽenem-kasenga” woto, Nowɛll wata ne saag-kasenga, fãagr saag-kasenga, bɩ d pak d suyã, n tõog n lebg Wẽnnaam kom-nongdse, n me laafɩ zamaan-paalga. Yaa pʋʋsgo, n paas yẽs ne-m to la nonglem. Laafɩ yaa Wẽnd kũuni, d sẽn tog n kose. Laafɩ me leb n yaa ninsaalb tʋʋmde. M neb sõmse, m saam-biisi, Wẽnd na sõng-do, tɩ d maan kibs rãmbã sẽn watã, ne tẽebo, la zɩɩri. D mao n maan bũmb fãa ne zemsgo, la d tẽeg d saam-biis nins fãa sẽn be-b namsg pʋgẽ wã yelle. D tõe n maana bõe bãmb yĩnga? Nowɛll la yʋʋm-paalgã mees rãmb pʋgẽ, Parwaas fãa mao n sak n yãk ligd lobr a yembre, tɩ d sõng sẽn be-b namsg fãa pʋgẽ. Neb nins sẽn zoe n bas b tẽnse, la b paoongo, kɩɩb-bi wã, pʋg-kõapã, la naong rãmba. Bɩ d kos laafɩ naabã, tɩ b ning Burkĩna zamaanã bark n kõ-do, b ning nin-sabls tẽnsã, la ãndũni wã tõr bark n kõ-do. Y zãag fãa ne y taabo, Wẽnd na taas-d vẽer ne laafɩ la sõmblem”.Kagdinall Filip WEDRAOOGO, Waogdg tigung roogã ba.

Vaeesdbã wilgame tɩ Burkĩna sʋndã futu, a tẽngã nin-buiid sã n ninga, a sõmblamã ka tar mak-n-taag ye. Ba zĩigã sã n wɩngd bɩ a maagdame, a ket n sakda ne Burkĩna Faso nin-buiidã vɩɩm. La tʋʋmdã sẽn wẽnd a kẽnda taoorã , sʋn-wʋgdb kẽer yãka yam, n tʋmd tʋʋm sẽn ka kẽesd tẽngã yõodo.B togsdame n wʋgd fut sẽn pa wʋg ne tõnd Burkĩna Fasom lamdã, n be raagã pʋgẽ, n sãamd Fasodãni wa raaga.Yaa rẽ tɩ b kot nin-buiidã tɩ b maan gũusg wʋsgo, ne fu-kãens buudã. Bala yaa fut sẽn ka kẽesd Burkĩna Faso yõod ye. A nafda neb ka yɩɩd a wãn bala. La sã n ya fut nins sẽn wʋgd ne Burkĩna Faso gĩsã, a sõngda sʋ-wʋgdbã, la a le sõngd tẽngã t’a arzɛk kẽnd taoore. Sʋ-wʋgdbã taoor soab kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ fut nins sẽn yi zamaan-zẽnsã, b bãngrã yaa naana. Bala, b sã n get-ba, b be neer nifẽ. B leb n yaa zɩsgo. B gisã sã n yõog-b bugum b yẽnegdame, bala, b yaa sũudu. Rẽnd nebã maan gũusgu, ne b sẽn daad fut ninsã.

Sullã seb-gʋnd a Zermend KÕNPAOOR me kell n zẽka koɛɛg n kos kiba-kɩtbã tɩ b rɩk b sũurã koees n taas nin-buiidã tɩ b tõog n bãng gĩs a yiibã n welge. Arb daar fãa, gosneem miniisdãmbã segda taaba. Yʋʋm 2022 soabã, b sega taab sapaolg kiuug rasem 30, wa b sẽn minim n maandẽ, la yɩɩ Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWAR taoore. Gosneem no-rɛɛs a Zã Emanwɛll WEDRAOOG wilgame tɩ b rɩka noy wʋsgo b seg-taabã pʋgẽ.Sã n ya ne ministɛɛr ning sẽn get kadengã tʋmtʋmdb zĩigẽ, b rɩka noor n na n gɩdg tɩ b ra le rɩk politik tʋʋmd n kẽes gosneer tʋʋm noyã pʋs ye. Sẽn get-a nug-tik kãngã, yaa miniisr Basolma BAAZIE. A wilgame tɩ na-kẽndrã ra zoe n bee Burkĩna Faso tẽn-kugr ning b sẽn gʋls sigr kiuug rasem 2 yʋʋm 1991 soabã, a no-rikr 12 soabã zĩigẽ. B zĩniga nin-kẽem-sõms sull yʋʋm 2006 soabã, tɩ b sulg n ges no-rɩkrã a Noorbɛɛr ZÃONG kʋʋbã loogr poore. Nug-tik- kãng na n sõngame tɩ gosneem tʋm-noyã fãa ra kẽ tʋʋm-sõms pʋgẽ, tɩ neb nins fãa sẽn kõt b mens tʋʋmdã pʋgã ra tõog n paamd keoor ning sẽn segd ne-ba. Woto na n kɩtame tɩ pʋpeelem zĩnd tʋʋma pʋga, tɩ tẽngã tõog n kẽng taoore.

Miniisr ning sẽn get tʋmtʋmdbã kell n wilgame tɩ b sã n tik no-rɩkrã, b tõe n gesa ned fãa tʋʋmd na-kẽndrẽ n yaool n dɩk a soabã, n lʋɩɩs tʋʋm-noor taoore. A pa na n le tũ ne a sẽn be pagtɩ politik ning pʋgẽ ye. Woto me, rɩkd gosneem mobilã n tar n maand naamã baoob nogooma me na n tũu be n kolg weoogo.Sẽn kẽed ne ministɛɛr ning sẽn get tẽngã arzɛk zãab zĩigẽ, miniisr dãmbã tika nug n wilg ligd sõor b sẽn na n dɩk n tʋm yʋʋm 2023 soabã pʋgẽ. Miniisr Abubakar NAKANABO wilgame tɩ yaa zab ne yõ-koglg kaalmã zĩigẽ̃, la b na n kẽes ligdã n wa tɩ yɩɩge. Yaa ligd sõor sẽn na n ta milyaar 2600 la b tõe n kẽes yʋʋm 2023 pʋge.̃ La ligd sẽn na n yi yaa milyaar 3200. Gosneerã b segd n baoo ligd sõor sẽn ta milyaar 600 n paase, tɩ b tõog n tʋm tʋʋma. Sẽn na yɩlẽ n paam ligdã, gosneem yãka yam n na baoo tʋmd-n-taas sẽn na n sak n sõng ne milyaar 600.Ministɛɛr ning sẽn get sari wã la ninsaal yalẽ wã zĩigẽ, gosneem rɩka noore, sẽn na n yɩlẽ n koglg nin-buiidã wala, nin-wẽnse, bɩ tʋʋm-yoodã rãmb sẽn mi n yõk ned menesã wɛɛngẽ. Zĩ-kãnga, miniisr Bibata NEBIYE wilgame tɩ tʋʋlg kiuug yʋʋm 2022 soabã, b wilga tʋʋmdã na-kẽndr sebre. Seb-kãng rɩglgã na n sõnga Burkĩna Faso tɩ b tõog n tũ na-kẽnda nins b sẽn gãneg ãndũni ninsaal yalẽ wã wɛɛngẽ, la ãnduni wã pʋgẽ.Na-kẽnd-kãng na n sõnga Burkĩna Faso taoor dãmbã tɩ b wilg tʋʋm nins b sẽn maan yʋʋm 2016 , la yʋʋm 2021 soabã ninsaal yalẽ wã waoogr yĩnga.

Sapaolg kiuug rasem 24 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, tẽngã taoor soab tʋma miniisr ning sẽn get kadensã tʋʋma, a Basolma BAAZIE t’a tɩ kõ sore, tɩ b sɩng yʋʋm 2022 la yʋʋm 2023 soabã sapaol-koobo, la b kell n bog rũmsã sẽn na yɩlẽ n zab ne rũm-bãasã. Sorã kũun yɩɩ Tãngẽwoodo Sabu komindã Reezẽo de Sãntr wɛstã pʋgẽ. Yaa gosneema miniisr dãmb kẽere, la tẽngã rãmb zĩnda sʋka.Gom-zug b sẽn tik yʋʋm 2022 la yʋʋm 2023 soabã, yaa ka-koaadb la gʋʋndb paam bãngr n paas sapaol-koobã na tõog n kẽng taoore, la b rũmsã na paam laafɩ la koglgo. A Basolma BAAZIE sẽn pak tʋʋmdã tẽngã taoor soab yʋʋr yĩnga, a wilgame tɩ zu-loees nins sẽn be Burkĩna Faso wã kɩtame tɩ koobã la gʋʋlgã leb poorẽ. 

A yɩɩ sabaab n paas zu-loees a taab wala sa-paowã, la birgã kaalem n kɩt t’a ligdã lebg toogo. Koaadbã sẽn pa tar bãngr sõma koobã la gʋʋlgã wɛɛngẽ wã, kɩtame tɩ rũm-bãasã kʋʋd b rũmsã. Miniisr ning sẽn get koobã, a Deni WEDRAOOG wilgame tɩ nasaar birgã ligd sẽn ya toogã, yaa ãndũni wã fãa pʋgẽ. Bala, tẽns koabg zugu, 80 bɩ 90 fãa birg yita tẽns nins be zab pʋgẽ wã. Sẽn yɩɩd fãa Risi. Yaa rẽ n kɩt tɩ gosneer kot koaadbã, tɩ b tʋm ne bir-moaagã, t’a tõe n sõng-b lame. A yeel-b lame tɩ b maoome, tɩ birgã maaneg zĩig sẽn be Kugpɛɛlã na n tõog n sɩng tʋʋm yʋʋm 2023 pʋgẽ.Miniisr Basolma BAAZIE wilgame tɩ sapaol-koobã, la gʋʋlgã wɛɛngẽ zu-loees ka be ye. Miniisr Kaasem KULIBALI pẽga Sodaasã, la a kos tɩ nin-buiidã sugri, tɩ bala, wakat kẽere, pa wʋm taab n mi n be Sodaasã ne nin-zaalsã sʋka. Yɩɩ tẽngã taoor soab a Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWARE, n lʋɩ tʋʋmdã taoore, tɩ b tɩ rɩgl tɩ-puudu, n tẽeg a Tooma SÃNKAR ne a tũud-n-taasã b sẽn kʋ-b zĩig ninga, zĩ-likr kiuug rasem 15 yʋʋm 1987 soabã. Yʋʋm 35 loogr poore, b rɩka Revolisẽo wã bug-vɩleng n ning kom-bɩɩbã nugẽ, tɩ b kell n kẽng taoor ne a Tooma SÃNKAR sẽn da tʋmd bũmb ninsi,  Burkĩna Faso  soog-m-mengã la a taoor kẽndã wɛɛngẽ.

Yaa Kapitɛnd Yibrayɩɩm TARWARE, la b rɩ Revolisẽko wã bug-vɩleng n kɩse. Kell n yɩɩ wakat me, b sẽn dɩk bug-vɩlens 12 n kɩs kom-bɩɩb tɩ b paas n yãag tẽngã taoor soaba. Woto makda neb 13 nins b sẽn kʋ Kõnsaye de Lãntãtã pʋg zĩ-likr kiuug rasem 15 yʋʋm 1987 soabã.

Memoryal Tooma SÃNKAR sullã taoor soaba a Pɛɛr WEDRAOOG yeelame tɩ b saagdame tɩ bug-vɩlensã bãmb sẽn n kõ kom-bɩɩbã, a na n kenga b pelse tɩ b tõog n dɩk a Tooma SÃNKAR naoore, tɩ Burkĩna Faso tẽngã neb tõog n tall saamb biilim, la b yɩ pʋ-peelem rãmba.

A tẽegrã maana wakat ning Burkĩna Faso sẽn be yõ-koglg kaalem pʋgẽ, tɩ rẽ yɩ sabaabo, tɩ naam tekr zĩndi. Leb n yɩɩ wakat Burkĩna Faso kom-bɩɩbã sẽn yi n wilg b belem ne Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWARE.

Kapitɛnd Marsɛll MEDA wilgame tɩ sẽn tũ ne naam wẽ-n-dɩkã sẽn zĩnd yʋʋm vẽkr kiuug rasem 24 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, tɩ ƐMPESƐƐR sẽn ya sodaas sull reeg naamã, Burkĩna Faso neb wʋsg sũur ra yaa noogo, tɩ bala, b ra tara tẽeb la saagre, tɩ yõ-koglg kaalmã na leb poorẽ. Yaa rẽ n kɩte, tɩ bõn-bɩʋʋng kiuug rasem 29 ne a rasem 30 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, sodaasã sull n yik n deeg naamã, sẽn na n yɩlẽ n maneg n sigl tɩ bũmb nins fãa sẽn da ka kẽnd sõma wã, tõog n tũ taoore. Kapitɛnd Marsɛll MEDA kẽnga taoor n wilg tɩ rũndã, zĩ-likr kiuug rasem 14 soabã, yaa raar sẽn ya kasenga Burkĩna Faso kʋdemdã pʋgẽ. B pasaame ti Gosneer tum tumdb sa on be Gibo teinga puga, yaa toog ne a t’a toong on paam a kiuuga yaoodo. A leb on pa tone on bool a zak ramb bi a tuud n taas ye. Nugei banga tuum teed ka le keind ye. Yaa rei ti ub rat ti ub ges zu loe kaens faa yelle. Karen biisa sein yi wa ya a Maru Yilbuud sein ya Gibo Perfe wa la ub kis ub su pa noaanga sebre, la yei me pulmame t’a na taas ub kosga teinga zaadba. A Saadu Ganaba ne a karen bi taasa raab yaa karen dota toong on lebg on pake.

Kibara yii Faso.net

original:
Burkĩna Faso kom-bɩɩb n yãk b yam n bool nin-buiidã tɩ ned kam kõ a nug bũmb tɩ b naag taab n maan ninbãan-zoeer tʋʋmde, ne neb nins sẽn be zu-loees pʋgẽ, sẽn kẽed ne nin-wẽnsã tʋʋm-goabã sabaabo.

La b boolã ka lʋɩ muk tʋbrẽ, tɩ bala, nebã sakame n kẽes b toogo. Yaa rẽ n so, tɩ zĩ-likr kiuug rasem 11 yʋʋm 2022 soabã pʋgẽ, sẽn sigl-b tʋʋmdã seg kiba-kɩtbã Waogdgo, SIYAWO wã zak pʋg n wilg-ba, b sẽn paam yãagr ninga.

Kom-bɩɩb nins sẽn siglg tʋʋmdã taoor soab a Alẽ TARWAR tɩ boond t’a Alino Faso wilgame tɩ yaa kood toand 400 la futu la b paam yã. A kẽnga taoor n paas tɩ sɩngrã bãmb raabã ra yaa toand 100, la b sũur yaa noogo, tɩ bala, b raaba pĩdame. B paama toand 400, la b ket n saagdame tɩ b paam n paase.

Sullã taoor soab paasame tɩ sɩngrẽ wã ra yaa Gibo la b ra yãk yam n na n sõnge. Rẽ n kɩt tɩ b pʋd tʋʋmdã yʋʋr tɩ «d naag taab n fãag Gibo»

A wilgame tɩ b sẽn paam woto wã, b na n yãka toand 100 n tɩ kõ Gibo rãmba, la b rɩk sẽn kellã n pʋɩ tẽns a taab me sẽn be zu-loees pʋg wala Pama, Barsaolgo, Solã, Seba la Titao.

Yɩɩ neb 250 n sak n kõ meng ne yamleoogo n tʋmd tʋʋmdã, ned ba a ye pa reeg ba wakɩr ye.

Sẽn na n yɩlẽ n paam tɩ koodã tõog n t’a tẽns nins b sẽn dat n kõ wã, b wilgame tɩ b rɩka tõkr ne tẽngã taoor dãmba, sẽn na yɩl n paam tɩ b sõng-ba.

Yaa rasem a tãab pʋgẽ la b siglg tʋʋmdã tɩ ned fãa kẽng n tɩ kõ a sẽn tar ne yamleoogo. Tʋʋmdã b maan-a-la Waogdgo, Bobo, Kʋdgo, la Tẽnkʋdgo.

Burkina Faso kom biib on yak ub yam on bool nin buiida ti ned kam kon a nug bumb ti ub naag taab on maan ninbaan zoeer tuumde, ne neb nins sein be zu loees pugei, sein keied ne nin weinsa tuum goaba sabaabo.

La ub boola ka lui muk tubrei, ti bala, neba sakame on keies ub toogo. Yaa rei on so, ti zi likr kiuug rasem piig la a yembre yuum tuusa yiibu la pisi la a yiibu soaba pugei, sein sigl b tuumda seg kiba kitba Waogdgo, SIYAWO wa zak pug on wilg ba, ub sein paam yaagr ninga.

A keinga taoor on paas ti singra bamb raaba ra yaa toand koabga, la ub suur yaa noogo, ti bala, ub raaba pidame. B paama toand kobs naanse, la ub ket on saagdame ti ub paam on paase.

Sulla taoor soab paasame ti singrei wa ra yaa Gibo la ub ra yak yam on na on sonnge. Rei on kit ti ub pud tuumda yuur ti «d naag taab on faag Gibo»

A wilgame ti ub sein paam woto wa, ub na on yaka toand koabga on ti kon Gibo ramba, la ub rik sein kella on pui teins a taab me sein be zu loees pug wala Pama, Barsaolgo, Sola, Seba la Titao.

Yii neb kobs i la pisnu on sak on kon meng ne yamleoogo on tumd tuumda, ned ba a ye pa reeg ba wakir ye.

Sein na on yilei on paam ti kooda toong on t’a teins nins ub sein dat on kon wa, ub wilgame ti ub rika tonkr ne teinga taoor damba, sein na yil on paam ti ub sonng ba.

Yaa rasem a taab pugei la ub siglg tuumda ti ned faa keing on ti kon a sein tar ne yamleoogo. Tuumda ub maan a la Waogdgo, Bobo, Kudgo, la Teinkudgo.

original:
Zĩ-likr kiuug rasem a 5 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, sodaas nins sẽn deeg Burkĩna Faso tẽngã taoor bõn-bɩʋʋng kiuug rasem 30 yʋʋm 2022, gãnega na-kẽndr ning b sẽn na n dɩk n zã tẽngã t’a tũ sari sore, waoog taaba, la soog-m-meng pʋgẽ. Yɩɩ Kapitɛnd Faruk Azarya SORGO, n karem sebrã ɛrtebe televisẽo wã zug yʋng wakat a 9 wã kibay kũun sasa.

 Ad na-kẽnda nins sẽn be sebrã pʋga :

Pipi gom-zugu : na-kẽndrã zu-raado

Pipi nug tikri : nand tɩ tẽngã taoor dãmb wa naag taab n zĩnd n gʋls tãrazisẽo wã zãab na-kẽndr sebre, yaa na-kẽnd-kãngã la b tik Burkĩna Faso tẽngã zãab wɛɛngẽ.

Gom-zug a yiib soaba : ƐMPESƐƐRE

Nug-tikr a 2 soaba : yaa ƐMPESƐƐR sodaasã n get tẽngã zãab yelle hal n tɩ ta wakat ning b sẽn na n yãk neb nins sẽn na n lʋɩ tãrãzisẽo wã taoore. Bãmb n get gosneerã tʋʋma. Bãmb n get yõ-koglgã, arzɛkã, sõng taabã, tẽngã taoor kẽnde, la tẽngã tods koglg yelle.

Nug-tikr  a 3 soaba : ƐMPESƐƐR sullã sigla wa sẽn pʋgdã ; a tara taoor soaba, taoor soab pʋgdga, la taoor soab pʋgdga a yiib n soaba, ned sẽn get sullã siglg yelle, la yaa sull-kasens a yiib n be a pʋgẽ.

Gom-zug a tãab soaba : ƐMPESƐƐR taoor soabã tʋʋmd sẽn ya a soaba

Nug-tikr a 4 soaba  : yaa ƐMPESƐƐR taoor soabã n ya tẽngã taoor soaba, la sodaasã fãa taoor soaba

yẽnda n get sari  roogã soog-m-meng yelle. Taoor soabã sã n wa tar gɩdgre, yaa taoor soab pʋgdgã n get rẽ. Sẽn pʋgd-a me sã n wa tar gɩdgre, yaa pʋgdg a yiib n soabã n gete.

Nug-tikr  a 5 soaba : ƐMPESƐƐR n get tẽngã soog-m-meng zãabo, tẽngã todse, gosneerã tʋʋma, la nug tigsa nins Burkĩna Faso sẽn maan ne tẽns a taabã waoogre.

Yaa yẽ n get gosneerã siglg yelle, la a tõe n kõ noor ne a nug tikri. Yẽ n segd n ges tɩ gosneer tʋʋma fãa kẽn wa sẽn segde.

Nug-tikr a 6 soaba : ƐMPESƐƐR taoor soabã, tara sor n tõe n yãk neb tɩ b lʋɩ gosneer tʋʋm-no-bɛdã, sodaarã tʋʋm noya, la tʋʋm noy a taab taoore, wala laloa wã sẽn gãnege.

Nug-tikr a 7 soaba : taoor soabã le tara sor n tõe kõ tẽns a taaba no-rɛɛsdba, bɩ zamaan-zẽns rãmb sẽn tʋm neb nins  sõor tɩ b tõe n zĩnd Burkĩna Faso tẽngã pʋgẽ. Tẽnsã no-rɛɛsdb la tẽnsã sẽn tʋm b rãmbã segd n wa wilga b sorã kũun sebr ƐMPESƐƐR taoor soabã nengẽ.

Gom-zug a naas soaba : sari wɛɛngẽ

Nug-tikr a 8 soaba : sari wã roog so a menga,  yaa bʋ-kaood rotã rãmb n  gãnegdb na-kẽnda n tũudẽ.

Gom-zug a nu soaba : nug tika , la zood ne zamaan-zẽnse

Nug-tikr a 9 soaba : ƐMPESƐƐR taoor soabã tara sor n tõe n yẽs ne tẽns a taab rãmba, la a tar sor n tõe n tall tʋmd-n-taar nug tikr ne-ba.

Gom-zug a yoob soaba : tẽngã zãab na-kẽndr lebg n gese

Nug-tikr 10 soaba : ƐMPESƐƐR sullã rãmb tõe n dɩka na-kẽndr n lebg n ges b na-kẽndrã sebre, la rẽnda tũuda ne sullã neb pʋsʋk sẽn na n wilg tɩ b ratame tɩ b lebg n ges-a.

Gom-zug a yopoe soaba : na-kẽnda sẽn na n baase

Nug-tikr 11 soaba :  ƐMPESƐƐR taoor soabã sã n sak n tik a nug na-kẽndrã sebr zugu, a wilgdame tɩ b sẽn da togs tɩ tẽngã tẽn-kug-kʋdg b sẽn gʋls sigr kiuug rasem a 2 yʋʋm 1991 soabã yalsame wã,  a lebg n wa a zĩigẽ, b tũuda tẽn-kug kãnga. Bala, a pa gɩdg ƐMPESƐƐR sullã sẽn gʋls a na-kẽndrã sebr ninga wã ye.

Nug-tikr 12 soaba : ƐMPESƐƐR sullã sẽn gʋls tẽngã zãab na-kẽndr seb-kãnga wã, a bee na-kẽndr pʋgẽ, hal sẽn sɩng ne bõn-bɩʋʋng kiuug rasem 30 yʋʋm 2022 soabã.

Nug-tikr 13 soaba : Seb-kãngã sẽn ya ƐPEYƐSƐR taoor dãmbã n gʋls-a n na n tũ n zã tẽngã, b segd n yiis-a-la tẽngã zʋgnall-kaseng ning b sẽn boond tɩ Zʋgnall Ofisɛllã pʋgẽ.

Yaa Kapitɛnd Yɩbrayɩɩm TARWARE, ƐMPESƐƐR  taoor soabã, n tik a nug sebrã zug

Waogdgo, zĩ-likr kiuug rasem a 5 yʋʋm 2022 soabã.

yeinda on get sari  rooga soog m meng yelle. Taoor soaba sa on wa tar gidgre, yaa taoor soab pugdga on get rei. Sein pugd a me sa on wa tar gidgre, yaa pugdg a yiib on soaba on gete.

Yʋʋm-vẽkr kiuug  yʋʋm 2022 soabã, naam wẽ-n-dɩkã sẽn zĩndã yɩɩ sabaab n koms pagtɩ ning sẽn da be naamẽ wã.  A komsgã ket n kẽnda taoore, tɩ bala, bõn-bɩʋnʋg kiuug rasem 21 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, minisr kʋd sẽn da be a Rok Mark Kiristẽ KABOOr naamã pʋg rɩgla b sigb sɛba, rẽ tɩ kiis a wãn loogr pooe,  neb a taab me n   da yi n bas Pagtɩ wã.

Kibayã kẽer wilgame tɩ yaa pa wʋm taab n be neb nins sẽn wẽed n yitã ne  MPP wã Pagtɩ taoor soab a Bala Sakãnd sʋka, rẽ n kɩt tɩ  tãp-biisã yita. B yiibã sabaab yaa sẽn kẽed ne MPP tigs-kaseng b sẽn segd n paam Bõn-bɩʋʋng kiuug yʋʋm 2023 yʋʋmdã n wat ne-b yit n basd Pagtɩ wã.

Neb nins sẽn wilg tɩ b pa le naag Mpp pagtɩ wã sʋka, d tõe n sõdga miniisr ning sẽn da get zamaan- zẽns zoodã, a  Alfa Baari, la miniisr ning sẽn da get kʋʋra wã, a BasirYɩsmayɛll Wedraoogo, la depite kʋdg a Lasina Wattara. D sʋkda d mens n getẽ sẽn yit-bã na n tɩ fãoonga Pagtɩ a to, bɩ b na n sigla b Pagtɩ wala a Abdulae Moose ne a poorẽ dãmbã sẽn yi n tɩ viglg bPpagtɩ tɩ boond tɩ Pepeyɛsã.

original:
Yɩɩ bõn-bɩʋʋng kiuug rasem 19 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, la Burkĩna Faso gosneerã taoor soaba, a Albɛɛr Wedraoog kẽng Amerik soolmẽ pʋgẽ, n tɩ zĩnd tigsg a ye pʋgẽ. Sõs-n-kõ taabã, pʋgẽ, a wilgame tɩ b na n lebg n sigla kaorengã.

A kell n zẽka koɛɛg n wilg tɩ yõ-koglg kaalmã sẽn kẽed tẽngã pʋgẽ wã, segdame tɩ b lebg n sulg n ges kaorengã na-kẽndre, t’a tõog n naf karen-biisã.

Permye miniisr Albɛɛr WEDRAOOG kẽnga taoor n paase, tɩ ba Koviid 19 bãag sã n komsa kaorengã ãnduni wã fãa gill pʋgẽ, Burkĩna Faso, yõ-koglg kaalmã sẽn be wã koms-a-la wʋsgo.  Bala, yaa neb sõor na  ta milyão la zak n zoe n bas b tẽnse.  Karen-dot sẽn pag sõor  taa bãmb 4000. Karen-dotã sẽn pagã  kɩtame tɩ karen-biis 700 000 baa kaorengo.

La sẽn na n yɩlẽ n paam zu-loe-kãnga tɩɩm, rẽndame tɩ Burkĩna Faso Lekollã na-kẽndre, b lebg n sigl-a n tũnug  na-kẽnd paall ning b sẽn dat n sigla, t’a sõng karen-biisã tɩ b fãa  paam zu-noog a ye.  Yaa sẽn na n yɩlẽ tɩ ba  zu-loees sã n wa beẽ bɩ a ra tiis kaorengã ye.

Yaa Nasẽo zini sull ning sẽn get kaorengã tɩ b boond tɩ INESKO wã bãmb n sigl seg-taabã Amerik soolmẽ wã.

Kibarã yii Libre info
converted:
Yii bonn biuung kiuug rasem piig la a wai yuum tuusa yiibu la pisi la a yiibu soaba, la Burkina Faso gosneera taoor soaba, a Albeer Wedraoog keing Amerik soolmei pugei, on ti zind tigsg a ye pugei. Sons n kon taaba, pugei, a wilgame ti ub na on lebg on sigla kaorenga.

A kell on zeika koeeg on wilg ti yon koglg kaalma sein keied teinga pugei wa, segdame ti ub lebg on sulg on ges kaorenga na keindre, t’a toong on naf karen biisa.

Permye miniisr Albeer WEDRAOOG keinga taoor on paase, ti ba Koviid piig la a wai baag sa on komsa kaorenga anduni wa faa gill pugei, Burkina Faso, yon koglg kaalma sein be wa koms a la wusgo.  Bala, yaa neb soonr na  ta milyao la zak on zoe on bas ub teinse.  Karen dot sein pag soonr  taa bamb tuusa naanse. Karen dota sein paga  kitame ti karen biis kobs yopoe zaalem baa kaorengo.

La sein na on yilei on paam zu loe kanga tiim, reindame ti Burkina Faso Lekolla na keindre, ub lebg on sigl a on tunug  na keind paall ning ub sein dat on sigla, t’a sonng karen biisa ti ub faa  paam zu noog a ye.  Yaa sein na on yilei ti ba  zu loees sa on wa beei bi a ra tiis kaorenga ye.

Yaa Naseio zini sull ning sein get kaorenga ti ub boond ti INESKO wa bamb on sigl seg taaba Amerik soolmei wa.

Kibara yii Libre info

original:
Bõn-bɩʋʋng kiuug  rasem 19 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, Waogd bʋ-kaood ro-kaseng a yiib n soabã kõo sor tɩ b pak yʋʋm 2021 la yʋʋm 2022 soabã bʋʋd kaoob vuk a tãab soaba. Yaa sɛb sõor sẽn ta bãmb 19 la b segd n tik n bʋ. Sɛbã sʋka, a Daabo Bukari la a Wʋsmaan Gɩɩrʋ sɛbã naaga sʋka.

Yaa roog sẽn pid  pʋgẽ, la nin-buiidã ra zĩ n gũud bʋ-kaoodbã tɩ b wa sɩng b tʋʋmdã. Neb nins b sẽn talg tɩ yaa bãmb n yɩ sabaab tɩ b yãk a Daabo Bukari yõorã, wala Zenerall Zɩlbɛɛr Gengere, a Mamadu Bamba, la a Magʋloaar Vigtoaar Yugbare, bãmb ra zoe n be roogã pʋga.

Yaa sẽn wa n zems yibeoog wakat a 9 sasa, la bʋ-kaoodb nins b sẽn yãk tɩ b get bʋʋdã yell kẽ roogã pʋga. Karen-bi-bɛdã sul-kaseng b sẽn boond tɩ IZƐB « UGEB » tãb-biis me waame, n na n maan kaset ne bʋʋdã sẽn na n kẽn toto. Bʋ-kaoodbã taoor rɩka koɛɛg n wilg na-kẽnda nins b sẽn segd n dɩk bʋʋdã kaoob wakato. A wilgame tɩ nug-n-bãng pa segd n kelme, nug-poak me pa wẽeda.

A sẽn kõ na-kẽnda wã loogr poore, a kõo sor tɩ bʋʋdã kaoob sɩnge. Yaa rasem a tãab tõr la b na n dɩk n bao n paam vẽenem sẽn kẽed ne a Daabo Bukari kʋʋbã zugu.

Tẽegre, yɩɩ  = sig-noy kiuug yʋʋm 1990 soabã, la a Daabo Bukari sẽn da be logtoeemdã karen-dot a 7 zĩigẽ maan kalem karen-bi-bɛdã sẽn wa n yi n wilgd b sũ-pa-noaanga.

Yaa bõn-bɩʋʋng kiuug rasem 30 sẽn watã la bʋ-kaood roogã na n kõ vẽenem sɛb 19 wã b sẽn tik n na na bʋ wã zugu.

Yaa seb soonr sein ta bamb piig la a wai la ub segd on tik on bu. Seba suka, a Daabo Bukari la a Wusmaan Giiru seba naaga suka.

Yaa roog sein pid  pugei, la nin buiida ra zi on guud bu kaoodba ti ub wa sing ub tuumda. Neb nins ub sein talg ti yaa bamb on yi sabaab ti ub yak a Daabo Bukari yoonra, wala Zenerall Zilbeer Gengere, a Mamadu Bamba, la a Maguloaar Vigtoaar Yugbare, bamb ra zoe on be rooga puga.

Yaa sein wa on zems yibeoog wakat a wai sasa, la bu kaoodb nins ub sein yak ti ub get buuda yell kei rooga puga. Karen bi beda sul kaseng ub sein boond ti IZƐB « UGEB » tab biis me waame, on na on maan kaset ne buuda sein na on kein toto. Bu kaoodba taoor rika koeeg on wilg na keinda nins ub sein segd on dik buuda kaoob wakato. A wilgame ti nug n bang pa segd on kelme, nug poak me pa weieda.

A sein kon na keinda wa loogr poore, a koon sor ti buuda kaoob singe. Yaa rasem a taab tonr la ub na on dik on bao on paam veienem sein keied ne a Daabo Bukari kuuba zugu.

Teiegre, yii  = sig noy kiuug yuum tuusri la kobs wai la piswai soaba, la a Daabo Bukari sein da be logtoeemda karen dot a yopoe ziigei maan kalem karen bi beda sein wa on yi on wilgd ub su pa noaanga.

original:
Bõ-bɩʋʋg kiuug rasem 13 yʋʋm 2022 soabã, ministɛɛr ning sẽn get laafɩ wã yell, kõ sor tɩ b na n pak zɩɩm kũun Wogdg yaar dãmba, la raasã pʋsẽ, yɩ Wogdg ra-kasenga pʋgẽ la b tɩ pak tʋʋmdã kʋɩlẽnse, yɩɩ minisr ninga sẽn geta laafɩ wã yelle a Robɛɛr Lusẽ Zã kolod KARGUGU n lʋɩ tʋʋmdã taoore.

Kõ f zɩɩm , ya  fãag f to yõore, yaa rẽ n kɩt tɩ sull ninga b sẽn boond tɩ sos sã, n paas ministɛɛr ning sẽn get laafɩ wã yel yãk yam n siglg zɩɩm kũun yaar dãmba la raasa pʋse , a vuk 14 soaba. Yɩɩ wogdg ra-kasenga pʋga la b tɩ pak tʋʋmdã kʋɩlẽnse. Lɛɛbdbã, la ra-biisã  wa n kõ b zɩɩm b taaba yõy fãagr yĩnga.

Minisrã pẽga sull ning sẽn yãk yam n siglg tʋʋmdã, la a wilg tɩ bãmb ne sull ning sẽn get zɩɩma kũun  yel sũur yaa noogo, la b na n kell n yãaga tʋʋmdã, sẽn yɩɩd fãa wakat ning tõnd  sẽn be a soab pʋgẽ wã zɩɩma raab sẽn yaa wʋsg logto-yiyã pʋsã, sẽn tũ ne weooga bãaga.

Zɩɩma b sẽn yãkã

Yɩɩ zɩɩm sẽn ta sase rãmb 70 la b sẽn paam zĩiga pʋgẽ a rood-wokã.  tʋʋmda ba-yãkdg yɩɩ  lahagi Hammid WEDRAOOG tɩ b boond t’a Hamiid kaaro. Yɩ wakat ba-yãkdgã  sẽn bool lɛbdba  faa tɩ b kõ b zɩɩma sẽn na n yɩlẽ n tõog n sõng b saambiisã, tɩ bala zɩɩm kũun tara nafr wʋsgo, a yaa yelsõmde, n tõe n le wa naf fo menga, f paga bɩ f kamba.

Yaa zɩɩm sase rãmb 3000 la b rat ka ne tʋʋmdã saabo, y arẽ n so tɩ b na n gilg yaar dãmba la raasã pʋse.

Burkĩna Faso goosneera taoor soaba a Albɛr WEDRAOOGO reega IYEMOWA wã tẽns sug-koatb sigr kiuug rasem a 9 yʋʋm 2022 soabã Waogdgo.

Sug-koatbã sull wa n wilga b seg taab kaseng a naoor a yoob n soab sẽn zĩnd sigr kiuug rasem a 6 n ta a rasem a  8 soabã. A DƐMBA Kandɩ, Senegal tẽnga sug-koata, n leb n yaa IYEMOWA tẽnsa sug-kaotb no-rɛs wilgamr tɩ bãmb zĩnda ne taaba n tags bũmb nins sẽn be tẽnga pʋgẽ wã. sẽn pogde, yɩ wakat b sẽn tek b sullã taoor dãmba, yaa rẽ tɩ bãmb yãk yam n wa na n wilg Burkĩna Faso goosneera taoor soab bũmb nins fãa b sẽn yalsg b tigsgã pʋgã.

A DƐMBA Kandɩkell n kẽnga taoor n wilg tɩ bãmb tigsga baosgẽ b yɩsa koees n kõ b sẽn tagsd bũmb ninsa Mali tẽnga zugu, sẽn tũ ne b sẽn sɩbg bã. A wilgame tɩ bãmb kosa tẽns nins sẽn kẽes b mens n sɩbg Mali wã, tɩ b yãk b sɩbgrã n bas, Mali ninbuiidã vɩɩm na yɩ neer yĩnga.

Senegal tẽnga sug-kaot wilgame tɩ bãmb tʋʋmdã pa regd sarɩ wã zĩig ye, a leb n pa goosneer tʋʋm noor ye, la a songda ninbuiidã tɩ b tõe n paam n bãng bũmb ning sẽn segd ne b yalẽ wã.

Yaa rẽ n so tɩ bãmb seg taabã baoosgẽ b tags zuloees nins sẽn be tẽnsa pʋgẽ wã, la b tags laafɩ la yõ-koglg na tõog n zĩndi.

Sug koatba sull wa on wilga ub seg taab kaseng a naoor a yoob on soab sein zind sigr kiuug rasem a yoobe on ta a rasem a  nii soaba. A DƐMBA Kandi, Senegal teinga sug koata, on leb on yaa IYEMOWA teinsa sug kaotb no res wilgamr ti bamb zinda ne taaba on tags bumb nins sein be teinga pugei wa. sein pogde, yi wakat ub sein tek ub sulla taoor damba, yaa rei ti bamb yak yam on wa na on wilg Burkina Faso goosneera taoor soab bumb nins faa ub sein yalsg ub tigsga puga.

A DƐMBA Kandikell on keinga taoor on wilg ti bamb tigsga baosgei ub yisa koees on kon ub sein tagsd bumb ninsa Mali teinga zugu, sein tu ne ub sein sibg ba. A wilgame ti bamb kosa teins nins sein keies ub mens on sibg Mali wa, ti ub yak ub sibgra on bas, Mali ninbuiida viim na yi neer yinga.

Senegal teinga sug kaot wilgame ti bamb tuumda pa regd sari wa ziig ye, a leb on pa goosneer tuum noor ye, la a songda ninbuiida ti ub tone on paam on bang bumb ning sein segd ne ub yalei wa.

Yaa rei on so ti bamb seg taaba baoosgei ub tags zuloees nins sein be teinsa pugei wa, la ub tags laafi la yon koglg na toong on zindi.
